• Self-employed and very careful working methods

• A team-oriented and decision-making personality with a high degree of solution orientation

• Very good German (C1) and good English (B2) knowledge in word and writing

• Versified in handling SAP and the MS Office package

jobs.title: Mechanical Designer
jobs.description:
We're looking for a Mechanical Designer with 10+ years of experience who can lead design work from concept to execution to meet project specifications, elevate visual and interaction quality, and partner closely with cross-functional teams to deliver thoughtful, high-impact outcomes. You'll operate with strong craft, sound judgment, and the ability to mentor others while driving projects forward.

Aufgaben:
• Produce high-quality deliverables such as equipment models and manufacturing drawings using Autodesk Inventor.

• Generate sales drawings using Inventor and AutoCAD.

• Ensure technical compliance and proper fit and function.

• Present work clearly - sharing rationale, incorporating feedback, and driving toward decisions.

• Manage workload priorities to adhere to budget constraints and project timelines.

• Resolve discrepancies that occur during the design and manufacture of Buhler equipment.

• Perform inspections of components, work-in-process, and finished equipment.

• Organize information on project specific SharePoint sites.

• Actively participate in project meetings with cross-functional team members, suppliers, and/or customers.

• Complete design related tasks resulting from equipment installation issues at customer site.

• Provide mentorship and design direction to other designers through critique, coaching, and collaborative problem-solving.

Anforderungen:
Job Specifications
 (Required education and experience)

• Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent

• 10+ years of relevant work experience

PREFERRED SKILLS

• Proficient in engineering drafting/drawings and engineering principles.

• Working knowledge of manufacturing and assembly practices, e.g. welding, sheet metal forming, press operations, etc.

• Awareness of machine safety codes and designing equipment for the food industry.

• Proficient in GD&T

• Autodesk Inventor and AutoCAD

• PTC Windchill

Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines.
Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries.
We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

Bühler vise à équilibrer l'humanité, la nature et l'économie dans chaque décision en développant des solutions qui permettent de libérer des opportunités d'affaires durables dans les industries mondiales de l'alimentation, de l'alimentation et de la mobilité.

jobs.description:
2007年，布勒（无锡）商业有限公司成立于江苏无锡市。凭借先进的技术优势，公司在谷物处理加工、消费食品制造及研磨与分散等领域引领市场。公司拥有制粉，面条，色选，消费食品，研磨分散等多个独立应用中心及客户服务中心，提供多产业链集成解决方案。我们秉持“布勒创新，驱动未来”愿景 ，携布勒集团全球资源，利用本地化优势，致力于开发更多创新解决方案。

Aufgaben:
根据布勒统一的研发流程与规范，负责自动化编程工具的研发、产品自动化软件的开发、电气选型和设计、整机项目支持、现有设备升级、技术转让项目落地、及其全生命周期管理等工作，具体如下：
• 新产品自动化研发：

• 完成自动化编程工具的研发。

• 完成产品自动化软件的组态、编程、仿真及界面设计等自动化程序的开发。

• 完成电气元件选型与电气方案设计。

• 根据产品开发任务书/需求输入，完成市场与应用调研；与机械、工艺、制造、质量等团队协作，制定自动化整体方案与控制架构，确保功能实现、交付质量与可维护性。

• 配合样机联调与测试验证，发现问题并持续改进。

• 跟踪新产品市场推广与客户反馈，持续优化设计文档、使用手册、程序块封装等标准化成果。

• 现有设备电气与控制升级改造：

• 对现有设备进行自动化控制升级方案设计、实施支持与验证。

• 输出改造方案、风险评估、验证计划及升级文档，支持现场验收与持续改进。

• 国外技术转让/国产化项目：

• 负责技术转让设备项目的电气图纸国产化、电气元件替代选型、软件更新与版本跟踪。

• 协调跨区域技术对齐，确保功能一致、规范一致并按期交付。

• 供应链/制造过程支持与质量改进：

• 对新选型电气设备，协助供应链与外协/外购供应商进行技术沟通、首样验收确认。

• 跟踪设备电气系统的制造与装配质量，及时发现硬件接线及软件控制问题并推动改进。

• 需求对接与技术支持：

• 学习并掌握布勒上位机控制系统的操作与应用，提出并反馈必要的开发需求。

• 负责与客户或产品开发部门的需求澄清与技术对接，形成可执行的功能规格与验收标准。

• 支持其他团队，对销售项目提供技术支持。

Anforderungen:
• 本科/硕士及以上学历，计算机软件、软件工程、电气自动化、自动化、机电一体化等相关专业。

• 3 年以上工控自动化编程类软件研发、产品自动化软件研发及电气设计相关工作经验。有食品加工行业设备自动化开发经验者优先。

• 具备开发PLC自动化编程工具的能力，包括：

• 精通Visual Basic/C#编程语言，精通工控脚本或宏编程技术。

• 精通面向对象编程（OOP）编程技术。

• 熟练使用 Git 等版本管理工具，了解常见协作流程（分支管理、合并、PR 等）。

• 熟练使用 Visual Studio Code（或 Visual Studio）工具进行开发与调试。

• 精通西门子TIA Portal SCL编程语言 和 STL编程语言。

• 熟悉西门子TIA Portal Openness开发接口。

• 熟悉微软Azure DevOps平台。

• 熟悉TypeScript/JavaScript语言和Node.js开发环境者优先。

• 具备程序标准化与版本控制意识，具备敏捷开发经验者优先。

• 具备电气专用设计工具EPlan或 Engineering Base的应用能力者优先。

• 具备常用伺服控制应用经验者优先。

• 具备扎实的电气设计基础与工程化思维，具备创新意识与解决问题的能力。

• 能够在样机测试与现场调试中独立定位问题，推动跨团队协作解决。

• 具备团队精神，开诚布公，良好的人际沟通与协作能力。

• 良好的英语读写能力及口语沟通能力。

20亿人每天食用布勒设备生产的食品。10亿人驾驶的车辆中包含本公司设备制造的部件。
布勒力求在每项决策中平衡兼顾人类、自然和经济，在全球食品、饲料和交通运输行业开发解决方案，拓展可持续业务解决方案。我们努力以创新驱动未来，特别专注于健康、安全、可持续的解决方案。因此，我们与客户、创业公司、跨国企业和学界携手
合作，共同加速实现影响。

jobs.description:
Am Standort Beilngries widmen sich rund 360 Mitarbeitende im Geschäftsbereich Grain Quality and Supply dem Anlagen- und Maschinenbau rund um die Themen Getreideverarbeitung sowie Mälzen & Brauen.
Dies umfasst die Reinigung, Trocknung, den Transport (inkl. Fördertechnik und Schiffsbeladung), die Lagerung und Digitalisierung, um Getreide vom Feld bis zum Verbraucher zu verarbeiten. Immer mit dem Fokus auf Effizienz, Produktqualität und Nachhaltigkeit.

Lass uns bei Bühler gemeinsam etwas bewirken!
Zwei Milliarden Menschen essen täglich Lebensmittel, die auf Anlagen von Bühler hergestellt wurden. Eine Milliarde Menschen reisen in Fahrzeugen, deren Teile mit Technologien von Bühler produziert wurden.
Mit jeder Entscheidung verfolgt Bühler das Ziel, die Bedürfnisse von Wirtschaft, Mensch und Natur in Einklang zu bringen. So entwickeln wir Lösungen, die nachhaltige Geschäftsmöglichkeiten in der globalen Lebensmittel-, Futtermittel- und Mobilitätsindustrie eröffnen.
Wir wollen Innovationen für eine bessere Welt schaffen, mit besonderem Fokus auf gesunde, sichere und nachhaltige Lösungen. Deshalb arbeiten wir mit Kunden, Start-ups, multinationalen Konzernen und Wissenschaftlern zusammen, um gemeinsam eine schnellere Wirkung zu erzielen. Aufgaben: Mit einem Dualen Studium zum Bachelor of Engineering (B.Eng.) Maschinenbau (m/w/d) in Kooperation mit Bühler und unserer Partnerhochschule TH Ingolstadt schlägst du einen sehr vielseitigen Weg für deine berufliche Laufbahn ein. Im Studium mit vertiefter Praxis wird keine Berufsausbildung parallel zum Studium absolviert, sondern während der vorlesungsfreien Zeit werden Praxisphasen im Unternehmen verbracht. Mit diesem Modell sammelst du etwa 50 Prozent mehr Praxiserfahrung als im regulären Studium. Der Studiengang vermittelt dir nicht nur fundierte theoretische und praktische Grundlagen des Maschinenbaus, sondern auch die nötige Methodenkompetenz, um komplexe technische Zusammenhänge zu verstehen. Im Mittelpunkt steht eine ingenieurwissenschaftliche Ausbildung - optimal verknüpft mit wertvollen Praxiseinblicken in unser Unternehmen. • Theoriephasen im Studium: Vorlesungen u. a. in Mathematik, Mechanik, Thermodynamik und Elektrotechnik. Durch Wahlfächer wie Produktentwicklung und Produktion, Mechatronik oder Energietechnik kannst du eigene Schwerpunkte setzen • Praxisphasen bei Bühler: Einsätze z. B. in der Forschung & Entwicklung, Konstruktion, Qualitätsmanagement, Supply Chain Management oder Projektmanagement • Basics: Kennenlernen der grundlegenden Ingenieurkenntnisse in Mathematik, Physik, Mechanik und Werkstoffkunde • Spezialisierung: Du erlangst fachrichtungsbezogenes Wissen in der Konstruktion und Entwicklung • Die Methoden & Umsetzung: Lösungsorientierte Bearbeitung praktischer Engineering-Aufgaben u. a. durch Studien- und Praxisarbeiten und Erlangen von Sozial- und Methodenkompetenz • Raum für Orientierung: Du durchläufst die Abteilungen Lehrwerkstatt, Forschung und Entwicklung, Prototypenbau, Fertigungsplanung und Fertigungstechnik und lernst so alle möglichen Einsatzgebiete kennen, in denen du nach deinem Abschluss tätig werden könntest • Eigenverantwortung: Von Anfang an kannst du eigene Projekte übernehmen und arbeitest ausbildungsübergreifend mit anderen Auszubildenden z.B. an einem Nachhaltigkeitsprojekt Anforderungen: • Schulabschluss: Abitur (allgemein oder fachgebunden) oder Fachhochschulreife - idealerweise mit dem Leistungskurs Mathematik oder Physik • Interesse an Maschinenbau: Du findest Technik spannend und hast gutes räumliches und logisches Vorstellungsvermögen • Sprache & Persönlichkeit: Gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse sowie Offenheit für fremde Kulturen, Teamfähigkeit und Engagement • Praxis: Du möchtest studieren und gleichzeitig Praxiserfahrung sammeln • Digitalisierung & Leidenschaft: Du hast Lust, unsere digitale Zukunft voranzutreiben Wir bieten: Familiäre Unternehmenskultur Wir haben eine mehr als 160-jährige Geschichte. Damit sind wir ein Unternehmen, das langfristig denkt und investiert - bei Innovationen, unseren Mitarbeitenden und dem wirtschaftlichen Erfolg. Moderner Arbeitsplatz mit bester technischer Ausstattung Arbeiten Sie an einem modernen Arbeitsplatz, der mit den neuesten technischen Hilfsmitteln ausgestattet ist, um Ihre Produktivität und Innovation zu fördern. Interkulturelles Arbeitsumfeld Der Schlüssel zu unserem Erfolg ist unsere vielfältige Belegschaft aus mehr als 100 Nationen und unsere inklusive Kultur. Mitarbeitendenvorteile und Rabatte Geniessen Sie eine Vielzahl von Mitarbeitendenvorteilen und Ermässigungen, die Ihren Alltag erleichtern. Werden Sie Teil unseres Teams und erfahren Sie mehr. Teamanlässe und Events Ihr Engagement macht es uns möglich. Das wollen wir gemeinsam mit Ihnen feiern. Unsere Weihnachtsfeiern, Sommerpartys, Sportveranstaltungen und Teamevents bieten die besten Gelegenheiten dazu. Grossartiger Kaffee und frisches Obst Geniessen Sie unsere Annehmlichkeiten, wie kostenlosen Premium-Kaffee und frisches Obst - für Ihren perfekten Start in den Tag! Mit jeder Entscheidung verfolgt Bühler das Ziel, die Bedürfnisse von Wirtschaft, Mensch und Natur in Einklang zu bringen. So entwickeln wir Lösungen, die nachhaltige Geschäftsmöglichkeiten in der globalen Lebensmittel-, Futtermittel- und Mobilitätsindustrie eröffnen. Wir wollen Innovationen für eine bessere Welt schaffen, mit besonderem Fokus auf gesunde, sichere und nachhaltige Lösungen. Deshalb arbeiten wir mit Kunden, Start-ups, multinationalen Konzernen und Wissenschaftlern zusammen, um gemeinsam eine schnellere Wirkung zu erzielen.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Nel sito di Beilngries, circa 360 dipendenti della divisione Qualità e Fornitura dei cereali sono dedicati all'ingegneria meccanica e impiantistica nei settori della lavorazione dei cereali e della maltificazione e della brasatura. Ciò comprende la pulizia, l'essiccazione, il trasporto (compresa la tecnologia di movimentazione e carico delle navi), lo stoccaggio e la digitalizzazione per elaborare i cereali dal campo al consumatore. Sempre con attenzione all'efficienza, alla qualità dei prodotti e alla sostenibilità.

Facciamo la differenza a Bühler! Due miliardi di persone mangiano cibo prodotto ogni giorno sulle piante di Bühler. Un miliardo di persone viaggiano in veicoli le cui parti sono state prodotte dalla tecnologia di Bühler. Con ogni decisione, Bühler mira a conciliare le esigenze delle imprese, delle persone e della natura, e a sviluppare soluzioni che aprono opportunità di business sostenibili nel settore alimentare, dei mangimi e della mobilità globale.

Vogliamo creare innovazioni per un mondo migliore, con particolare attenzione alle soluzioni sane, sicure e sostenibili. Ecco perché lavoriamo con clienti, start-up, multinazionali e scienziati per ottenere un impatto più rapido insieme.

Compiti: Con un doppio diploma in Laurea in Ingegneria (B.Eng.) Ingegneria meccanica (m/p/d) in collaborazione con Bühler e la nostra università partner TH Ingolstadt, troverete un modo molto versatile per la vostra carriera professionale. Nel corso di studi con pratica approfondita, nessuna formazione professionale è completata parallelamente ai vostri studi, ma le fasi pratiche sono passate in azienda durante il periodo di lezione-free. Con questo modello si sperimenterà circa il 50% più esperienza pratica che in studi regolari.

Il corso di studio non solo fornisce solide basi teoriche e pratiche dell'ingegneria meccanica, ma anche la competenza metodologica necessaria per comprendere relazioni tecniche complesse. L'attenzione è rivolta all'educazione ingegneristica, ottimamente legata a preziose conoscenze pratiche nella nostra azienda.

• Fasi teoriche nel corso degli studi: lezioni di matematica, meccanica, termodinamica e ingegneria elettrica. Potete stabilire le vostre priorità scegliendo argomenti quali lo sviluppo e la produzione di prodotti, la meccatronica o la tecnologia energetica

• Fasi pratiche a Bühler: incarichi di ricerca e sviluppo, costruzione, gestione della qualità, gestione della catena di approvvigionamento o gestione dei progetti

• Fondamenti: Conoscere le competenze ingegneristiche di base in matematica, fisica, meccanica e scienze dei materiali

• Specializzazione: Si acquisisce conoscenze specialistiche in progettazione e sviluppo

• Metodi e attuazione: elaborazione orientata alla soluzione di compiti di ingegneria pratica, anche attraverso lo studio e il lavoro pratico e l'acquisizione di competenze sociali e metodologiche

• Spazio per l'orientamento: Passerete attraverso i dipartimenti di laboratorio didattico, ricerca e sviluppo, costruzione di prototipi, pianificazione della produzione e tecnologia di fabbricazione e quindi imparare tutti i possibili campi di applicazione in cui si potrebbe diventare attivi dopo la vostra graduazione

• Autoresponsabilità: dall'inizio è possibile assumere i propri progetti e lavorare con altri tirocinanti in tutto il sistema di formazione, ad esempio su un progetto di sostenibilità

Requisiti:
• Certificato di uscita dalla scuola: Abitur (generale o soggetto) o Fachhochschulereife - idealmente con il corso di Matematica o Fisica

• Interesse per l'ingegneria meccanica: Trovi la tecnologia entusiasmante e hai una buona immaginazione spaziale e logica

• Lingua e personalità: buona conoscenza del tedesco e dell'inglese, apertura alle culture straniere, lavoro di squadra e impegno

• Pratica: vuoi studiare e allo stesso tempo acquisire esperienza pratica

• Digitalizzazione & Passione: vuoi guidare il nostro futuro digitale in avanti

Offriamo: Family Corporate Culture Abbiamo una storia di oltre 160 anni. Questo ci rende un'azienda che pensa e investe a lungo termine - nell'innovazione, nei nostri dipendenti e nel successo economico.

Posto di lavoro moderno con le migliori attrezzature tecniche Lavorare in un luogo di lavoro moderno dotato degli ultimi strumenti tecnici per promuovere la vostra produttività e innovazione.

Ambiente di lavoro interculturale La chiave del nostro successo è la nostra forza lavoro diversificata da più di 100 nazioni e la nostra cultura inclusiva.

Vantaggi e sconti per i dipendenti Goditi una varietà di benefici e sconti per i dipendenti che rendono la tua vita quotidiana più facile.

Eventi di gruppo Il vostro impegno ci rende possibili. Vogliamo festeggiare insieme a voi. Le nostre feste di Natale, le feste estive, gli eventi sportivi e gli eventi di squadra offrono le migliori opportunità.

Ottimo caffè e frutta fresca Godetevi i nostri servizi, come caffè premium gratuito e frutta fresca - per il vostro inizio perfetto per la giornata!

Due miliardi di persone mangiano cibo prodotto ogni giorno nelle piante di Bühler. Un miliardo di persone viaggia in veicoli le cui parti sono state prodotte dalla tecnologia di Bühler. Con ogni decisione, Bühler punta a allineare le esigenze di business, persone e natura. Sviluppiamo soluzioni che aprono opportunità di business sostenibili nel settore alimentare, alimentare e della mobilità globale. Vogliamo creare innovazioni per un mondo migliore, con particolare attenzione alle soluzioni sane, sicure e sostenibili.

Per questo motivo lavoriamo con clienti, start-up, multinazionali e scienziati per ottenere un impatto più rapido insieme.
descriptionByLocale.en:
At the Beilngries site, around 360 employees in the Grain Quality and Supply division are dedicated to plant and mechanical engineering in the fields of grain processing and malting and brewing. This includes cleaning, drying, transport (including handling technology and ship loading), storage and digitalization to process grain from the field to the consumer. Always with a focus on efficiency, product quality and sustainability.

Let's make a difference at Bühler! Two billion people eat food produced on Bühler plants every day. One billion people travel in vehicles whose parts have been produced by Bühler technology. With every decision, Bühler aims to reconcile the needs of business, people and nature, and to develop solutions that open up sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed and mobility industries.

We want to create innovations for a better world, with a particular focus on healthy, safe and sustainable solutions. That's why we work with customers, start-ups, multinational corporations and scientists to achieve a faster impact together.

Tasks: With a dual degree in Bachelor of Engineering (B.Eng.) Mechanical Engineering (m/w/d) in cooperation with Bühler and our partner university TH Ingolstadt, you will find a very versatile way for your professional career. In the course of studies with in-depth practice, no vocational training is completed parallel to your studies, but practical phases are spent in the company during the lecture-free period. With this model you will experience about 50 percent more practical experience than in regular studies.

The course of study not only provides you with sound theoretical and practical basics of mechanical engineering, but also the necessary methodological competence to understand complex technical relationships. The focus is on engineering education - optimally linked to valuable practical insights into our company.

• Theory phases in the course of studies: lectures in mathematics, mechanics, thermodynamics and electrical engineering. You can set your own priorities by choosing subjects such as product development and production, mechatronics or energy technology

• Practical phases at Bühler: assignments in research & development, construction, quality management, supply chain management or project management

• Basics: Getting to know the basic engineering skills in mathematics, physics, mechanics and materials science

• Specialization: You gain specialist knowledge in design and development

• Methods & Implementation: Solution-oriented processing of practical engineering tasks, including through study and practical work and acquisition of social and methodological competence

• Space for orientation: You will pass through the departments of teaching workshop, research and development, prototype construction, production planning and manufacturing technology and thus learn all possible fields of application in which you could become active after your graduation

• Self-responsibility: From the beginning you can take over your own projects and work with other trainees across the training system, e.g. on a sustainability project

Requirements:
• School leaving certificate: Abitur (general or subject-related) or Fachhochschulereife - ideally with the course Mathematics or Physics

• Interest in mechanical engineering: You find technology exciting and have good spatial and logical imagination

• Language & personality: good knowledge of German and English as well as openness to foreign cultures, teamwork and commitment

• Practice: You want to study and at the same time gain practical experience

• Digitalization & Passion: You want to drive our digital future forward

We offer: Family Corporate Culture We have a more than 160-year history. This makes us a company that thinks and invests in the long term - in innovation, our employees and economic success.

Modern workplace with the best technical equipment Work at a modern workplace equipped with the latest technical tools to promote your productivity and innovation.

Intercultural working environment The key to our success is our diverse workforce from more than 100 nations and our inclusive culture.

Employee benefits and discounts Enjoy a variety of employee benefits and discounts that make your everyday life easier. Become part of our team and learn more.

Team events and events Your commitment makes it possible for us. We want to celebrate this together with you. Our Christmas parties, summer parties, sports events and team events offer the best opportunities.

Great coffee and fresh fruit Enjoy our amenities, such as free premium coffee and fresh fruit - for your perfect start to the day!

With every decision, Bühler aims to bring the needs of business, people and nature into line. We develop solutions that open up sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed and mobility industries. We want to create innovations for a better world, with a particular focus on healthy, safe and sustainable solutions.

That is why we work with customers, start-ups, multinational corporations and scientists to achieve a faster impact together.

Dies umfasst die Reinigung, Trocknung, den Transport (inkl. Fördertechnik und Schiffsbeladung), die Lagerung und Digitalisierung, um Getreide vom Feld bis zum Verbraucher zu verarbeiten. Immer mit dem Fokus auf Effizienz, Produktqualität und Nachhaltigkeit.

Lass uns bei Bühler gemeinsam etwas bewirken!
Zwei Milliarden Menschen essen täglich Lebensmittel, die auf Anlagen von Bühler hergestellt wurden. Eine Milliarde Menschen reisen in Fahrzeugen, deren Teile mit Technologien von Bühler produziert wurden.
Mit jeder Entscheidung verfolgt Bühler das Ziel, die Bedürfnisse von Wirtschaft, Mensch und Natur in Einklang zu bringen. So entwickeln wir Lösungen, die nachhaltige Geschäftsmöglichkeiten in der globalen Lebensmittel-, Futtermittel- und Mobilitätsindustrie eröffnen.
Wir wollen Innovationen für eine bessere Welt schaffen, mit besonderem Fokus auf gesunde, sichere und nachhaltige Lösungen. Deshalb arbeiten wir mit Kunden, Start-ups, multinationalen Konzernen und Wissenschaftlern zusammen, um gemeinsam eine schnellere Wirkung zu erzielen. Aufgaben: Mit einem Dualen Studium zum Bachelor of Engineering (B.Eng.) Maschinenbau (m/w/d) in Kooperation mit Bühler und unserer Partnerhochschule TH Ingolstadt schlägst du einen sehr vielseitigen Weg für deine berufliche Laufbahn ein. Im Studium mit vertiefter Praxis wird keine Berufsausbildung parallel zum Studium absolviert, sondern während der vorlesungsfreien Zeit werden Praxisphasen im Unternehmen verbracht. Mit diesem Modell sammelst du etwa 50 Prozent mehr Praxiserfahrung als im regulären Studium. Der Studiengang vermittelt dir nicht nur fundierte theoretische und praktische Grundlagen des Maschinenbaus, sondern auch die nötige Methodenkompetenz, um komplexe technische Zusammenhänge zu verstehen. Im Mittelpunkt steht eine ingenieurwissenschaftliche Ausbildung - optimal verknüpft mit wertvollen Praxiseinblicken in unser Unternehmen. • Theoriephasen im Studium: Vorlesungen u. a. in Mathematik, Mechanik, Thermodynamik und Elektrotechnik. Durch Wahlfächer wie Produktentwicklung und Produktion, Mechatronik oder Energietechnik kannst du eigene Schwerpunkte setzen • Praxisphasen bei Bühler: Einsätze z. B. in der Forschung & Entwicklung, Konstruktion, Qualitätsmanagement, Supply Chain Management oder Projektmanagement • Basics: Kennenlernen der grundlegenden Ingenieurkenntnisse in Mathematik, Physik, Mechanik und Werkstoffkunde • Spezialisierung: Du erlangst fachrichtungsbezogenes Wissen in der Konstruktion und Entwicklung • Die Methoden & Umsetzung: Lösungsorientierte Bearbeitung praktischer Engineering-Aufgaben u. a. durch Studien- und Praxisarbeiten und Erlangen von Sozial- und Methodenkompetenz • Raum für Orientierung: Du durchläufst die Abteilungen Lehrwerkstatt, Forschung und Entwicklung, Prototypenbau, Fertigungsplanung und Fertigungstechnik und lernst so alle möglichen Einsatzgebiete kennen, in denen du nach deinem Abschluss tätig werden könntest • Eigenverantwortung: Von Anfang an kannst du eigene Projekte übernehmen und arbeitest ausbildungsübergreifend mit anderen Auszubildenden z.B. an einem Nachhaltigkeitsprojekt Anforderungen: • Schulabschluss: Abitur (allgemein oder fachgebunden) oder Fachhochschulreife - idealerweise mit dem Leistungskurs Mathematik oder Physik • Interesse an Maschinenbau: Du findest Technik spannend und hast gutes räumliches und logisches Vorstellungsvermögen • Sprache & Persönlichkeit: Gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse sowie Offenheit für fremde Kulturen, Teamfähigkeit und Engagement • Praxis: Du möchtest studieren und gleichzeitig Praxiserfahrung sammeln • Digitalisierung & Leidenschaft: Du hast Lust, unsere digitale Zukunft voranzutreiben Wir bieten: Familiäre Unternehmenskultur Wir haben eine mehr als 160-jährige Geschichte. Damit sind wir ein Unternehmen, das langfristig denkt und investiert - bei Innovationen, unseren Mitarbeitenden und dem wirtschaftlichen Erfolg. Moderner Arbeitsplatz mit bester technischer Ausstattung Arbeiten Sie an einem modernen Arbeitsplatz, der mit den neuesten technischen Hilfsmitteln ausgestattet ist, um Ihre Produktivität und Innovation zu fördern. descriptionByLocale.fr:
Sur le site de Beilngries, environ 360 employés de la division Qualité et approvisionnement des grains sont dédiés à l'ingénierie des installations et des machines dans les domaines de la transformation et de la malturation des grains et de la brassage, notamment le nettoyage, le séchage, le transport (y compris la technologie de manutention et le chargement des navires), l'entreposage et la numérisation pour traiter les grains du champ au consommateur.

Deux milliards de personnes mangent quotidiennement des aliments produits sur les usines de Bühler. Un milliard de personnes voyagent dans des véhicules dont les pièces ont été produites par la technologie Bühler. Avec chaque décision, Bühler vise à concilier les besoins des entreprises, des personnes et de la nature, et à développer des solutions qui ouvrent des opportunités commerciales durables dans les industries mondiales de l'alimentation humaine, des aliments pour animaux et de la mobilité.

Nous voulons créer des innovations pour un monde meilleur, en mettant l'accent sur des solutions saines, sûres et durables. C'est pourquoi nous travaillons avec nos clients, les start-up, les multinationales et les scientifiques pour obtenir un impact plus rapide ensemble.

Tâches: Avec un double diplôme en Licence en Ingénierie (B.Eng.) Génie Mécanique (m/w/d) en collaboration avec Bühler et notre université partenaire TH Ingolstadt, vous trouverez une façon très polyvalente pour votre carrière professionnelle. Dans le cours d'études avec une pratique approfondie, aucune formation professionnelle n'est terminée parallèlement à vos études, mais des phases pratiques sont passées dans l'entreprise pendant la période sans cours. Avec ce modèle vous vivrez environ 50% plus d'expérience pratique que dans les études régulières.

Le cours d'étude vous fournit non seulement des bases théoriques et pratiques solides de l'ingénierie mécanique, mais aussi la compétence méthodologique nécessaire pour comprendre des relations techniques complexes. L'accent est mis sur la formation en ingénierie - idéalement liée à des informations pratiques précieuses dans notre entreprise.

• Phases théoriques au cours des études : cours de mathématiques, de mécanique, de thermodynamique et de génie électrique. Vous pouvez définir vos propres priorités en choisissant des sujets tels que le développement et la production de produits, la méchatronics ou la technologie énergétique

• Phases pratiques chez Bühler : travaux de recherche et développement, construction, gestion de la qualité, gestion de la chaîne logistique ou gestion de projet

• Bases: Apprendre à connaître les compétences de base en ingénierie en mathématiques, physique, mécanique et sciences des matériaux

• Spécialisation : vous acquérez des connaissances spécialisées en conception et développement

• Méthodes et mise en œuvre: traitement axé sur la solution des tâches d'ingénierie pratique, y compris par l'étude et le travail pratique et l'acquisition de compétences sociales et méthodologiques

• Espace d'orientation : vous allez passer par les départements de l'atelier d'enseignement, de la recherche et du développement, de la construction prototype, de la planification de la production et de la technologie de fabrication et ainsi apprendre tous les domaines d'application possibles dans lesquels vous pourriez devenir actif après votre diplôme

• Autoresponsabilité: dès le début, vous pouvez prendre en charge vos propres projets et travailler avec d'autres stagiaires dans tout le système de formation, par exemple sur un projet de durabilité

Exigences:
• Certificat de fin d'études: Abitur (général ou relatif à la matière) ou Fachhochschulereife - idéalement avec le cours Mathématiques ou Physique

• Intérêt pour l'ingénierie mécanique : vous trouvez la technologie passionnante et avez une bonne imagination spatiale et logique

• Langue et personnalité : bonne connaissance de l'allemand et de l'anglais ainsi que ouverture aux cultures étrangères, travail d'équipe et engagement

• Pratique : vous voulez étudier et acquérir en même temps une expérience pratique

• Digitalisation & Passion : Vous voulez faire avancer notre futur numérique

Nous offrons: Culture d'entreprise familiale Nous avons plus de 160 ans d'histoire. Cela fait de nous une entreprise qui pense et investit à long terme - dans l'innovation, nos employés et la réussite économique.

Un lieu de travail moderne avec le meilleur équipement technique Travaillez sur un lieu de travail moderne équipé des derniers outils techniques pour promouvoir votre productivité et votre innovation.

Environnement de travail interculturel La clé de notre succès est notre main-d'oeuvre diversifiée de plus de 100 pays et notre culture inclusive.

Avantages et réductions pour les employés Profitez d'une variété d'avantages et de réductions pour les employés qui facilitent votre vie quotidienne.

Événements et événements d'équipe Votre engagement nous permet de célébrer cela ensemble avec vous. Nos fêtes de Noël, les fêtes d'été, les événements sportifs et les événements d'équipe offrent les meilleures opportunités.

Grand café et fruits frais Profitez de nos commodités, comme le café gratuit premium et les fruits frais - pour votre début parfait de la journée!

Chaque jour, deux milliards de personnes consomment des aliments produits sur les usines de Bühler. Un milliard de personnes voyagent dans des véhicules dont les pièces ont été produites par la technologie Bühler. Avec chaque décision, Bühler vise à mettre en ligne les besoins des entreprises, des personnes et de la nature. Nous développons des solutions qui ouvrent des opportunités d'affaires durables dans les industries mondiales de l'alimentation humaine, de l'alimentation animale et de la mobilité.

C'est pourquoi nous travaillons avec nos clients, nos start-up, nos multinationales et nos scientifiques pour obtenir un impact plus rapide ensemble.

titleByLocale.fr: Ingénieur R&D (m/f/d) Pulvérisation par Faisceau Ionique

jobs.description:
As an R&D Engineer (m/f/d) Ion Beam Sputtering, you will contribute to the further development of our LEYBOLD OPTICS IBS ion beam sputtering platforms. In this role, you will develop advanced thin-film coating processes and support the realization of innovative vacuum coating systems for demanding optical applications. If you enjoy working in an innovative technical environment, combining scientific understanding with hands-on engineering, we look forward to receiving your application.

Creating impact together at Bühler!
Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines.
Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries.
We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together. Aufgaben: • You develop and optimize ion beam sputtering processes for the deposition of optical thin-film systems • You are actively involved in the development, testing, and qualification of new components, process solutions, and system features • You coordinate and execute R&D projects in close collaboration with internal departments and external partners • You write development and application reports as well as scientific publications • You attend international conferences and technical events to follow the latest developments, present results, and build professional networks • You commission novel vacuum coating systems • You support our sales team and customers with technical expertise Anforderungen: • You have successfully completed a university degree e.g., in Physics, Applied Physics, Material Science, Physical Engineering, Optical Engineering, Electrical Engineering or a comparable field • Experience in process development, experimental work, data evaluation, or system commissioning • Ideally, you have experience with ion beam sputtering systems, vacuum coating technology, optical thin films, or optical interference filters • You have a good command of English, German skills are of advantage • You have a structured, reliable, and solution-oriented way of working • You are willing to travel internationally to visit customers, support system commissioning, and attend conferences Wir bieten: Modern workplace with best technical equipment Work in a modern workplace equipped with the latest technical tools to support your productivity and innovation. Cross-cultural working environment The key to our success is our diverse workforce from at least 100 nationalities as well as our inclusive culture. Career and personal development We deliver a broad spectrum of learning opportunities through videos, e-learnings, classroom trainings, and webinars that offer training in formats that are short, relevant, engaging, personalized, and mobile. Employee benefits and discounts Enjoy a variety of employee benefits and discounts designed to enhance your everyday life. Join our team and learn more. Canteen with healthy meal options Enjoy healthy meals in our canteen at fair prices! Team and social events Your engagement makes it possible for us. We want to celebrate this together with you. descriptionByLocale.it:
Come ingegnere R&D (m/f/d) Ion Beam Sputtering, contribuirete allo sviluppo delle nostre piattaforme di spruzzatura a fascio ionico LEYBOLD OPTICS IBS. In questo ruolo, svilupperete processi avanzati di rivestimento a film sottile e sosterrete la realizzazione di sistemi innovativi di rivestimento sotto vuoto per applicazioni ottiche esigenti. Se vi piace lavorare in un ambiente tecnico innovativo, combinando la comprensione scientifica con l'ingegneria pratica, non vediamo l'ora di ricevere la vostra applicazione.

Creare impatto insieme a Bühler! Due miliardi di persone mangiano cibo ogni giorno che è stato prodotto con le attrezzature Bühler. Un miliardo di persone guidano veicoli le cui parti sono state prodotte con le nostre macchine. Bühler mira a bilanciare l'umanità, la natura e l'economia in ogni decisione, mentre sviluppa soluzioni che sbloccano opportunità di business sostenibili nel settore alimentare, alimentare e della mobilità globale. Ci sforziamo di creare innovazioni per un mondo migliore, con una particolare attenzione a soluzioni sane, sicure e sostenibili.

Pertanto, collaboriamo con clienti, start-up, multinazionali e mondo accademico per accelerare l'impatto insieme.

Aufgaben:
• Sviluppate e ottimizzate i processi di sputtering dei raggi ionici per la deposizione di sistemi ottici a film sottile

• Siete attivamente coinvolti nello sviluppo, testing e qualificazione di nuovi componenti, soluzioni di processo e funzionalità di sistema

• Coordina ed esegue progetti di R&S in stretta collaborazione con i servizi interni e partner esterni

• Scrivete rapporti sullo sviluppo e sulle applicazioni nonché pubblicazioni scientifiche

• Partecipate a conferenze internazionali ed eventi tecnici per seguire gli ultimi sviluppi, i risultati attuali e costruire reti professionali

• Lei commissiona nuovi sistemi di rivestimento sottovuoto

• Supporti il nostro team di vendita e i clienti con esperienza tecnica

Anforderungen:
• Hai completato con successo un corso di laurea, ad esempio in Fisica, Fisica Applicata, Scienza dei Materiali, Ingegneria Fisica, Ingegneria Ottica, Ingegneria Elettrica o un campo comparabile

• Esperienza nello sviluppo di processi, lavoro sperimentale, valutazione dei dati o messa in servizio di sistemi

• Idealmente, avete esperienza con sistemi di sputtering a fascio ionico, tecnologia di rivestimento sotto vuoto, film sottili ottici, o filtri di interferenza ottica

• Hai un buon livello di conoscenza dell'inglese, le competenze tedesche sono di vantaggio

• Hai un modo strutturato, affidabile e orientato alla soluzione di lavoro

• Siete disposti a viaggiare a livello internazionale per visitare i clienti, supportare il sistema di messa in servizio e partecipare a conferenze

Wirbiet: Posto di lavoro moderno con migliori attrezzature tecniche Lavorare in un luogo di lavoro moderno dotato degli ultimi strumenti tecnici per supportare la produttività e l'innovazione.

Ambiente di lavoro interculturale La chiave del nostro successo è la nostra forza lavoro diversificata da almeno 100 nazionalità e la nostra cultura inclusiva.

Carriera e sviluppo personale Offriamo un ampio spettro di opportunità di apprendimento attraverso video, e-learning, corsi di formazione in aula, e noi bilgari che offriamo formazione in formati brevi, pertinenti, coinvolgenti, personalizzati e mobili.

Vantaggi e sconti per i dipendenti Goditi una varietà di benefici e sconti per i dipendenti progettati per migliorare la tua vita quotidiana. Unisciti al nostro team e scopri di più.

Mensa con opzioni di pasto sano Godetevi pasti sani nella nostra mensa a prezzi equi!

Team ed eventi sociali Il vostro impegno ci rende possibili. Vogliamo festeggiare insieme a voi. Le nostre feste, feste estive, eventi sportivi ed eventi di squadra offrono le migliori opportunità per farlo.

In dieser Funktion entwickeln Sie fortschrittliche Dünnschichtbeschichtungsverfahren und unterstützen die Realisierung innovativer Vakuumbeschichtungssysteme für anspruchsvolle optische Anwendungen. Wenn Sie gerne in einem innovativen technischen Umfeld arbeiten, das wissenschaftliche Verständnis mit dem Hands-on-Engineering verbindet, freuen wir uns auf Ihre Anwendung.

• Sie sind aktiv an der Entwicklung, Erprobung und Qualifizierung neuer Komponenten, Prozesslösungen und Systemfunktionen beteiligt

• Sie koordinieren und führen FuE-Projekte in enger Zusammenarbeit mit internen Abteilungen und externen Partnern durch

• Sie schreiben Entwicklungs- und Bewerbungsberichte sowie wissenschaftliche Publikationen

• Erfahrung in der Prozessentwicklung, experimentellen Arbeiten, Datenauswertung oder Systeminbetriebnahme

• Sie haben eine strukturierte, zuverlässige und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise

In questo ruolo, sviluppi processi avanzati di rivestimento a film sottile e supporti l'implementazione di sistemi innovativi di rivestimento sotto vuoto per applicazioni ottiche esigenti. descriptionByLocale.en:
As R&D Engineer (m/w/d) Ion Beam Sputtering, you contribute to the further development of our LEYBOLD OPTICS IBS ion beam sputter platforms. In this role, you develop advanced thin-film coating processes and support the implementation of innovative vacuum coating systems for demanding optical applications. If you like to work in an innovative technical environment and combine scientific understanding with practice-oriented engineering, we look forward to receiving your application.

Let us make a difference at Bühler! Two billion people eat food produced on Bühler plants every day. One billion people travel in vehicles whose parts have been produced by Bühler technology. With every decision, Bühler is pursuing the goal of reconciling the needs of business, people and nature. We are developing solutions that open up sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed and mobility industries.

We want to create innovations for a better world, with a particular focus on healthy, safe and sustainable solutions. That's why we work with customers, start-ups, multinational corporations and scientists to achieve a faster impact together.

Tasks:
• They develop and optimize ion beam sputtering processes for the deposition of optical thin film systems

• You are actively involved in the development, testing and qualification of new components, process solutions and system functions

• They coordinate and implement R&D projects in close cooperation with internal departments and external partners

• You write development and application reports as well as scientific publications

• You will participate in international conferences and events to follow the latest developments, present results and build professional networks

• They are commissioning new vacuum coating systems

• You support our sales team and our customers with technical expertise

Requirements:
• You have successfully completed a technical degree in physics, applied physics, material sciences, physics, optics, electrical engineering or a similar field of study

• You have experience in process development, experimental work, data evaluation or commissioning of systems

• Ideally, you have experience with ion beam sputtering systems, vacuum coating technology, optical thin films or optical interference filters

• You have good English skills; German skills are advantageous

• They are characterised by a structured, reliable and solution-oriented approach

• You are ready to travel internationally to visit customers, support system operations and participate in conferences

We offer: Modern workplace with the best technical equipment Work at a modern workplace equipped with the latest technical tools to promote your productivity and innovation.

Intercultural working environment The key to our success is our diverse workforce from more than 100 nations and our inclusive culture.

Professional and personal development We offer a wide range of learning opportunities, such as videos, online training, presence training and webinars with short, relevant, appealing, personalized and mobile formats.

Nous attendons avec impatience un membre de l'équipe dévoué (m/w/d) qui soutient activement notre équipe de service dans le service à la clientèle du secteur d'activité Grinding & Dispersing par l'initiative, la flexibilité et l'orientation client. Dans votre rôle de technicien de service (m/w/d) vous convainquez avec l'engagement et la force de communication et ne pas hésiter à de nouveaux défis.

Deux milliards de personnes mangent quotidiennement des aliments produits sur les usines de Bühler. Un milliard de personnes voyagent dans des véhicules dont les pièces ont été produites par la technologie Bühler. Avec chaque décision, Bühler poursuit l'objectif de concilier les besoins des entreprises, des personnes et de la nature. Nous développons des solutions qui ouvrent des opportunités commerciales durables dans les industries mondiales de l'alimentation, de l'alimentation animale et de la mobilité.

Nous voulons créer des innovations pour un monde meilleur, en mettant l'accent sur des solutions saines, sûres et durables. C'est pourquoi nous travaillons avec nos clients, les start-up, les multinationales et les scientifiques pour obtenir un impact plus rapide ensemble.

Tâches:
• Vous effectuez des travaux de mise en service et de service tels que des réparations, des modifications, des inspections, des réparations et de l'entretien de machines et systèmes individuels en Allemagne et à l'étranger

• Vous prenez en charge le support technique ou le support de notre clientèle mondiale par téléphone ou sur place et maintenez des contacts avec les clients

• Vous analysez et corrigez les erreurs/problèmes avec les départements concernés

• Vous formez les employés des clients pendant la période de service dans le domaine de l'opération de machine

• Vous travaillez sur la mise à jour du logiciel de la machine

• Vous avez suivi une formation professionnelle en tant qu'ingénieur méchatronique (m/w/d), mécanicien industriel (m/w/d), électricien (m/w/d) ou comparable, vous souhaitez poursuivre votre formation en tant que maître/technicien (m/w/d) ou un diplôme en génie électrique

• Vous avez une expérience professionnelle en ingénierie de machines et d'usines, idéalement dans le domaine de la dispersion et de la technologie de broyage humide

• Vous avez une connaissance du contrôle PLC (Siemens)

• Vous communiquez très bien en anglais

• Une approche indépendante et orientée vers le client et une volonté mondiale de voyager complètent votre profil

Nous offrons: Un lieu de travail moderne avec le meilleur équipement technique Travailler sur un lieu de travail moderne équipé des derniers outils techniques pour promouvoir votre productivité et votre innovation.

Environnement de travail interculturel La clé de notre succès est notre main-d'oeuvre diversifiée de plus de 100 pays et notre culture inclusive.

Développement professionnel et personnel Nous offrons une large gamme de possibilités d'apprentissage, comme des vidéos, des formations en ligne, des formations de présence et des webinaires avec des formats courts, pertinents, attrayants, personnalisés et mobiles.

Avantages et réductions pour les employés Profitez d'une variété d'avantages et de réductions pour les employés qui facilitent votre vie quotidienne.

Cantine avec des repas sains Profitez de repas sains dans notre cantine à des prix équitables.

Prestations de retraite ou de prestations professionnelles Profitez de notre prestation de retraite ou de prestations professionnelles – pour un avenir sûr!

C'est pourquoi nous travaillons avec nos clients, nos start-up, nos multinationales et nos scientifiques pour obtenir un impact plus rapide ensemble.

jobs.title: Customer Service Sales Manager
jobs.description:
Sales-driven Customer Service professional to grow Bühler's after-sales business in Thailand for Human and Animal Nutrition. This role will drive service sales, develop customer relationships, and convert opportunities into orders, working closely with the sales and service teams.

Aufgaben:
• Achieve sales targets (orders, revenue, margin, pipeline).

• Identify, develop, and close Customer Service opportunities.

• Grow service business across spare parts, service agreements, retrofits, upgrades, and field services.

• Build strong relationships with customers and understand their operational needs.

• Translate customer challenges (e.g., downtime, efficiency, quality, cost) into solutions.

• Manage sales pipeline, quotations, and forecasts using CRM tools.

• Drive recurring revenue through service contracts and long-term agreements.

• Collaborate with internal teams to deliver competitive proposals.

• Provide market insights on customer needs, competitors, and pricing.

Anforderungen:
• Degree/Diploma in Engineering, Business, or related field.

• Minimum 5 years of experience in service, aftermarket, or technical sales.

• Proven track record in sales and customer relationship management.

• Experience in machinery, spare parts, or industrial solutions preferred.

• Fluent in Thai and English.

• Familiarity with CRM and digital/AI sales tools is a plus.

• Knowledge of food/feed processing industries is an advantage.

Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines.
Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries.
We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

jobs.title: Project Manager (Engineering)
jobs.description:
Managing and leading the project team-including internal stakeholders, subcontractors, and consortium partners, as applicable-as well as coordinating with external interfaces for projects of up to high complexity.

Aufgaben:
• Manage and lead the project team to achieve and further improve the cost, schedule, quality and EHS targets

• Supervise the final negotiations for the allocated project and provides the execution strategy

• Ensures that the project schedule baseline is signed by the involved parties at the start of the project

• Perform proper risk and opportunity management

• Prepare and perform Project Reviews as requested, report according Bühler Project Management process

• Responsible for the site briefing meeting; Ensures that all site relevant documents are handed over to site personnel

• Ensure forecasting accuracy and monitor project KPIs including Schedule Performance Index (SPI) and Cost Performance Index (CPI), timely Turnover (TO) and manual TO Pulls if needed, to drive project success

Anforderungen:
• Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) in Engineering

• Minimum 4 years as Project Manager or proof of sufficient skills (full cycle project management)

• Plant Engineering experience preferred

• Preferably PMI/PMP Certification

• Strong planning, organizing and priority setting skills, with a proven ability to manage teams

• Ability to work in a matrix organization

• Strong problem-solving skills

• Strong teamwork and leadership skills

• Excellent written and oral communication skills, including the ability to interface effectively with people inside and outside of the company

personale - Assicurare l'accuratezza delle previsioni e monitorare i KPI del progetto, inclusi l'indice di prestazione di pianificazione (SPI) e l'indice di prestazione di costo (CPI), il fatturato tempestivo (TO) e il manuale da tirare se necessario, per guidare il successo del progetto

Bühler Leybold Optics is a wholly owned subsidiary of Bühler Leybold Optics in Beijing and is currently one of the two global manufacturing bases for high vacuum coating equipment of the Bühler Group. The business of Bühler Leybold Optics covers two major business fields: optics and large area coating, contributing to the development of the precision optics, optics, automotive, semiconductor, flexible electronics and architectural glass industries in China. Let us make a difference together at Bühler!
Two billion people eat food produced on Bühler plants every day. One billion people travel in vehicles whose parts were produced using Bühler technologies.
With every decision, Bühler pursues the goal of reconciling the needs of the economy, people and nature. In this way, we develop solutions that open up sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed and mobility industries.
We want to create innovations for a better world, with a particular focus on healthy, safe and sustainable solutions. This is why we work with customers, start-ups, multinational corporations and scientists to achieve a faster impact together. descriptionByLocale.en:
Bühler Leybold Optics stands for innovative technologies and steady growth. As part of the Bühler Group, a global engineering group with over 13,000 employees, we are one of the market leaders in the field of high-tech thin film vacuum coating systems. For more than 150 years, we have been offering our customers a wide range of systems for the coating of spectacle lenses, optical components in smartphones, cars, medical technology cameras, car head-up displays and much more.

Our international team manages to set new standards every day and successfully implement complex projects.

We are looking for a motivated student (m/w/d) who actively supports our mechanical construction in Alzenau. Our desired colleague (m/w/d) impresses with commitment and reliability and does not hesitate to take on tasks independently.

Let's make a difference at Bühler! Two billion people eat food produced on Bühler plants every day. One billion people travel in vehicles whose parts have been produced by Bühler technology. With every decision, Bühler aims to reconcile the needs of business, people and nature, and to develop solutions that open up sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed and mobility industries.

We want to create innovations for a better world, with a particular focus on healthy, safe and sustainable solutions. That's why we work with customers, start-ups, multinational corporations and scientists to achieve a faster impact together.

Tasks:
• You design and calculate relevant components for high-precision coating systems

• You will first and then pick 3D models and manufacturing drawings in CAD (preferably Solid Edge)

• You research components, get technical data and create your own ideas

• You actively support ongoing development and innovation projects – from the first sketch to prototype validation

• You are an integral part of the team and join the Daily Business

Requirements:
• Studies in mechanical engineering, mechatronics, production technology or comparable (requiring enrollment)

• First practical CAD experience (ideally Solid Edge, but also Inventory, Creo, CatIA & Co. are welcome)

• Enthusiasm for high-tech, precision machine construction and innovative technologies

• Structured, independent and careful working methods

• Good communication skills and real team player mentality

We offer: Team events and events Your commitment makes it possible for us. We want to celebrate this together with you. Our Christmas parties, summer parties, sports events and team events offer the best opportunities.

Professional and personal development We offer a wide range of learning opportunities, such as videos, online training, presence training and webinars with short, relevant, appealing, personalized and mobile formats.

Family Corporate Culture We have a more than 160-year history. This makes us a company that thinks and invests in the long term - in innovations, our employees and economic success.

Intercultural working environment The key to our success is our diverse workforce from more than 100 nations and our inclusive culture.

Canteen with healthy meals Enjoy healthy meals in our canteen at fair prices.

Learning Platform Welcome to a world of over 16,000 opportunities to train!

Two billion people eat food produced on Bühler plants every day. One billion people travel in vehicles whose parts have been produced by Bühler technology. With every decision, Bühler aims to bring the needs of business, people and nature into line. We develop solutions that open up sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed and mobility industries. We want to create innovations for a better world, with a particular focus on healthy, safe and sustainable solutions.

That is why we work with customers, start-ups, multinational corporations and scientists to achieve a faster impact together.

jobs.title: Electro Mechanical Technician
jobs.description:
Maintain, troubleshoot, repair, and keep records on production equipment, vehicles, HVAC, building and grounds and security system. See day to day functionality of manufacturing equipment and make/oversee repairs as needed.

Aufgaben:
• Performs trouble-shooting and diagnostic tests on all types of production equipment Investigates and executes economic repair options on production equipment

• Executes preventative maintenance program

• Maintains inventory of maintenance spare parts

• Assists in the installation of new equipment, and relocation of existing equipment Performs maintenance on buildings, grounds and facility infrastructure

• Coordinates with outside resources for delivery of repair goods and services

• Maintains the highest quality of workmanship

• Requires minimal supervision

• Accepts/performs other responsibilities/duties as assigned by immediate supervisor

• Complete tasks and operate equipment in a safe manner

• Work at an acceptable and communicated level of productivity

Anforderungen:
Job Specifications:
 (Desired education and experience)

• Vocational training in blue print reading, basic machining and basic quality control

• Strong electrical / mechanical troubleshooting skills

• Minimum five years in the industrial maintenance field

• Minimum two years vocational training

• Must have a current North Carolina driver's license

• Basic computer skills and knowledge of Word and Excel software

• Must be able to wear safety equipment(hard hat, safety shoes, safety glasses)

• Ability to work overtime when needed

TECHNICAL SKILLS

• Electrical

• Plumbing

• Hydraulics

• Carpentry

• Machine Shop

• Welding

• Troubleshooting electronic machine controls.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities
 Mechanical -- Knowledge of machines and tools, including their designs, uses, repair, and maintenance. Knowledge of electrical, hydraulics, control systems and HVAC systems.
 Design -- Knowledge of design techniques, tools, and principles involved in production of precision technical plans, blueprints, drawings, and models.
 Building and Construction -- Knowledge of materials, methods, and the tools involved in basic carpentry and construction.
 Engineering and Technology -- Knowledge of the practical application of engineering science and technology. This includes applying principles, techniques, procedures, and equipment to the design and production of various goods and services.
 Production and Processing -- Knowledge of raw materials, production processes, quality control , costs, and other techniques for maximizing the effective manufacture and distribution of goods.

Titolo di lavoro Manutenzione TechNICan

Descrizione Mantenere, risolvere i problemi, riparare e tenere registrazioni su attrezzature di produzione, veicoli, HVAC, edifici e terreni, e sistemi di sicurezza. Assicurare la funzionalità quotidiana di attrezzature di produzione e fare / sopravedere le riparazioni, se necessario.

Responsabilità - Esegue test diagnostici e di ricerca di guasti su tutti i tipi di attrezzature di produzione - Indaga ed esegue opzioni di riparazione economica sulle attrezzature di produzione - Esegui programma di manutenzione preventiva - Mantiene l'inventario dei pezzi di ricambio di manutenzione - Assiste nell'installazione di nuove attrezzature e delocalizzazione di attrezzature esistenti - Esegue la manutenzione su edifici, terreni e infrastrutture impianti - Coordina con risorse esterne per la fornitura di beni e servizi di riparazione - Mantiene la massima qualità di lavorazione - Richiede una supervisione minima -

Accetta/performa altre responsabilità/disposizioni assegnate da un supervisore immediato - Completa le attività e gestisce le apparecchiature in modo sicuro - Lavora a un livello di produttività accettabile e comunicato

Requisiti Specifiche di lavoro - Formazione professionale in lettura di progetti, lavorazione di base e controllo di qualità di base - Forte capacità di risoluzione dei problemi elettrici/meccanici - Minimo cinque anni nel campo della manutenzione industriale - Minimo due anni di formazione professionale - Deve avere una patente di guida in Nord Carolina - Competenze informatiche di base e conoscenze del software Word ed Excel - Deve essere in grado di indossare attrezzature di sicurezza (hard hat, scarpe di sicurezza, occhiali di sicurezza) - Capacità di lavorare straordinario quando necessario

Capacità tecniche - Elettrico - Idraulica - Idraulica - Carpenteria - Macchine - Saldatura - Controllo elettronico delle macchine

Conoscenza, competenze e capacità - Meccanica: Conoscenza delle macchine e degli utensili, compresi i loro disegni, usi, riparazioni e manutenzione. TECHNICAL SKILLS

• Electrical

We want to create innovations for a better world, with a particular focus on healthy, safe and sustainable solutions. That's why we work with customers, start-ups, multinational corporations and scientists to achieve a faster impact together.

• Further development and implementation of a sustainable HR strategy in line with corporate goals and in coordination with the global Headquarter.

• Management, development and operational support of HR teams.

• Control and optimization of the activities in talent, performance & concentration management.

• Support and coaching of managers and employees in change processes and moderation of internal workshops.

• Ensure compliance with labour law and contact persons for works councils.

• Further development of a sustainable, modern employee branding and recruiting strategy.

Requirements:
• Many years of experience as head of HR, or in a comparable management position with experience/understanding for corporate structures.

• Completed training (university or FH) preferably with a focus on human capital.

• Experience in the control and monitoring of change processes and HR projects.

• Very good knowledge of Austrian labour and social law.

• Structured, decision-making and implementation-strong working methods, coupled with a professional, winning attitude.

• Communication, moderation and consulting pleasure on an equal footing in German and English.

• Optimistic attitude, strategic thinking, pragmatic mindset

Dans ce poste, vous assumez la responsabilité globale des RH pour les sites Bühler en Autriche, en Allemagne, au Danemark et aux Pays-Bas.

Faisons la différence chez Bühler! Deux milliards de personnes mangent quotidiennement des aliments produits sur les usines de Bühler. Un milliard de personnes voyagent dans des véhicules dont les pièces ont été produites par la technologie Bühler. Avec chaque décision, Bühler vise à concilier les besoins des entreprises, des personnes et de la nature, et à développer des solutions qui ouvrent des opportunités commerciales durables dans les industries mondiales de l'alimentation humaine, de l'alimentation animale et de la mobilité.

Nous voulons créer des innovations pour un monde meilleur, en mettant l'accent sur des solutions saines, sûres et durables. C'est pourquoi nous travaillons avec nos clients, les start-up, les multinationales et les scientifiques pour obtenir un impact plus rapide ensemble.

Tâches:
• Partenaire stratégique de gestion et de direction aux niveaux national et international (AT, DE, NL, DK) dans tous les domaines pertinents des RH.

• Poursuite de l'élaboration et de la mise en œuvre d'une stratégie durable en matière de ressources humaines, conformément aux objectifs de l'organisation et en coordination avec le Siège mondial.

• Gestion, développement et appui opérationnel des équipes de RH.

• Contrôle et optimisation des activités dans la gestion des talents, des performances et des concentrations.

• Soutien et encadrement des gestionnaires et des employés dans les processus de changement et modération des ateliers internes.

• Assurer le respect du droit du travail et contacter les personnes chargées des conseils d'entreprise.

• Poursuite de l'élaboration d'une stratégie de recrutement et d'image de marque durable et moderne des employés.

Exigences:
• De nombreuses années d'expérience en tant que chef de RH ou dans un poste de gestion comparable avec expérience/compréhension pour les structures organisationnelles.

• Formation complète (universitaire ou FH) de préférence axée sur le capital humain.

• Expérience dans le contrôle et le suivi des processus de changement et des projets de RH.

• Très bonne connaissance du droit du travail et du droit social autrichiens.

• Des méthodes de travail structurées, décisionnelles et performantes, associées à une attitude professionnelle et gagnante.

• Communication, modération et consultation du plaisir sur un pied d'égalité en allemand et en anglais.

jobs.description:
Bühler Leybold Optics steht für innovative Technologien, Präzision und nachhaltiges Wachstum. Als Teil der international erfolgreichen Bühler Group mit über 13.000 Mitarbeitenden weltweit gehören wir zu den Marktführern im Bereich Hightech-Dünnfilm-Vakuumbeschichtungsanlagen.

Als Entwicklungsingenieur (m/w/d) werden Sie Teil eines interdisziplinären Teams, das technische Herausforderungen mit Kreativität und Innovationsfreude löst. Sie arbeiten an Schlüsselkomponenten für High-End-Anlagen und begleiten Entwicklungen von der Idee bis zur Serienreife.

Wenn Sie Freude daran haben, komplexe technische Lösungen zu entwickeln und in einem dynamischen Umfeld mitzugestalten, freuen wir uns darauf, Sie kennenzulernen.

Lassen Sie uns bei Bühler gemeinsam etwas bewirken!

descriptionByLocale.it:
Bühler Leybold Optics è sinonimo di tecnologie innovative, precisione e crescita sostenibile. Nell'ambito del Gruppo Bühler di successo internazionale con oltre 13.000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo, siamo uno dei leader di mercato nel campo dei sistemi di rivestimento a vuoto a film sottile ad alta tecnologia.

Il nostro centro competenze Leipzig è specializzato nella lucidatura superficiale ad alta precisione utilizzando processi di lavorazione di fasci ionici e plasma nell'area sub-nanometro. Sviluppiamo anche sistemi di misurazione ottici e implementare soluzioni sofisticate di automazione e robot.

Come ingegnere di sviluppo (m/f/d) si entra a far parte di un team interdisciplinare che risolve le sfide tecniche con creatività e innovazione. Lavorano su componenti chiave per sistemi di fascia alta e accompagnano gli sviluppi dall'idea alla produzione in serie.

Se vi piace sviluppare soluzioni tecniche complesse e contribuire a modellarle in un ambiente dinamico, non vediamo l'ora di incontrarvi.

A Bühler facciamo la differenza: ogni giorno due miliardi di persone mangiano cibo prodotto sulle piante di Bühler; un miliardo di persone viaggiano in veicoli le cui parti sono state prodotte dalla tecnologia di Bühler. Ad ogni decisione, Bühler punta a conciliare le esigenze delle imprese, delle persone e della natura, e a sviluppare soluzioni che aprono opportunità commerciali sostenibili nell'industria alimentare, dei mangimi e della mobilità globale.

Vogliamo creare innovazioni per un mondo migliore, con particolare attenzione alle soluzioni sane, sicure e sostenibili. Ecco perché lavoriamo con clienti, start-up, multinazionali e scienziati per ottenere un impatto più rapido insieme.

Compiti: In questa posizione di Veraille, si assume la responsabilità dello sviluppo di soluzioni tecniche sofisticate e si lavora a stretto contatto con partner interni ed esterni.

I loro compiti comprendono in particolare:

• Sviluppo di concetti e soluzioni tecniche per il nuovo e ulteriore sviluppo di componenti chiave dei nostri sistemi di fascia alta

• Monitoraggio dell'attuazione dei progetti di sviluppo per i prodotti della produzione-ready

• Preparazione e manutenzione della documentazione tecnica, anche in ambito di progettazione meccanica, progettazione schema e routing circuiti

• Pianificazione, implementazione e valutazione dei test di laboratorio per verificare i nuovi sviluppi

• Close cooperation and technical coordinateon with internal reparties and external customers

• Supporto per il montaggio, l'integrazione e la messa in servizio di sistemi di misurazione ad alta precisione

• Selezione dei componenti adatti, comunicazione e coordinamento con i fornitori

• Collaborazione attiva in un team interfunzionale con ampio spazio per idee proprie e progettazione tecnica

Requisiti: Per questa posizione cerchiamo una personalità tecnicamente entusiasta che ami lavorare orientata alla soluzione e che si diverta con impegnativi compiti di sviluppo.

Porta con te:

• Studi realizzati con successo nei settori della meccatronica, laser e optotecnologia, ingegneria meccanica, ingegneria elettrica o una qualifica analoga

• Gestione sicura delle schede tecniche, delle specifiche e della documentazione

• Conoscenza iniziale dello sviluppo dell'elettronica, ad esempio con Autodesk Eagle, e progettazione meccanica, ad esempio con Solid Edge

• Le competenze di programmazione in C++ o Python sono vantaggiose

• Buona conoscenza del tedesco e dell'inglese in termini di parole e scrittura

• Metodi di lavoro strutturati, responsabili e indipendenti

• Spirito di squadra, forza comunicativa e gioia nello sviluppo di soluzioni innovative insieme

Offriamo: Collegamenti pubblici e privati La nostra posizione offre ottimi collegamenti con i mezzi pubblici e comodi posti auto che rendono più facile per voi di pendolare ogni giorno.

Eventi di gruppo Il vostro impegno ci rende possibili. Vogliamo festeggiare insieme a voi. Le nostre feste di Natale, le feste estive, gli eventi sportivi e gli eventi di squadra offrono le migliori opportunità.

Family Corporate Culture Abbiamo una storia di oltre 160 anni. Questo ci rende un'azienda che pensa e investe a lungo termine - nelle innovazioni, nei nostri dipendenti e nel successo economico.

Vantaggi e sconti per i dipendenti Goditi una varietà di benefici e sconti per i dipendenti che rendono la tua vita quotidiana più facile.

Ambiente di lavoro interculturale La chiave del nostro successo è la nostra forza lavoro diversificata da più di 100 nazioni e la nostra cultura inclusiva.

Sviluppo professionale e personale Offriamo un'ampia gamma di opportunità di apprendimento, come video, formazione online, formazione di presenza e noi blindati con formati brevi, pertinenti, accattivanti, personalizzati e mobili.

Due miliardi di persone mangiano cibo prodotto ogni giorno nelle piante di Bühler. Un miliardo di persone viaggia in veicoli le cui parti sono state prodotte dalla tecnologia di Bühler. Con ogni decisione, Bühler punta a allineare le esigenze di business, persone e natura. Sviluppiamo soluzioni che aprono opportunità di business sostenibili nell'industria alimentare, dei mangimi e della mobilità globale. Vogliamo creare innovazioni per un mondo migliore, con particolare attenzione alle soluzioni sane, sicure e sostenibili.

Per questo motivo lavoriamo con clienti, start-up, multinazionali e scienziati per ottenere un impatto più rapido insieme.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Bühler Leybold Optics stands for innovative technologies, precision and sustainable growth. As part of the internationally successful Bühler Group with over 13,000 employees worldwide, we are one of the market leaders in the field of high-tech thin film vacuum coating systems.

Our Competence Center Leipzig specializes in high-precision surface polishing using ion beam and plasma processing processes in the sub-nanometer area. We also develop optical measurement systems and implement sophisticated automation and robot solutions.

As a development engineer (m/f/d) you become part of an interdisciplinary team that solves technical challenges with creativity and innovation. They work on key components for high-end systems and accompany developments from the idea to series production.

If you enjoy developing complex technical solutions and helping to shape them in a dynamic environment, we look forward to meeting you.

Let us make a difference at Bühler! Two billion people eat food produced on Bühler plants every day. One billion people travel in vehicles whose parts have been produced by Bühler technology. With every decision, Bühler aims to reconcile the needs of business, people and nature, and to develop solutions that open up sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed and mobility industries.

We want to create innovations for a better world, with a particular focus on healthy, safe and sustainable solutions. That's why we work with customers, start-ups, multinational corporations and scientists to achieve a faster impact together.

Tasks: In this versatile position, you take responsibility for the development of sophisticated technical solutions and work closely with internal and external partners.

Their tasks include in particular:

• Development of concepts and technical solutions for the new and further development of key components of our high-end systems

• Monitoring the implementation of development projects to production-ready products

• Preparation and maintenance of technical documentation, including in the areas of mechanical design, circuit diagram design and circuit board routing

• Planning, implementation and evaluation of laboratory tests for verifying new developments

• Close cooperation and technical coordination with internal departments and external customers

• Support for assembly, integration and commissioning of high-precision measuring systems

• Selection of suitable components as well as communication and coordination with suppliers

• Active cooperation in a cross-functional team with plenty of room for own ideas and technical design

Requirements: For this position we are looking for a technically enthusiastic personality who likes to work solution-oriented and enjoys demanding development tasks.

You bring with you:

• Successfully completed studies in the fields of mechatronics, laser and optotechnology, mechanical engineering, electrical engineering or a comparable qualification

• Safe handling of technical data sheets, specifications and documentation

• Initial knowledge of electronics development, for example with Autodesk Eagle, and mechanical design, for example with Solid Edge

• Programming skills in C++ or Python are advantageous

• Good knowledge of German and English in word and writing

• Structured, responsible and independent working methods

• Team spirit, communication strength and joy in developing innovative solutions together

We offer: Public and private connections Our location offers excellent connections to public transport and convenient parking spaces that make it easier for you to commute daily.

Team events and events Your commitment makes it possible for us. We want to celebrate this together with you. Our Christmas parties, summer parties, sports events and team events offer the best opportunities.

Family Corporate Culture We have a more than 160-year history. This makes us a company that thinks and invests in the long term - in innovations, our employees and economic success.

Employee benefits and discounts Enjoy a variety of employee benefits and discounts that make your everyday life easier. Become part of our team and learn more.

Intercultural working environment The key to our success is our diverse workforce from more than 100 nations and our inclusive culture.

Professional and personal development We offer a wide range of learning opportunities, such as videos, online training, presence training and webinars with short, relevant, appealing, personalized and mobile formats.

Two billion people eat food produced on Bühler plants every day. One billion people travel in vehicles whose parts have been produced by Bühler technology. With every decision, Bühler aims to bring the needs of business, people and nature into line. We develop solutions that open up sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed and mobility industries. We want to create innovations for a better world, with a particular focus on healthy, safe and sustainable solutions.

That is why we work with customers, start-ups, multinational corporations and scientists to achieve a faster impact together.
