En tant qu'ingénieur en développement (m/f/d), vous faites partie d'une équipe interdisciplinaire qui résout les défis techniques avec créativité et innovation. Ils travaillent sur des composants clés pour les systèmes haut de gamme et accompagnent les développements de l'idée à la production en série.

Si vous aimez développer des solutions techniques complexes et les aider à les façonner dans un environnement dynamique, nous sommes impatients de vous rencontrer.

Faisons la différence chez Bühler! Deux milliards de personnes mangent quotidiennement des aliments produits sur les usines de Bühler. Un milliard de personnes voyagent dans des véhicules dont les pièces ont été produites par la technologie Bühler. Avec chaque décision, Bühler vise à concilier les besoins des entreprises, des personnes et de la nature, et à développer des solutions qui ouvrent des opportunités commerciales durables dans les industries mondiales de l'alimentation humaine, de l'alimentation animale et de la mobilité.

Nous voulons créer des innovations pour un monde meilleur, en mettant l'accent sur des solutions saines, sûres et durables. C'est pourquoi nous travaillons avec nos clients, les start-up, les multinationales et les scientifiques pour obtenir un impact plus rapide ensemble.

Tâches : Dans cette position polyvalente, vous prenez la responsabilité du développement de solutions techniques sophistiquées et travaillez en étroite collaboration avec des partenaires internes et externes.

Leurs tâches comprennent notamment:

• Développement de concepts et de solutions techniques pour le développement nouveau et ultérieur des composants clés de nos systèmes haut de gamme

• Suivi de la mise en œuvre des projets de développement pour les produits prêts à la production

• Préparation et maintenance de la documentation technique, y compris dans les domaines de la conception mécanique, de la conception des schémas de circuits et de l'acheminement des circuits

• Planification, mise en œuvre et évaluation des essais en laboratoire pour vérifier les nouveaux développements

• Coopération étroite et coordination technique avec les services internes et les clients externes

• Support pour l'assemblage, l'intégration et la mise en service de systèmes de mesure de haute précision

• Sélection de composants appropriés ainsi que communication et coordination avec les fournisseurs

• Coopération active dans une équipe interfonctionnelle avec beaucoup de place pour ses idées et son design technique

Exigences : Pour cette position, nous recherchons une personnalité techniquement enthousiaste qui aime travailler en fonction de la solution et qui aime les tâches de développement exigeantes.

Tu amènes avec toi :

• Études réussies dans les domaines de la méchatronics, du laser et de l'optotechnologie, de la mécanique, de l'électrotechnique ou d'une qualification comparable

• Traitement sûr des fiches techniques, spécifications et documentation

• Connaissance initiale du développement électronique, par exemple avec Autodesk Eagle, et conception mécanique, par exemple avec Solid Edge

• Les compétences en programmation en C++ ou Python sont avantageuses

• Bonne connaissance de l'allemand et de l'anglais en paroles et en écriture

• Méthodes de travail structurées, responsables et indépendantes

• Esprit d'équipe, force de communication et joie dans le développement de solutions innovantes ensemble

Nous offrons: Les connexions publiques et privées Notre emplacement offre d'excellentes connexions aux transports en commun et des places de stationnement pratiques qui vous facilitent la circulation quotidienne.

Événements et événements d'équipe Votre engagement nous permet de célébrer cela ensemble avec vous. Nos fêtes de Noël, les fêtes d'été, les événements sportifs et les événements d'équipe offrent les meilleures opportunités.

Culture d'entreprise familiale Nous avons plus de 160 ans d'histoire. Cela fait de nous une entreprise qui réfléchit et investit à long terme - dans les innovations, nos employés et la réussite économique.

Avantages et réductions pour les employés Profitez d'une variété d'avantages et de réductions pour les employés qui facilitent votre vie quotidienne.

Environnement de travail interculturel La clé de notre succès est notre main-d'oeuvre diversifiée de plus de 100 pays et notre culture inclusive.

Développement professionnel et personnel Nous offrons une large gamme de possibilités d'apprentissage, comme des vidéos, des formations en ligne, des formations de présence et des webinaires avec des formats courts, pertinents, attrayants, personnalisés et mobiles.

Chaque jour, deux milliards de personnes consomment des aliments produits sur les usines de Bühler. Un milliard de personnes voyagent dans des véhicules dont les pièces ont été produites par la technologie Bühler. Avec chaque décision, Bühler vise à mettre en ligne les besoins des entreprises, des personnes et de la nature. Nous développons des solutions qui ouvrent des opportunités d'affaires durables dans les industries mondiales de l'alimentation humaine, de l'alimentation animale et de la mobilité.

C'est pourquoi nous travaillons avec nos clients, nos start-up, nos multinationales et nos scientifiques pour obtenir un impact plus rapide ensemble.

jobs.title: Automation Quotation Engineer
jobs.description:
Responsible for producing quotation documents with internal tools, consisting of pricing, concept drawing, presentation material, and other supporting sales process. Provide technical leadership and direction for projects in the quotation phase. In charge to deliver the required quotation services within the given time and required quality, while ensuring compliance with Bühler related directives and EHS standards.

Aufgaben:
• Responsible for preparing automation quotations using Bühler internal tools, standards and quotation processes.

• Clarifies automation requirements with internal project sales teams and, where required, directly with customers.

• Performs technical and commercial analysis of customer requirements in close alignment with the Sales Manager.

• Develops project-specific plant automation concepts based on customer requirements, project scope, technical feasibility and Bühler solution standards.

• Collaborates with Sales, Technology, Engineering, Commercial Services, Mechanical Engineers and Automation Specialists to develop competitive and high-quality quotations.

• Ensures technical and commercial ownership of assigned quotations, including scope, assumptions, risks, exclusions and deliverables.

• Provides timely responses to internal technical questions and supports clarification of technical issues during the quotation phase.

• Proactively follows up on submitted quotation documents with internal stakeholders or customers to support the sales process.

Anforderungen:
• Bachelor's degree in Automation Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Industrial Engineering or any related Engineering degree

• Minimum of 2–3 years of experience in an engineering role, preferably in quotation, project, or technical sales engineering

• Experience in Industrial Automation

• Demonstrated ability to manage technical and commercial aspects of quotations

• Experience in layout preparation, technical concept development, and customer-facing discussions

• Proficiency in the English language

Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines.
Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries.
We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Designazione delle merci

Responsabile della produzione di documenti di quotazione con strumenti interni, costituiti da prezzi, disegno di concetto, materiale di presentazione e altro processo di vendita di supporto. Fornire la leadership tecnica e la direzione per i progetti in fase di quotazione. Responsabile di fornire i servizi di quotazione richiesti entro il tempo e la qualità richiesti, garantendo al contempo il rispetto delle direttive relative a Bühler e standard EHS.

Aufgaben

- Responsabile della preparazione delle quotazioni di automazione utilizzando strumenti interni, standard e processi di quotazione Bühler. - Chiarisce i requisiti di automazione con i team di vendita interni e, ove necessario, direttamente con i clienti. - Esegue analisi tecniche e commerciali delle esigenze dei clienti in stretto allineamento con il Sales Manager. - Sviluppa concetti di automazione impiantistica specifici per progetto basati sulle esigenze dei clienti, la portata del progetto, la fattibilità tecnica e gli standard di soluzioni Bühler.

- Di conseguenza, la proprietà tecnica e commerciale delle quotazioni assegnate, compresi la portata, le ipotesi, i rischi, le esclusioni e i risultati. - Fornisce risposte tempestive alle domande tecniche interne e fornisce chiarimenti sulle questioni tecniche durante la fase di quotazione. - Seguirà proattivamente i documenti di quotazione presentati con stakeholder interni o clienti per supportare il processo di vendita.

Anfonderungen

- Laurea in Ingegneria Automatica, Ingegneria Elettrica, Meccatronica, Ingegneria Industriale o qualsiasi altro titolo di Ingegneria - Minimo 2,3 anni di esperienza in ingegneria, preferibilmente in termini di preventivo, progetto o ingegneria tecnica di vendita - Esperienza in Automazione Industriale - Capacità dimostrativa di gestire aspetti tecnici e commerciali delle citazioni - Esperienza nella preparazione del layout, sviluppo di concetti tecnici e discussioni rivolte al cliente - Proficienza nella lingua inglese

Riguardo Bühler

Due miliardi di persone mangiano cibo ogni giorno che è stato prodotto con le attrezzature Bühler. Un miliardo di persone guidano veicoli le cui parti sono state prodotte con le nostre macchine. Bühler mira a bilanciare l'umanità, la natura e l'economia in ogni decisione, in quanto sviluppa soluzioni che sbloccano opportunità di business sostenibili nel settore alimentare, alimentare e della mobilità globale. Ci sforziamo di creare innovazioni per un mondo migliore, con una particolare attenzione alle soluzioni sane, sicure e sostenibili. Pertanto, collaboriamo con clienti, start-up, multinazionali e mondo accademico per accelerare l'impatto insieme.

Warenbezeichnung

Verantwortlich für die Erstellung von Angebotsdokumenten mit internen Tools, bestehend aus Preisgestaltung, Konzeptzeichnung, Präsentationsmaterial und anderen unterstützenden Verkaufsprozessen. Geben Sie technische Führung und Leitung für Projekte in der Angebotsphase. Verantwortlich für die Lieferung der erforderlichen Angebotsdienstleistungen innerhalb der vorgegebenen Zeit und der erforderlichen Qualität, wobei die Einhaltung der Bühler-Richtlinien und EHS-Standards gewährleistet wird.

ZIE

- Verantwortlich für die Erstellung von Automatisierungsangeboten mit Hilfe von Bühler internen Tools, Standards und Angebotsprozessen. - Präzisierung der Automatisierungsanforderungen mit internen Projektvertriebsteams und, falls erforderlich, direkt mit Kunden. - Führt technische und kommerzielle Analyse der Kundenanforderungen in enger Abstimmung mit dem Sales Manager durch. - Entwickelt projektspezifische Anlagenautomationskonzepte auf Basis von Kundenanforderungen, Projektumfang, technischer Machbarkeit und Bühler Lösungsstandards.

- Zusammenarbeit mit Vertriebs-, Technologie-, Engineering-, Handels-Services, Maschinenbauingenieure und Automatisierungsspezialisten, um wettbewerbsfähige und qualitativ hochwertige Angebote zu entwickeln. - Gewährleistung der technischen und kommerziellen Eigentümer von zugeteilten Angeboten, einschließlich Umfang, Annahmen, Risiken, Ausschlüsse und Liefermaterialien. - Bietet zeitnahe Antworten auf interne technische Fragen und unterstützt die Klärung technischer Fragen während der Angebotsphase. - Proaktiv folgt auf eingereichte Angebotsdokumente mit internen Stakeholdern oder Kunden, um den Verkaufsprozess zu unterstützen.

Milch

- Bachelor in Automation Engineering, Elektrotechnik, Mechatronik, Industrieingenieurwesen oder verwandten Ingenieurwesen - Mindeststudienzeit von 2-3 Jahren in einer technischen Funktion, vorzugsweise in der Angebots-, Projekt- oder technischen Vertriebstechnik - Erfahrung in der industriellen Automatisierung - Nachweis der Fähigkeit, technische und kommerzielle Aspekte der Angebots- und Angebotsgestaltung zu verwalten - Erfahrung in der Layout-Vorbereitung, technischen Konzeptentwicklung und kundennahen Diskussionen - Kompetenz in der englischen Sprache

Zwei Milliarden Menschen essen täglich Lebensmittel, die mit Bühler-Geräten hergestellt wurden. Eine Milliarde Menschen fahren Fahrzeuge, deren Teile mit unseren Maschinen hergestellt wurden. Wir streben Innovationen für eine bessere Welt an, mit einem besonderen Fokus auf gesunde, sichere und nachhaltige Lösungen. Daher arbeiten wir mit Kunden, Start-ups, multinationalen Unternehmen und Hochschulen zusammen, um gemeinsam die Wirkung zu beschleunigen.

Les États-Unis

jobs.title: Legal Counsel
jobs.description:
To strengthen our Legal Services team at our headquarters in Uzwil, we are looking for a motivated and business-minded Legal Counsel who combines strong legal expertise with a pragmatic, solution-oriented approach. In this role, you will work closely with colleagues across our global organization, advising on a wide range of legal matters and supporting the business in achieving its goals in a compliant and commercially sound way.

Aufgaben:
• You advise internal stakeholders on a broad range of legal matters, with a focus on commercial contracts, IT law, and corporate governance

• You draft, review, and negotiate a variety of agreements, including customer, supplier, and IT-related contracts (software, cloud, SaaS)

• You develop and enhance contract templates, policies, and legal standards, while supporting the continuous improvement of legal processes and tools

• You identify legal risks, monitor regulatory developments, and translate them into practical, business-oriented guidance

• You collaborate cross-functionally and support governance matters, ensuring effective communication with stakeholders at all levels

Anforderungen:
• Swiss law degree and admission to the bar in Switzerland, combined with several years of relevant professional experience in a law firm or in-house environment, ideally in an international, industrial or technology-driven setting

• Strong expertise in contract law, IT law, and corporate governance, with proven experience in drafting and negotiating commercial and IT-related agreements

• Independent, structured working style paired with strong teamwork skills, business acumen, and a pragmatic, solution-oriented mindset

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, along with a high level of integrity, reliability, and sound judgment

• Fluency in German and English; strong interest in digitalization, legal technology, and continuous improvement, combined with curiosity and a willingness to learn

Wir bieten:
Attractive vacation entitlement
Enough time for relaxation and personal interests - we offer from 25 to 30 days of vacation per year depending on age.

Attractive mobility concept
We offer an OSTWIND ZVV / Z-Pass + half-fare travelcard for CHF 365 + CHF 400 public transport credit as well as an attractive first-class travelcard or free parking.

VIVA Restaurant
We offer our employees a daily fitness menu from 9, 00 CHF.

Employer-funded pension plan
The Bühler Pension Fund offers Bühler employees an independent pension fund that ensures reliable financial security in retirement: www.pk-buhler.ch

Health-Port
We are committed to preventive health care through laboratory analyses, massages, nutritional advice, physiotherapy, group courses and a company doctor.

Sports activities
We promote physical activity through self-organized circuit training and running groups as well as vouchers for Update and Activ Fitness.

Colors are your thing and you want to see how technology and design come together? Then the apprenticeship as an industrial painter: in EFZ at Bühler is exactly the right thing for you!


Apply now with your complete application documents (motivation letter, CV, certificates) and start your future with us! Tasks: • You clean and cover components professionally for further processing • You base and paint surfaces precisely according to specifications • You perform powder coatings • You control and process surfaces and ensure impeccable quality • You mount control signs and provide materials for delivery Requirements • Awareness of Colors • Craftsmanship and practical understanding • Precise operation • Reliability and responsibility • Teamwork We offer: Attractive holiday entitlement Sufficient time for recreation and personal interests - we offer from 25 to 30 days of holidays per year depending on the year of life. Attractive mobility concept We offer an OSTWIND ZVV / Z-Pass + Half-Tax for 365 CHF + 400CHF public transport credit as well as an attractive first-class subscription or free parking. Staff restaurant VIVA We offer our employees a daily fitness menu from 9.00 CHF. Mobile subscriptions We offer special conditions for mobile subscriptions via Mobilezone at Sunrise and Swisscom. Health port We are committed to health prevention through laboratory analyses, massages, nutritional advice, physiotherapy, group courses and a company doctor. Sports activities We promote sport through self-organized circuit training and running groups as well as vouchers for update and active fitness. Two billion people eat food produced at Bühler plants every day. One billion people travel in vehicles whose parts were produced using Bühler technologies. With every decision, Bühler pursues the goal of reconciling the needs of the economy, people and nature. In this way, we develop solutions that open up sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed and mobility industries. We want to innovate for a better world, with a particular focus on healthy, safe and sustainable solutions. This is why we work with customers, start-ups, multinational corporations and scientists to achieve a faster impact together.

You want to understand how IT systems work, run smoothly in the background and are protected from hacker attacks? Then the apprenticeship as a computer scientist: in platform development EFZ at Bühler is exactly the right thing for you!


Apply now with your complete application documents (motivation letter, CV, certificates and) and start your future with us! Tasks: • You build computer systems and ensure their smooth operation • You operate and maintain networks and ensure their availability and security • You provide hardware and software support for internal users • You work with different operating systems and technologies • You support international employees and work on exciting IT and automation projects Requirements • Logical and Abstract Thinking • Strong in Mathematics, Physics and English • Technical understanding • Patient and goal-oriented work • Reliability and responsibility We offer: Attractive holiday entitlement Sufficient time for recreation and personal interests - we offer from 25 to 30 days of holidays per year depending on the year of life. Attractive mobility concept We offer an OSTWIND ZVV / Z-Pass + Half-Tax for 365 CHF + 400CHF public transport credit as well as an attractive first-class subscription or free parking. Staff restaurant VIVA We offer our employees a daily fitness menu from 9.00 CHF. Mobile subscriptions We offer special conditions for mobile subscriptions via Mobilezone at Sunrise and Swisscom. Health port We are committed to health prevention through laboratory analyses, massages, nutritional advice, physiotherapy, group courses and a company doctor. Sports activities We promote sport through self-organized circuit training and running groups as well as vouchers for update and active fitness. Two billion people eat food produced at Bühler plants every day. One billion people travel in vehicles whose parts were produced using Bühler technologies. With every decision, Bühler pursues the goal of reconciling the needs of the economy, people and nature. In this way, we develop solutions that open up sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed and mobility industries. We want to innovate for a better world, with a particular focus on healthy, safe and sustainable solutions. This is why we work with customers, start-ups, multinational corporations and scientists to achieve a faster impact together.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Starte jetzt. Gestalte morgen. BFuture.


Du willst verstehen, wie IT-Systeme funktionieren, im Hintergrund reibungslos laufen und vor Hackerangriffen geschützt sind? Dann ist die Lehrstelle als Informatiker:in Plattformentwicklung EFZ bei Bühler genau das Richtige für dich!


Bewerbe dich jetzt mit deinen vollständigen Bewerbungsunterlagen (Motivationsschreiben, Lebenslauf, Zeugnisse und) und starte deine Zukunft mit uns! Aufgaben: • Du baust Informatiksysteme auf und stellst deren reibungslosen Betrieb sicher • Du betreibst und wartest Netzwerke und sorgst für deren Verfügbarkeit und Sicherheit • Du leistest Hardware- und Software-Support für interne Anwender • Du arbeitest mit verschiedenen Betriebssystemen und Technologien • Du unterstützt internationale Mitarbeitende und arbeitest an spannenden IT- und Automationsprojekten mit Anforderungen: • Logisches und abstraktes Denken • Stark in Mathematik, Physik und Englisch • Technisches Verständnis • Geduldiges und zielorientiertes Arbeiten • Zuverlässigkeit und Verantwortungsbewusstsein Wir bieten: Attraktiver Ferienanspruch Ausreichend Zeit für Erholung und persönliche Interessen - wir bieten von 25 bis zu 30 Tage Ferien pro Jahr abhängig vom Lebensjahr. Attraktives Mobilitätskonzept Wir bieten ein OSTWIND ZVV / Z-Pass + Halbtax für 365 CHF + 400CHF ÖV-Guthaben sowie ein attraktives Erstklass-Abonnement oder kostenlose Parkplätze. Personalrestaurant VIVA Wir bieten unseren Mitarbeitenden ein tägliches Fitnessmenü ab 9, 00 CHF. Handy-Abonnements Wir bieten Spezialkonditionen bei Handyabonnements über Mobilezone bei Sunrise und Swisscom. Health-Port Wir setzen uns für Gesundheitsprävention durch Laboranalysen, Massagen, Ernährungsberatung, Physiotherapie, Gruppenkurse sowie einen Betriebsarzt ein. Sportangebote Wir fördern die sportliche Betätigung durch eigenorganisiertes Zirkeltraining und Laufgruppen sowie durch Gutscheine für Update und Activ Fitness. Zwei Milliarden Menschen essen täglich Lebensmittel, die auf Anlagen von Bühler hergestellt wurden. Eine Milliarde Menschen reisen in Fahrzeugen, deren Teile mit Technologien von Bühler produziert wurden. Mit jeder Entscheidung verfolgt Bühler das Ziel, die Bedürfnisse von Wirtschaft, Mensch und Natur in Einklang zu bringen. So entwickeln wir Lösungen, die nachhaltige Geschäftsmöglichkeiten in der globalen Lebensmittel-, Futtermittel- und Mobilitätsindustrie eröffnen. Wir wollen Innovationen für eine bessere Welt schaffen, mit besonderem Fokus auf gesunde, sichere und nachhaltige Lösungen. Deshalb arbeiten wir mit Kunden, Start-ups, multinationalen Konzernen und Wissenschaftlern zusammen, um gemeinsam eine schnellere Wirkung zu erzielen.

jobs.description:
Am Standort Beilngries widmen sich rund 360 Mitarbeitende im Geschäftsbereich Grain Quality and Supply (GQ) dem Anlagen- und Maschinenbau rund um die Themen Getreideverarbeitung sowie Mälzen & Brauen.
Dies umfasst die Reinigung, Trocknung, den Transport (inkl. Fördertechnik und Schiffsbeladung), die Lagerung und Digitalisierung, um Getreide vom Feld bis zum Verbraucher zu verarbeiten. Immer mit dem Fokus auf Effizienz, Produktqualität und Nachhaltigkeit.

Als Montageleiter (m/w/d) bist Du der zentrale Ansprechpartner auf unseren Baustellen weltweit und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Projekte im Anlagen- und Maschinenbau reibungslos, termingerecht und in hoher Qualität umgesetzt werden.
Du koordinierst Teams, planst Abläufe und trägst aktiv dazu bei, dass unsere Kunden auf unsere Kompetenz und Zuverlässigkeit bauen können.

Lass uns bei Bühler gemeinsam etwas bewirken!
Zwei Milliarden Menschen essen täglich Lebensmittel, die auf Anlagen von Bühler hergestellt wurden. Eine Milliarde Menschen reisen in Fahrzeugen, deren Teile mit Technologien von Bühler produziert wurden.
Mit jeder Entscheidung verfolgt Bühler das Ziel, die Bedürfnisse von Wirtschaft, Mensch und Natur in Einklang zu bringen. So entwickeln wir Lösungen, die nachhaltige Geschäftsmöglichkeiten in der globalen Lebensmittel-, Futtermittel- und Mobilitätsindustrie eröffnen.
Wir wollen Innovationen für eine bessere Welt schaffen, mit besonderem Fokus auf gesunde, sichere und nachhaltige Lösungen. Deshalb arbeiten wir mit Kunden, Start-ups, multinationalen Konzernen und Wissenschaftlern zusammen, um gemeinsam eine schnellere Wirkung zu erzielen. Aufgaben: • Montage und Inbetriebnahme: Eigenständige Organisation und Durchführung der Montage und Inbetriebnahme unserer Maschinen und Anlagen auf Baustellen weltweit • Projektkoordination: Schnittstelle zwischen Projektmanagement, Kunden und Subunternehmer • Bauablauf: Planung und Überwachung der Montage und Inbetriebnahme hinsichtlich Qualität, Zeit und Materialeinsatz • Ressourcenplanung: Einsatzplanung für Eigen- und Fremdpersonal sowie Maschinen • Qualitäts- und Sicherheitsmanagement: Durchsetzung von Arbeitssicherheitsrichtlinien und Abnahme der Baufortschritte • Dokumentation: Durchführung von Besprechungen, Teilabnahmen und Kundenbegehungen inkl. Baustellendokumentation Anforderungen: • Abgeschlossene gewerbliche oder technische Ausbildung (Konstruktions-, Anlagenmechanik, Metallbau oder ähnliches) • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in der Montage auf Baustellen, vorzugsweise im Anlagenbau • Entscheidungsfreudige und lösungsorientierte Persönlichkeit • Organisationstalent, ausgeprägte Kundenorientierung und erkennbares Führungspotenzial • Flexibilität und hohe Mobilität bezüglich Einsatzbereitschaft und -ort (Reisebereitschaft weltweit ca. 90%) • Sichere Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift • Führerschein Klasse B erforderlich Wir bieten: Familiäre Unternehmenskultur Wir haben eine mehr als 160-jährige Geschichte. Damit sind wir ein Unternehmen, das langfristig denkt und investiert - bei Innovationen, unseren Mitarbeitenden und dem wirtschaftlichen Erfolg. Interkulturelles Arbeitsumfeld Der Schlüssel zu unserem Erfolg ist unsere vielfältige Belegschaft aus mehr als 100 Nationen und unsere inklusive Kultur. Betriebliche Altersvorsorge oder vermögenswirksame Leistungen Profitiere von unserer betrieblichen Altersvorsorge oder vermögenswirksamen Leistungen – für eine sichere Zukunft! Teamanlässe und Events Ihr Engagement macht es uns möglich. Das wollen wir gemeinsam mit Ihnen feiern. Unsere Weihnachtsfeiern, Sommerpartys, Sportveranstaltungen und Teamevents bieten die besten Gelegenheiten dazu. Offene Kommunikationskultur Profitieren Sie von einer offenen Kommunikationskultur, die Transparenz und Austausch fördert! Berufliche und persönliche Entwicklung Wir bieten ein breites Spektrum an Lernmöglichkeiten, wie Videos, Online-Schulungen, Präsenzschulungen und Webinare mit kurzen, relevanten, ansprechenden, personalisierten und mobilen Formaten. descriptionByLocale.it:
Nel sito Beilngries, circa 360 dipendenti della divisione Grain Quality and Supply (GQ) sono dedicati all'ingegneria meccanica e vegetale nei settori della lavorazione del grano e della produzione di malto e malto. > Ciò include la pulizia, l'essiccazione, il trasporto (comprese le attrezzature di trasporto e il carico delle navi), lo stoccaggio e la digitalizzazione per elaborare il grano dal campo al consumatore. Sempre al centro dell'efficienza, della qualità del prodotto e della sostenibilità. > > Come direttore d'assemblaggio (m/f/d) Lei è il punto centrale di contatto sui nostri cantieri in tutto il mondo e assicura che i nostri progetti in ingegneria vegetale e meccanica siano implementati senza intoppi, nel tempo e in alta qualità. > Coordinate team, pianificate processi e aiutate attivamente i nostri clienti a sviluppare le nostre competenze e affidabilità. > > Facciamo la differenza a Bühler insieme! Un miliardo di persone viaggiano in veicoli le cui parti sono state prodotte utilizzando le tecnologie Bühler. > Con ogni decisione, Bühler persegue l'obiettivo di conciliare le esigenze dell'economia, delle persone e della natura. In questo modo, sviluppiamo soluzioni che aprono opportunità di business sostenibili nel settore alimentare, alimentare e della mobilità globale. > Vogliamo creare innovazioni per un mondo migliore, con particolare attenzione alle soluzioni sane, sicure e sostenibili. Ecco perché lavoriamo con clienti, start-up, multinazionali e scienziati per ottenere un impatto più veloce insieme. Compiti:
• Assemblaggio e messa in servizio: Organizzazione indipendente e implementazione di assemblaggio e messa in servizio su cantieri in tutto il mondo
• Coordinamento del progetto: interfaccia tra project management, cliente e subappaltatore
• Processo di costruzione: pianificazione e monitoraggio del montaggio e della messa in servizio in termini di qualità, tempo e uso del materiale
• Pianificazione delle risorse: pianificazione operativa del personale e delle macchine proprie ed esterne
• Gestione della qualità e della sicurezza: applicazione delle politiche di sicurezza sul lavoro e riduzione del progresso delle costruzioni
• Documentazione: Conduzione di incontri, accettazione parziale e visite dei clienti incl. Documentazione del cantiere Requisiti
• Formazione commerciale o tecnica completa (costruzione, meccanica vegetale, costruzione di metalli o simili)
• Diversi anni di esperienza professionale in assemblaggio su cantieri, preferibilmente in costruzione di impianti
• Personalità decisionale e orientata alla soluzione
• Talenti organizzativi, forte orientamento del cliente e potenziale di leadership riconoscibile
• Flessibilità e elevata mobilità in termini di disponibilità operativa e posizione (prontezza del viaggio intorno al 90% in tutto il mondo)
• Conoscenza sicura dell'inglese in parola e scrittura
• Titolo di guida della categoria B richiesto Offriamo: Cultura aziendale familiare Abbiamo più di 160 anni di storia. Questo ci rende una società che pensa e investe a lungo termine - in innovazione, i nostri dipendenti e il successo economico. Ambiente di lavoro interculturale La chiave del nostro successo è la nostra forza lavoro diversificata da più di 100 nazioni e la nostra cultura inclusiva. Previdenza sociale Approfittate delle nostre pensioni aziendali o dei servizi che generano attività – per un futuro sicuro! Eventi e eventi di squadra Il vostro impegno ci rende possibile. Vogliamo festeggiare insieme a te. Le nostre feste di Natale, feste estive, eventi sportivi e eventi di squadra offrono le migliori opportunità per farlo. Cultura della comunicazione aperta Approfittate di una cultura di comunicazione aperta che promuove la trasparenza e lo scambio! Sviluppo professionale e personale Offriamo una vasta gamma di opportunità di apprendimento, come video, formazione online, formazione faccia a faccia e webinar con formati brevi, rilevanti, coinvolgenti, personalizzati e mobili. Due miliardi di persone mangiano cibo prodotto nelle piante di Bühler ogni giorno. Un miliardo di persone viaggiano in veicoli le cui parti sono state prodotte utilizzando le tecnologie Bühler. Con ogni decisione, Bühler persegue l'obiettivo di conciliare le esigenze dell'economia, delle persone e della natura. In questo modo, sviluppiamo soluzioni che aprono opportunità di business sostenibili nel settore alimentare, alimentare e della mobilità globale. Vogliamo innovare per un mondo migliore, con particolare attenzione alle soluzioni sane, sicure e sostenibili. Ecco perché lavoriamo con clienti, start-up, multinazionali e scienziati per ottenere un impatto più veloce insieme.
descriptionByLocale.en:
At the Beilngries site, around 360 employees in the Grain Quality and Supply (GQ) division are dedicated to plant and mechanical engineering in the areas of grain processing and malt & brewing.
This includes cleaning, drying, transport (including conveying equipment and ship loading), storage and digitization to process grain from the field to the consumer. Always with the focus on efficiency, product quality and sustainability.

As assembly conductor (m/f/d) You are the central point of contact on our construction sites worldwide and ensure that our projects in plant and mechanical engineering are implemented smoothly, on time and in high quality.
You coordinate teams, plan processes and actively help our customers to build on our expertise and reliability.

Let's make a difference at Bühler together!
Two billion people eat food produced on Bühler plants every day. One billion people travel in vehicles whose parts were produced using Bühler technologies.
With every decision, Bühler pursues the goal of reconciling the needs of the economy, people and nature. In this way, we develop solutions that open up sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed and mobility industries.
We want to create innovations for a better world, with a particular focus on healthy, safe and sustainable solutions. This is why we work with customers, start-ups, multinational corporations and scientists to achieve a faster impact together. Tasks: • Assembly and commissioning: Independent organization and implementation of assembly and commissioning on construction sites worldwide • Project coordination: interface between project management, customer and subcontractor • Construction process: planning and monitoring of assembly and commissioning in terms of quality, time and material use • Resource planning: operational planning for own and external personnel and machines • Quality and Safety Management: Enforcement of Occupational Safety Policies and Reduction of Construction Progress • Documentation: Conduct of meetings, partial acceptances and customer visits incl. Construction site documentation Requirements • Completed commercial or technical training (construction, plant mechanics, metal construction or similar) • Several years of professional experience in assembly on construction sites, preferably in plant construction • Decision-making and solution-oriented personality • Organizational talent, strong customer orientation and recognizable leadership potential • Flexibility and high mobility in terms of operational readiness and location (travel readiness around 90% worldwide) • Safe knowledge of English in word and writing • Category B driving licence required We offer: Family business culture We have more than 160 years of history. This makes us a company that thinks and invests in the long term - in innovation, our employees and economic success. Intercultural working environment Key to our success is our diverse workforce from more than 100 nations and our inclusive culture. Occupational pension schemes or asset-generating benefits Benefit from our company pensions or asset-generating services – for a secure future! Team events and events Your commitment makes it possible for us. We want to celebrate this together with you. Our Christmas parties, summer parties, sporting events and team events offer the best opportunities to do so. Open communication culture Benefit from an open communication culture that promotes transparency and exchange! Professional and personal development We offer a wide range of learning opportunities, such as videos, online training, face-to-face training and webinars with short, relevant, engaging, personalised and mobile formats. Two billion people eat food produced on Bühler plants every day. One billion people travel in vehicles whose parts were produced using Bühler technologies. With every decision, Bühler pursues the goal of reconciling the needs of the economy, people and nature. In this way, we develop solutions that open up sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed and mobility industries. We want to innovate for a better world, with a particular focus on healthy, safe and sustainable solutions. This is why we work with customers, start-ups, multinational corporations and scientists to achieve a faster impact together.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Sur le site de Beilngries, environ 360 employés de la division Qualité et approvisionnement en grains (GQ) sont dédiés à l'ingénierie des installations et de la mécanique dans les domaines de la transformation des grains et du malt et brassage.
Cela comprend le nettoyage, le séchage, le transport (y compris l'équipement de transport et le chargement des navires), l'entreposage et la numérisation pour traiter le grain du champ au consommateur. Toujours en mettant l'accent sur l'efficacité, la qualité et la durabilité des produits.

En tant que chef d'assemblage (m/f/d) Vous êtes le point de contact central sur nos chantiers de construction dans le monde entier et assurez que nos projets d'ingénierie mécanique et d'usine sont mis en œuvre en douceur, à temps et en haute qualité.

Bühler (China) Investment Co., Ltd. established in 2011 in Wuxi, Jiangsu Province, is the group headquarters of the Swiss Bühler Group in Greater China and the first integrated headquarters of multinational companies in Jiangsu Province. With our advanced technology, we lead the market in grain handling and processing, consumer food manufacturing, and die-casting, grinding and dispersion. With our vision of "Innovations for a better world", we are committed to developing more innovative solutions by leveraging the global resources of the Bühler Group and taking advantage of localization.

Aufgaben:
• Manage sourcing activities of indirect materials, including MICE、Capital Expense, MRO, facility management, IT and HR services

• Responsible for sourcing and supplier management, continually optimize supply base to get competitive supplier base for indirect materials

• Work with regional category manager in building and implementing sourcing and category strategy

• Lead cross function team to complete potential supplier assessment and audit, and supplier performance improvement with corrective measures

• Closely work with internal customers to specify procurement requirements including but not limited to cost target, delivery time, brand, technology, and services

• Carry out RFI and RFQ process with competitive bidding process, and negotiate best prices and other commercial terms together with internal stakeholders

• Implement supplier contract to mitigate all potential supply and legal risks

• Complete subsequent purchasing activities timely including purchase order release, supplier delivery follow up and payment process

• Ensure supply and service continuous improvement, for business needs as well as internal customer service

• Establish the price database of indirect material, take lead on category annual cost saving initiatives and meet the objective.

Anforderungen:
• First degree: Bachelor

• PMP or CPSM is preferred

• 5-7 years' working experience in multinational companies, with head office experience is plus.

• 5-7 years' working experience for MICE category purchasing.

• 5-7 years' experience of indirect materials purchasing in an equipment manufacturing environment or similar.

• Be familiar with the purchasing of MRO, factory civil engineering, property leasing, equipment and plant maintenance, and administration consumables, etc.

• Advanced Sourcing methods (TCO, cost breakdown, negotiations skills, supplier selection, development, and relationship management)

• Good knowledge of project management, contract law, risk avoidance

• Good knowledge of the company operations, such as logistic, finance, production, quality, and R&D

• Good software/ system skills – excel, word, PowerPoint, SAP

• Language：CET6

• Self-driven and apt to take decisions

• Presentation and representations skills

• Have the capability to lead a cross function team to achieve the target

• Personal commitment and result oriented

• Cross functional, holistic and logic thinking and action taking

• Good execution and provide feedback in time

• Able to work under the pressure

• Good communication skills with influencing and convincing

Con la nostra tecnologia avanzata, guidiamo il mercato nella manipolazione e nella lavorazione dei cereali, nella produzione di cibo di consumo e nella pressofusione, nella macinazione e nella dispersione. Con la nostra visione di "Innovazioni per un mondo migliore", ci impegniamo a sviluppare soluzioni più innovative sfruttando le risorse globali del Gruppo Bühler e sfruttando la localizzazione. • Contratto fornitore di implementazione per mitigare tutti i potenziali rischi di approvvigionamento e legale
• Completare le successive attività di acquisto puntuale compreso il rilascio dell'ordine di acquisto, la consegna del fornitore segue il processo di pagamento
• Assicurare la fornitura e il servizio di miglioramento continuo, per le esigenze aziendali e il servizio clienti interno
• Stabilire il database dei prezzi dei materiali indiretti, prendere in considerazione le iniziative di risparmio annuale di categoria e soddisfare l'obiettivo. Anforderungen:

• PMP o CPSM è preferito

• 5-7 anni di esperienza di materiali indiretti che acquistano in un ambiente di produzione di attrezzature o simili.
• Conoscere l'acquisto di MRO, ingegneria civile di fabbrica, leasing di proprietà, attrezzature e manutenzione di impianti, e materiali di consumo di amministrazione, ecc.

Bühler (Chine) Investment Co., Ltd. établie en 2011 à Wuxi, province de Jiangsu, est le siège du groupe suisse Bühler dans la Grande Chine et le premier siège intégré de sociétés multinationales dans la province de Jiangsu. Grâce à notre technologie de pointe, nous sommes à la tête du marché de la manutention et de la transformation des grains, de la fabrication d'aliments de consommation, de la fonte sous-marine, du broyage et de la dispersion. Avec notre vision des "Innovations pour un monde meilleur", nous nous engageons à développer des solutions plus innovantes en exploitant les ressources mondiales du Groupe Bühler et en profitant de la localisation. Aufgaben:

• Responsable de l'approvisionnement et de la gestion des fournisseurs, optimise continuellement la base d'approvisionnement pour obtenir une base de fournisseurs concurrentiels pour les matériaux indirects
• Collaborer avec le gestionnaire de catégorie régional pour élaborer et mettre en oeuvre une stratégie d'approvisionnement et de catégorie
• Équipe interfonctionnelle responsable de l'évaluation et de la vérification possibles des fournisseurs et de l'amélioration du rendement des fournisseurs grâce à des mesures correctives
• Collaborer étroitement avec les clients internes pour préciser les besoins en matière d'approvisionnement, y compris, sans s'y limiter, les coûts cibles, les délais de livraison, la marque, la technologie et les services
• Mettre en oeuvre le processus de demande de renseignements et de QDR avec un processus d'appel d'offres concurrentiel, et négocier les meilleurs prix et d'autres conditions commerciales avec les intervenants internes
• Mettre en œuvre le contrat de fournisseur pour atténuer tous les risques potentiels d'approvisionnement et de droit
• Terminer les activités d'achat subséquentes en temps opportun, y compris la mainlevée de la commande, le suivi de la livraison du fournisseur et le processus de paiement
• Assurer l'amélioration continue de l'offre et du service, pour les besoins des entreprises et le service à la clientèle interne
• Établir la base de données des prix du matériel indirect, prendre la tête des initiatives d'économies annuelles de catégorie et atteindre l'objectif. - C'est pas vrai.

• PMP ou CPSM est préféré

• 5-7 ans d'expérience de travail pour les achats de catégorie MICE.
• 5-7 ans d'expérience dans l'achat indirect de matériaux dans un environnement de fabrication d'équipement ou similaire.
• Vous devez vous familiariser avec l'achat de MRO, de génie civil d'usine, de location de biens immobiliers, d'équipement et d'entretien d'usines, de consommables administratifs, etc.
• Méthodes d'approvisionnement avancées (COT, ventilation des coûts, compétences en négociation, sélection des fournisseurs, développement et gestion des relations)
• Bonne connaissance de la gestion de projet, droit des contrats, prévention des risques
• Bonne connaissance des activités de l'entreprise, comme la logistique, la finance, la production, la qualité et la R-D
• Bonnes compétences logicielles / système – excellent, mot, PowerPoint, SAP
• Langue: CET6
• Autodidacte et apte à prendre des décisions
• Compétences en présentation et représentation
• Avoir la capacité de diriger une équipe interfonctions pour atteindre la cible

• La pensée et l'action transversales, fonctionnelles, holistiques et logiques
• Bonne exécution et retour à temps

Un milliard de personnes conduisent des véhicules dont les pièces ont été fabriquées avec nos machines. Bühler vise à équilibrer l'humanité, la nature et l'économie dans chaque décision en développant des solutions qui ouvrent des opportunités commerciales durables dans les industries mondiales de l'alimentation humaine, de l'alimentation animale et de la mobilité. jobs.description:
Als BuchhalterIn unterstützt du unser erfahrenes Accounting-Team in der Salzburger Bühler AG-Niederlassung bei jeglichen operativen und administrativen Aufgaben. Nach einer umfassenden Einarbeitung wirst du deine eigenen Aufgaben übernehmen, die du selbstständig abwickelst. Die Buchhaltung liefert wichtige Informationen, um das Unternehmen bestmöglich zu steuern. Um dieses verantwortungsvolle Aufgabengebiet weiterhin optimal ausführen zu können, sind wir auf der Suche nach dir, unserem neuen Teammitglied!

Lass uns bei Bühler gemeinsam etwas bewirken!
Zwei Milliarden Menschen essen täglich Lebensmittel, die auf Anlagen von Bühler hergestellt wurden. Eine Milliarde Menschen reisen in Fahrzeugen, deren Teile mit Technologien von Bühler produziert wurden.
Mit jeder Entscheidung verfolgt Bühler das Ziel, die Bedürfnisse von Wirtschaft, Mensch und Natur in Einklang zu bringen. So entwickeln wir Lösungen, die nachhaltige Geschäftsmöglichkeiten in der globalen Lebensmittel-, Futtermittel- und Mobilitätsindustrie eröffnen.
Wir wollen Innovationen für eine bessere Welt schaffen, mit besonderem Fokus auf gesunde, sichere und nachhaltige Lösungen. Deshalb arbeiten wir mit Kunden, Start-ups, multinationalen Konzernen und Wissenschaftlern zusammen, um gemeinsam eine schnellere Wirkung zu erzielen. Aufgaben: • Du prüfst und verbuchst die Reisespesen der Außendienstmitarbeitenden unserer Central Eastern Europe-Region • Die Anlagenbuchhaltung wird von dir verwaltet und gepflegt (Inventur) • Zudem führst du eigenverantwortlich die laufende Buchhaltung, einschließlich der Bearbeitung von Eingangsrechnungen- sowie Abwicklung von Kreditkarten- und Banktransaktionen, durch • Du erstellst und übermittelst statistische Meldungen • Die Vorsteuerrückerstattung wird jährlich von dir durchgeführt • Darüber hinaus unterstützt du bei der Erstellung des Jahresabschlusses • Auch die Unterstützung des Front Office Teams (fallweise Vertretung am Empfang) zählt zu deinen Aufgaben Anforderungen: • Abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung (HAK, HAS, HLW, Lehre) • Mindestens 1-2 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Buchhaltung nach UGB & Steuerrecht • Sehr gute MS Office-Anwenderkenntnisse (insbesondere Excel) • Kenntnisse in der BMD-NTCS-Buchhaltungssoftware (inkl. BMD KORE) sind von Vorteil • Du besitzt einwandfreie Deutsch- & gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift • Eine aufgeschlossene und freundliche Persönlichkeit zeichnet dich aus • Du bist ein Teamplayer und arbeitest strukturiert, genau und zuverlässig Wir bieten: Mobiles Arbeiten Wenn es Ihre Tätigkeit zulässt, ist mobiles Arbeiten in Absprache mit Ihrer Führungskraft möglich (bis zu 40%). So können Sie Ihr Berufs- und Privatleben in Einklang bringen. Teamanlässe und Events Ihr Engagement macht es uns möglich. Das wollen wir gemeinsam mit Ihnen feiern. Unsere Weihnachtsfeiern, Sommerpartys, Sportveranstaltungen und Teamevents bieten die besten Gelegenheiten dazu. Kantine mit gesunden Mahlzeiten Geniessen Sie gesunde Mahlzeiten in unserer Kantine zu fairen Preisen. Vielfältiger und integrativer Arbeitsplatz Wir fördern eine inklusive Kultur, die unsere globale Vielfalt wertschätzt. Respekt und Empathie sorgen dafür, dass sich alle sicher fühlen und ihr Bestes geben können. Berufliche und persönliche Entwicklung Wir bieten ein breites Spektrum an Lernmöglichkeiten, wie Videos, Online-Schulungen, Präsenzschulungen und Webinare mit kurzen, relevanten, ansprechenden, personalisierten und mobilen Formaten. Angebote für Gesundheit und Wohlbefinden Wir bieten eine Reihe von Gesundheits- und Wohlfühlangeboten, die Sie dabei unterstützen, sich körperlich und geistig wohl zu fühlen. Zwei Milliarden Menschen essen täglich Lebensmittel, die auf Anlagen von Bühler hergestellt wurden. Eine Milliarde Menschen reisen in Fahrzeugen, deren Teile mit Technologien von Bühler produziert wurden. Mit jeder Entscheidung verfolgt Bühler das Ziel, die Bedürfnisse von Wirtschaft, Mensch und Natur in Einklang zu bringen. So entwickeln wir Lösungen, die nachhaltige Geschäftsmöglichkeiten in der globalen Lebensmittel-, Futtermittel- und Mobilitätsindustrie eröffnen. Wir wollen Innovationen für eine bessere Welt schaffen, mit besonderem Fokus auf gesunde, sichere und nachhaltige Lösungen. Deshalb arbeiten wir mit Kunden, Start-ups, multinationalen Konzernen und Wissenschaftlern zusammen, um gemeinsam eine schnellere Wirkung zu erzielen.

descriptionByLocale.it:
In qualità di contabile, supporterete il nostro team di contabilità esperto presso l'ufficio di Salzburg Bühler AG in qualsiasi attività operativa e amministrativa. Dopo una formazione completa, si prenderanno i propri compiti, che si manterrà indipendentemente. La contabilità fornisce informazioni importanti per gestire l'azienda nel modo migliore possibile. Per continuare a svolgere questo compito responsabile in modo ottimale, siamo alla ricerca di voi, il nostro nuovo membro del team! Facciamo una differenza insieme a Bühler! Un miliardo di persone viaggiano in veicoli le cui parti sono state prodotte utilizzando le tecnologie Bühler. > Con ogni decisione, Bühler persegue l'obiettivo di conciliare le esigenze dell'economia, delle persone e della natura. In questo modo, sviluppiamo soluzioni che aprono opportunità di business sostenibili nel settore alimentare, alimentare e della mobilità globale. > Vogliamo creare innovazioni per un mondo migliore, con particolare attenzione alle soluzioni sane, sicure e sostenibili. Ecco perché lavoriamo con clienti, start-up, multinazionali e scienziati per ottenere un impatto più veloce insieme. Compiti:
• Controlla e prenota le spese di viaggio del personale del settore della nostra regione dell'Europa centrale orientale
• La contabilità patrimoniale è gestita e mantenuta da voi (inventario)
• Inoltre, sei responsabile della contabilità in corso, incluso il trattamento delle fatture in arrivo, nonché il trattamento delle carte di credito e delle transazioni bancarie,
• Crea e invia report statistici
• Il rimborso IVA è effettuato annualmente da voi
• Inoltre, si sostiene nella preparazione dei conti annuali
• Anche il supporto del team di front office (rappresentazione alla reception se necessario) è uno dei vostri compiti Requisiti
• Formazione commerciale completa (HAK, HAS, HLW, apprendistato)
• Almeno 1-2 anni di esperienza professionale in contabilità secondo UGB & diritto fiscale
• Conoscenza utente di MS Office molto buona (soprattutto Excel)
• La conoscenza del software di contabilità BMD-NTCS (incluso BMD KORE) è un vantaggio

After a comprehensive training, you will take on your own tasks, which you will handle independently. Accounting provides important information to manage the company in the best possible way. In order to continue to perform this responsible task optimally, we are looking for you, our new team member!

Let us at Bühler make a difference together!
Two billion people eat food produced on Bühler plants every day. One billion people travel in vehicles whose parts were produced using Bühler technologies.
With every decision, Bühler pursues the goal of reconciling the needs of the economy, people and nature. In this way, we develop solutions that open up sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed and mobility industries.

jobs.title: Solution Architect SAP C4C v2
jobs.description:
To strengthen our IT department, we are looking for a Solution Architect SAP C4C v2 to shape our global CRM landscape based on SAP Sales Cloud v2 and SAP Service Cloud v2. As the architectural lead, you will design scalable and integrated solutions that support Sales, Customer Service, Marketing, and Digital Customer Experience processes, while ensuring seamless connectivity across SAP S/4HANA, SAP BTP, and other enterprise platforms. Working closely with Product Owners, business stakeholders, and development teams, you will drive architectural decisions, govern technology standards, and help define the future roadmap of our customer engagement ecosystem.

Aufgaben:
• You define and drive the target architecture for Bühler's global CRM platform and Customer Engagement ecosystem

• You design scalable integration and data solutions across SAP Sales Cloud v2, SAP Service Cloud v2, SAP S/4HANA, SAP BTP, and connected digital platforms

• You translate business and technical requirements into solution architectures, implementation roadmaps, and design guidelines

• You lead architectural governance, technical decision-making, and ensure compliance with enterprise architecture, integration, and security standards

• You collaborate closely with Product Owners, business stakeholders, and delivery teams to continuously evolve and enhance CRM capabilities

Anforderungen:
• University degree in Computer Science, Business Informatics, Engineering, or a comparable qualification, combined with proven experience as a Solution Architect or Lead Architect in large-scale SAP CRM transformation programs

• Deep expertise in SAP Sales Cloud v2, SAP Service Cloud v2, SAP S/4HANA, SAP BTP, and SAP Integration Suite within complex global SAP environments

• Strong knowledge of enterprise integration architecture, including APIs, event-driven architectures, master data integration, customer data management, and enterprise integration patterns

• Ability to define architecture roadmaps, lead technical governance, and translate business strategy into scalable, secure, and future-oriented solution designs

• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills in English, with experience working in Agile (SAFe) environments and influencing business and technology decisions at senior leadership level

Wir bieten:
Attractive vacation entitlement
Enough time for relaxation and personal interests - we offer from 25 to 30 days of vacation per year depending on age.

Attractive mobility concept
We offer an OSTWIND ZVV / Z-Pass + half-fare travelcard for CHF 365 + CHF 400 public transport credit as well as an attractive first-class travelcard or free parking.

VIVA Restaurant
We offer our employees a daily fitness menu from 9, 00 CHF.

Employer-funded pension plan
The Bühler Pension Fund offers Bühler employees an independent pension fund that ensures reliable financial security in retirement: www.pk-buhler.ch

Health-Port
We are committed to preventive health care through laboratory analyses, massages, nutritional advice, physiotherapy, group courses and a company doctor.

Sports activities
We promote physical activity through self-organized circuit training and running groups as well as vouchers for Update and Activ Fitness.

Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines.
Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries.
We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

jobs.description:
In 2007, Bühler (Wuxi) Commercial Co., Ltd. was established in Wuxi, Jiangsu Province. We lead the market in grain handling and processing, consumer food manufacturing, and grinding and dispersion with our advanced technology advantages. We have several independent application centers and customer service centers for milling, pasta, color sorting, consumer food, grinding and dispersion, providing integrated solutions for multiple industry chains.
With our vision of “Innovations for a better world”, we are committed to developing more innovative solutions by leveraging the global resources of the Bühler Group and taking advantage of localization. Aufgaben: • Develop and maintain application software on Bühler's Linux-based embedded platform for machine control, covering control logic, parameter handling, alarms, status management, and machine interfaces. • Develop and maintain firmware for sensors used on Bühler machines, enabling sensing, data collection, local processing, diagnostics, and data upload. • Participate in software testing, verification, and validation. • Support machine integration, commissioning, troubleshooting, and issue resolution. Willingness to travel internationally (market introductions, troubleshooting). • Create and maintain technical documentation, such as software design documents, interface descriptions, test records, and release notes. • Follow software development processes, coding standards, version control and quality requirements. Anforderungen: • Bachelor's degree or above in Automation, Electronics Engineering, Computer Science, Control Engineering, or a related field. • 3 or more years of embedded software development experience. • Solid programming skills in C/C++ and good understanding of embedded software development. Familiar with embedded software development tools and workflows, e.g. Eclipse, git etc. We develop on Microsoft Windows for Linux and bare-metal. • Interest in complete machines, and motivated to work in a multidisciplinary and international environment. • Good English reading, writing, and verbal communication skills for international collaboration and technical documentation. • Experience in embedded software development, real-time machine control software, signal processing and closed-loop control, communication networks (IP, CAN, Fieldbus, BLE), low-power embedded systems, relational databases (SQL) is a plus. • Experience with ARM processors, STMicroelectronics STM32, Texas Instruments MCUs, or similar microcontroller platforms is a plus. Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines. Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries. We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

jobs.description:
The Executive Assistant to Regional President is a business-facing role, who supports the President in strategic analysis, business coordination, executive communication, stakeholder management and selected strategic projects. The role is not positioned as a traditional administrative assistant role, but as a value-added business support position to enhance leadership productivity and regional execution effectiveness.

Aufgaben:
- Strategic and Business Support
• Support the President in reviewing, consolidating and refining strategic perspectives for Greater China business topics.

• Prepare executive summaries based on large volumes of internal and external inputs, including business reports, market information, stakeholder feedback and strategic documents.

• Conduct business, market, industry, policy and competitor analysis to support management decision-making.

• Read, assimilate and summarize external inputs, including market trends, macroeconomic updates, regulatory changes and industry developments.

• Support the preparation, review and improvement of strategic presentations, management reports and professional slide decks for internal and external meetings.

• Support and coordinate M&A projects

• Regional President's Office Coordination

• Help establish and operate the President's Office as an effective working mechanism to support the President's productivity.

• Coordinate annual, quarterly, monthly and weekly business rhythms, management meetings and follow-up mechanisms.

• Maintain and follow up on key action lists, priorities, decisions and deliverables related to regional management topics.

• Prepare meeting minutes for strategic or business-critical meetings, formalize key decisions and coordinate follow-up actions.

• Support the setup and follow-up of regional company rhythms and align with relevant internal stakeholders.

• Stakeholder Management and Cross-cultural Communication

• Support communication and coordination between the President, Greater China Management Team, Group functions and Swiss / European stakeholders.

• Act as a cultural and business bridge between Greater China and European stakeholders.

• Establish and maintain effective working relationships with executive assistants, business leaders and relevant stakeholders at Group and regional levels.

• Support preparation for senior stakeholder visits, customer visits or Group representative visits from a business and cultural integration perspective.

• Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders to ensure alignment on key business topics and follow-up actions.

• Executive Communication and Presentation Support

• Draft, review and polish executive-level documents, presentations, meeting materials and formal communication.

• Prepare concise briefing notes before important meetings, stakeholder interactions or business reviews.

• Translate complex business information into structured, clear and actionable management insights.

• Support the President in preparing communication materials for internal management meetings, external engagements and Group-level discussions.

• Ensure quality, consistency and professionalism of documents and presentations.

• Strategic Project and Follow-up Management

• Support selected strategic projects on behalf of the President, including project tracking, research, coordination and follow-up.

• Engage with the Greater China Management Team on regional and Group-level strategic projects.

• Coordinate cross-functional inputs and ensure timely completion of agreed deliverables.

• Identify potential risks, bottlenecks or misalignments in project execution and escalate when necessary.

• Maintain structured documentation of key projects, meeting outcomes and action plans.

Anforderungen:
• Bachelor's degree or above in Business Administration, Economics, Finance, Industrial Engineering, Management, Strategy or related disciplines.

• Master's degree, overseas education background, or combined business and engineering education is preferred.

• 5+ years of experience in management consulting, strategy, business analysis, corporate development, investment / M&A or project management.

• Consulting firm background is highly preferred; M&A, investment advisory or cross-border project experience is a strong advantage.

• Solid business analysis capability, including market research, industry analysis, competitor analysis and business case preparation.

• Experience in strategic planning, market entry, management reporting or executive-level decision support is preferred.

• Experience in preparing professional presentations, executive summaries, business reports, strategy documents or information memoranda is required.

• Prior exposure to China-Europe business environment, manufacturing, industrial technology, supply chain or B2B industries is preferred.

• Fluent Mandarin Chinese and English, both written and spoken.

• Able to prepare professional business documents, reports and presentations in English.

• Confident in communicating with senior stakeholders in a multicultural environment.

• Excellent MS Office skills, especially PowerPoint, Excel and Word.

• Proficient in using AI tools for research, document drafting, executive summaries, presentation refinement, translation and data interpretation.

• Able to critically evaluate AI-generated outputs and ensure accuracy, confidentiality, professionalism and business relevance.

• Strong structured thinking, problem-solving capability, business acumen and strategic sensitivity.

• Strong project management and follow-up skills; able to manage multiple priorities and drive tasks to closure.

• Strong stakeholder management capability; able to coordinate cross-functional, cross-cultural and senior-level stakeholders.

• Mature, reliable and highly professional, with strong discretion when handling confidential information.

• Proactive, accountable and learning-agile, with strong ownership and interest in business topics, strategy and organizational development.

• Resilient, adaptable and positive in a complex and fast-changing environment; willing to take this role as a career development opportunity.

descriptionByLocale.it:
L'Assistente Esecutivo al Presidente Regionale è un ruolo di business-facing, che sostiene il Presidente in analisi strategica, coordinamento aziendale, comunicazione esecutiva, gestione delle parti interessate e progetti strategici selezionati. Il ruolo non è posizionato come un ruolo di assistente amministrativo tradizionale, ma come una posizione di supporto economico a valore aggiunto per migliorare la produttività della leadership e l'efficacia dell'esecuzione regionale.

Aufgaben:
- Supporto strategico e commerciale
• Sostenere il Presidente nel rivedere, consolidare e raffinare prospettive strategiche per gli argomenti aziendali della Grande Cina.

• Preparare i riassunti esecutivi basati su grandi volumi di input interni ed esterni, tra cui rapporti commerciali, informazioni di mercato, feedback degli stakeholder e documenti strategici.

• Condurre business, mercato, industria, politica e analisi dei concorrenti per sostenere il processo decisionale di gestione.

• Leggere, assimilare e riassumere gli input esterni, comprese le tendenze di mercato, gli aggiornamenti macroeconomici, i cambiamenti normativi e gli sviluppi del settore.

• Sostenere la preparazione, la revisione e il miglioramento di presentazioni strategiche, rapporti di gestione e piattaforme di scorrimento professionali per incontri interni ed esterni.

• Supporto e coordinamento dei progetti M&A

• Coordinamento dell'Ufficio regionale

• Aiuta a stabilire e gestire l'Ufficio del Presidente come un efficace meccanismo di lavoro per sostenere la produttività del Presidente.

• Coordinare i ritmi aziendali annuali, trimestrali, mensili e settimanali, le riunioni di gestione e i meccanismi di follow-up.

• Mantenere e seguire gli elenchi di azioni chiave, le priorità, le decisioni e i risultati relativi a temi di gestione regionale.

• Preparare i minuti di riunione per incontri strategici o business-critical, formalizzare le decisioni chiave e coordinare le azioni di follow-up.

• Sostenere la configurazione e il follow-up dei ritmi aziendali regionali e allineare con le parti interessate interne rilevanti.

• Gestione degli stakeholder e comunicazione interculturale

• Sostenere la comunicazione e il coordinamento tra il Presidente, il Greater China Management Team, le funzioni del Gruppo e gli stakeholder svizzeri / europei.

• Agire come un ponte culturale e commerciale tra la Grande Cina e gli stakeholder europei.

• Stabilire e mantenere relazioni di lavoro efficaci con assistenti esecutivi, leader aziendali e stakeholder rilevanti a livello di Gruppo e regionale.

• Preparazione del supporto per le visite degli stakeholder senior, le visite dei clienti o le visite rappresentative del Gruppo da una prospettiva di integrazione aziendale e culturale.

• Coordinare con gli stakeholder interni ed esterni per garantire l'allineamento su argomenti chiave di business e azioni di follow-up.

• Comunicazione e supporto per la presentazione

• Progetto, revisione e lucida documenti a livello esecutivo, presentazioni, materiali di riunione e comunicazione formale.

• Preparare note di briefing concise prima di incontri importanti, interazioni con gli stakeholder o recensioni aziendali.

• Traduci informazioni aziendali complesse intuizioni di gestione strutturate, chiare e attuabili.

• Sostenere il Presidente nella preparazione di materiali di comunicazione per riunioni di gestione interna, impegni esterni e discussioni a livello di gruppo.

• Assicurare qualità, coerenza e professionalità di documenti e presentazioni.

• Progetto strategico e gestione del follow-up

• Sostegno selezionati progetti strategici a nome del Presidente, tra cui il monitoraggio dei progetti, la ricerca, il coordinamento e il follow-up.

• Impegnarsi con il Greater China Management Team sui progetti strategici a livello regionale e di Gruppo.

• Coordinare gli input interfunzionali e garantire il completamento tempestivo dei consegnabili concordati.

• Identificare potenziali rischi, colli di bottiglia o disallineamenti nell'esecuzione del progetto e aumentare quando necessario.

• Mantenere la documentazione strutturata di progetti chiave, risultati di incontro e piani di azione.

Anforderungen:

• Proficient in using AI tools for research, document drafting, executive summaries, presentation refinement, translation and data interpretation.

• Able to critically evaluate AI-generated outputs and ensure accuracy, confidentiality, professionalism and business relevance.

• Strong structured thinking, problem-solving capability, business acumen and strategic sensitivity.

• Strong project management and follow-up skills; able to manage multiple priorities and drive tasks to closure.

jobs.description:
Bühler (China) Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd, was established in 2012 in Wuxi, Jiangsu Province. As the headquarters of Bühler Die Casting Greater China, the company became in 2018 the third production base for a full range of die casting machines supplying the world, after Switzerland and the USA, capable of tailor-made solutions from single die casting machines to complete die casting islandsBuhler (China) Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd. has carried out a new series of production line layout, respectively from Shanghai, Shenzhen, Hefei to Wuxi. Now the company has become a comprehensive product solution provider integrating R&D, sales, production, service, application, project execution and product management, serving customers worldwide with high-end cutting-edge technology and precision quality.

Aufgaben:
• Follow Buhler M2M process, lead new product development from kick-off to mass production, translate VOC into requirements, own technical specification definition, design, simulation, development and validation.

• Develop assemblies and complete machines aligned with automation/hydraulic/technical/manufacturing/and cost requirements, deliver full set of production documents including 3D CAD models/manufacturing drawings/product BOM/technical documents.

• Work cross-functionally with HQ design team, supply chain /quality/customer service to support component development, supplier audit and in-process quality control.

• Follow global engineering standards, correctly apply drawing specifications, basic ISO GPS, tolerance stack-up analysis and configuration control to guarantee consistent, compliant technical outputs.

• Mechanical Life cycle management for exiting products, maintenance existing products, support production and customer for any technical requests and develop solutions on it.

• Lead cross-functional product technical problems solve or 8D, lead root cause analysis and implement corrective actions to secure stable production and delivery.

• Other tasks assigned by manager

Anforderungen:
• Bachelor's degree or above in Mechanical design or Bachelor's degree, more than 7 years' relative working experience in mechanical;Master's degree, more than 5 years' relative working experience in mechanical

• Independently design a machine or part of system

• Technical responsibility for the products assigned

• Well familiar with full production routing process, master properties of different engineering raw materials, sheet metal forming specifications, and technical standards of core mechanical assembly methods like bolted joints.

• Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite, skilled in mainstream 3D CAD tools (Creo and UG, etc.), working experience on Finite Element Analysis (FEA) is a strong plus.

• Familiar with mechanical structure design, mechanical principles and mechanical calculation

• Knowledge of mechanical manufacturing process

• Good English in both oral and written, capable of completing English technical documentation and cross-border technical communication independently, collaborate with global team.

• Pneumatic/Hydraulic/Electrical knowledge is a plus.

• Ability to independently think, make and execute problem solving proposals

• Knowledge of techniques and tools that promote effective analysis; ability to determine the root cause of problems and create alternative solutions

• Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques

• Good project management and risk management skill

• High ability to work independently, High sense of responsibility

• Creativeness for driving innovative solutions, Strong analytical skills

• Team player and good communication skills for communication on all hierarchical levels internal as well as external

• Willing to Lean

• Readiness for business trip on customer/supplier side

Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines.
Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries.
We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Bühler (China) Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd, è stata fondata nel 2012 a Wuxi, provincia di Jiangsu. Come quartier generale di Bühler Die Casting Greater China, l'azienda è diventata nel 2018 la terza base di produzione per una gamma completa di macchine da colata che forniscono il mondo, dopo la Svizzera e gli Stati Uniti, in grado di soluzioni su misura da macchine da colata singola per completare le isole die castingBuhler (China) Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd. ha realizzato una nuova serie di layout della linea di produzione, rispettivamente da Shanghai, Shenzhen, Hefei a Wuxi. Ora l'azienda è diventata un fornitore completo di soluzioni di prodotto che integra R&D, vendite, produzione, servizio, applicazione, esecuzione del progetto e gestione dei prodotti, servendo i clienti in tutto il mondo con tecnologia all'avanguardia di fascia alta e qualità di precisione.

Aufgaben:
• Seguire il processo di Buhler M2M, portare nuovo sviluppo del prodotto da kick-off alla produzione di massa, tradurre VOC in requisiti, la definizione delle specifiche tecniche proprie, progettazione, simulazione, sviluppo e validazione.

• Sviluppare assemblaggi e macchine complete allineate con automazione/idraulico/tecnica/manufacturing/e requisiti di costo, fornire una serie completa di documenti di produzione, tra cui modelli CAD 3D / disegni di fabbricazione / prodotti BOM / documenti tecnici.

• Lavorare in modo trasversale con il team di progettazione HQ, la catena di fornitura / qualità / servizio clienti per supportare lo sviluppo dei componenti, l'audit dei fornitori e il controllo della qualità del processo.

• Seguire gli standard di ingegneria globali, applicare correttamente le specifiche di disegno, ISO GPS di base, analisi di stack-up di tolleranza e controllo di configurazione per garantire uscite tecniche conformi e coerenti.

• Meccanica Gestione del ciclo di vita per l'uscita dei prodotti, manutenzione dei prodotti esistenti, supporto alla produzione e al cliente per qualsiasi richiesta tecnica e sviluppare soluzioni su di esso.

• Problemi tecnici del prodotto cross-funzionali di piombo risolvono o 8D, causa principale analisi e implementare azioni correttive per garantire la produzione e la consegna stabili.

• Altri compiti assegnati dal gestore

Anforderungen:
• Laurea o superiore in progettazione meccanica o laurea, più di 7 anni di esperienza lavorativa relativa in meccanica; master di grado, più di 5 anni di esperienza lavorativa relativa in meccanica

• Progettazione indipendente di una macchina o parte del sistema

• Responsabilità tecnica dei prodotti assegnati

• Ben familiare con il processo di routing di produzione completa, le proprietà master di diverse materie prime di ingegneria, le specifiche di formatura della lamiera e gli standard tecnici dei metodi di assemblaggio meccanico nucleo come le articolazioni bullonate.

• Proficiente in Microsoft Office Suite, esperto in strumenti CAD 3D mainstream (Creo e UG, ecc.), l'esperienza di lavoro sull'analisi degli elementi finiti (FEA) è un vantaggio forte.

• Familiare con struttura meccanica, principi meccanici e calcolo meccanico

• Conoscenza del processo di fabbricazione meccanica

• Buono inglese sia orale che scritto, in grado di completare la documentazione tecnica inglese e la comunicazione tecnica transfrontaliera indipendentemente, collaborare con il team globale.

• La conoscenza pneumatica/idraulica/elettrica è un plus.

• Capacità di pensare indipendentemente, fare ed eseguire proposte di problem solving

• Conoscenza delle tecniche e degli strumenti che promuovono un'analisi efficace; capacità di determinare la causa principale dei problemi e creare soluzioni alternative

• Comprensione di efficaci concetti di comunicazione, strumenti e tecniche

• Buona gestione del progetto e capacità di gestione del rischio

• Alta capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente, Alto senso di responsabilità

• Creatività per la guida di soluzioni innovative, Forti competenze analitiche

• Team player e buone capacità di comunicazione per la comunicazione su tutti i livelli gerarchici interni ed esterni

• Willing a Lean

• Prontezza per viaggio d'affari sul lato cliente/fornitore
