Jetzt ist das Unternehmen zu einem umfassenden Anbieter von Produktlösungen geworden, der F & E, Vertrieb, Produktion, Service, Anwendung, Projektdurchführung und Produktmanagement integriert und Kunden weltweit mit erstklassiger Spitzentechnologie und Präzisionsqualität bedient.

Aufgaben:

• Baugruppen und komplette Maschinen entwickeln, die auf Automatisierungs-/Hydraulik-/Technik-/Fertigungs-/ und Kostenanforderungen ausgerichtet sind, liefern einen vollständigen Satz von Produktionsdokumenten, einschließlich 3D-CAD-Modellen/Fertigungszeichnungen/Produktstücklisten/technischen Dokumenten.

jobs.description:
Join Bühler's Wheat & Rye Business Unit and help shape the future of grain processing. As a Senior Process Engineer Innovation Wheat & Rye, you will play a key role in driving technological advancements across the entire machine-to-market process. Reporting to the Head of Process Technology Innovation, you will leverage your process expertise to evaluate and develop innovative technologies, machines, automation, and digital solutions, while creating technology concepts for customer projects and strategic inquiries that deliver sustainable value to the global milling industry.

Aufgaben:
• You drive innovation in wheat and rye milling by developing future-focused process solutions from concept to successful implementation

• You lead the integration of process technology, machinery, automation, and digitalization to create efficient, cost-effective, state-of-the-art milling solutions

• You validate and optimize concepts through trials, pilot projects, customer applications, and selected plant start-ups

• You provide technological leadership and hands-on process expertise to support Sales, Quotation, Fulfillment, and R&D teams while building milling knowledge through training and coaching

• You bring deep milling expertise, strong problem-solving and communication skills, proficiency with Bühler control systems, fluency in German and English, and a willingness to travel internationally

Anforderungen:
• Extensive milling expertise, supported by an SMS (Swiss Milling School) or DMSB (Deutsche Müllerschule Braunschweig) diploma and at least 7 years of progressive experience in milling operations as a Technologist, Head Miller, or Production Manager

• Solid understanding of Bühler milling equipment and control systems combined with systematic and efficient problem-solving skills

• Collaborative mindset with the ability to work effectively in multicultural teams, manage conflicts, and build strong professional relationships

• Proactive, creative, and self-motivated personality with a market-oriented approach, professional presence, and willingness to travel internationally up to 30%

• Excellent communication, consulting, and time-management abilities, with fluency in German and English

Wir bieten:
Attractive vacation entitlement
Enough time for relaxation and personal interests - we offer from 25 to 30 days of vacation per year depending on age.

Attractive mobility concept
We offer an OSTWIND ZVV / Z-Pass + half-fare travelcard for CHF 365 + CHF 400 public transport credit as well as an attractive first-class travelcard or free parking.

VIVA Restaurant
We offer our employees a daily fitness menu from 9, 00 CHF.

Employer-funded pension plan
The Bühler Pension Fund offers Bühler employees an independent pension fund that ensures reliable financial security in retirement: www.pk-buhler.ch

Health-Port
We are committed to preventive health care through laboratory analyses, massages, nutritional advice, physiotherapy, group courses and a company doctor.

Sports activities
We promote physical activity through self-organized circuit training and running groups as well as vouchers for Update and Activ Fitness.

Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines.
Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries.
We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

• Conduci l'integrazione di tecnologie di processo, macchinari, automazione e digitalizzazione per creare soluzioni di fresatura efficienti, convenienti e all'avanguardia

• Convalida e ottimizza i concetti attraverso prove, progetti pilota, applicazioni dei clienti e start-up degli impianti selezionati

• Porti competenze di fresatura profonda, forti capacità di problem solving e comunicazione, competenza con sistemi di controllo Bühler, fluency in tedesco e inglese, e la volontà di viaggiare a livello internazionale

Anforderungen:
• Ampia esperienza di fresatura, supportata da un diploma SMS (Swiss Milling School) o DMSB (Deutsche Müllerschule Braunschweig) e almeno 7 anni di esperienza progressiva nelle operazioni di fresatura come Technologist, Head Miller o Production Manager

• Solida comprensione delle apparecchiature di fresatura Bühler e dei sistemi di controllo combinati con capacità di problem solving sistematiche ed efficienti

• Mindset collaborativo con la capacità di lavorare efficacemente in team multiculturali, gestire i conflitti e costruire forti relazioni professionali

• Personalità attiva, creativa e automotivata con un approccio orientato al mercato, presenza professionale e disponibilità a viaggiare a livello internazionale fino al 30%

• Ottima capacità di comunicazione, consulenza e gestione del tempo, con fluidità in tedesco e inglese

Attraente diritto di vacanza
Abbastanza tempo per il relax e gli interessi personali - offriamo da 25 a 30 giorni di vacanza all'anno a seconda dell'età.

Concetto di mobilità attraente
Offriamo una OSTWIND ZVV / Z-Pass + mezza carta di viaggio per CHF 365 + CHF 400 credito di trasporto pubblico, nonché una attraente carta di viaggio di prima classe o un parcheggio gratuito.

Ristorante VIVA
Offriamo ai nostri dipendenti un menu di fitness giornaliero da 9, 00 CHF.

Piano pensionistico finanziato dal datore di lavoro
Il Bühler Pension Fund offre ai dipendenti Bühler un fondo pensione indipendente che garantisce una sicurezza finanziaria affidabile in pensione: www.pk-buhler.ch

Salute-Porto
Ci impegniamo per l'assistenza sanitaria preventiva attraverso analisi di laboratorio, massaggi, consulenza nutrizionale, fisioterapia, corsi di gruppo e un medico aziendale.

Attività sportive
Promuoviamo l'attività fisica attraverso la formazione di circuiti auto-organizzati e gruppi in esecuzione, nonché buoni per l'aggiornamento e l'attivazione di fitness.

Due miliardi di persone mangiano cibo ogni giorno che è stato prodotto con attrezzature Bühler. Un miliardo di persone guidano veicoli le cui parti sono state prodotte con le nostre macchine.
Bühler si propone di bilanciare l'umanità, la natura e l'economia in ogni decisione, sviluppando soluzioni che sbloccano opportunità di business sostenibili nel settore alimentare, alimentare e della mobilità globale.
Ci sforziamo di creare innovazioni per un mondo migliore, con un focus speciale su soluzioni sane, sicure e sostenibili. Pertanto, ci impegniamo con clienti, start-up, multinazionali e accademia per accelerare l'impatto insieme.

Am Standort Beilngries widmen sich rund 360 Mitarbeitende im Geschäftsbereich Grain Quality and Supply dem Anlagen- und Maschinenbau rund um die Themen Getreideverarbeitung sowie Mälzen & Brauen.
Dies umfasst die Reinigung, Trocknung, den Transport (inkl. Fördertechnik und Schiffsbeladung), die Lagerung und Digitalisierung, um Getreide vom Feld bis zum Verbraucher zu verarbeiten. Immer mit dem Fokus auf Effizienz, Produktqualität und Nachhaltigkeit.

Starte deine Ausbildung bei Bühler in Beilngries und freu dich auf:

Zwei Milliarden Menschen essen täglich Lebensmittel, die auf Anlagen von Bühler hergestellt wurden. Eine Milliarde Menschen reisen in Fahrzeugen, deren Teile mit Technologien von Bühler produziert wurden.

Ausbildungsjahr in Wasserburg am Inn, danach in Lauingen. Damit sind wir ein Unternehmen, das langfristig denkt und investiert - bei Innovationen, unseren Mitarbeitenden und dem wirtschaftlichen Erfolg. Sempre con l'obiettivo di efficienza, qualità del prodotto e sostenibilità. > > Inizi il tuo apprendistato a Bühler in Beilngries e attendi con ansia: <ul> <ι> < > > > < > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > ι > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > Un miliardo di persone viaggiano in veicoli le cui parti sono state prodotte utilizzando le tecnologie Bühler. > Con ogni decisione, Bühler persegue l'obiettivo di conciliare le esigenze dell'economia, delle persone e della natura. In questo modo, sviluppiamo soluzioni che aprono opportunità di business sostenibili nel settore alimentare, alimentare e della mobilità globale. > Vogliamo creare innovazioni per un mondo migliore, con particolare attenzione alle soluzioni sane, sicure e sostenibili. Ecco perché lavoriamo con clienti, start-up, multinazionali e scienziati per ottenere un impatto più veloce insieme.

Compiti:
• Come pianificatore di sistema tecnico (m/f/d), contribuisci in modo significativo ai nostri progetti clienti.
• Imparerai a progettare attrezzature complete per i nostri clienti in AutoCAD 3D e a creare set di dati completi per l'ordinazione di macchine e piani di assemblaggio.
• Con questo scopo, progetta tutte le macchine utilizzate in base all'ordine in termini di scopo e prestazioni e progettale nel modello 3D in conformità con l'applicazione.
• Da questo, si creano tutti i disegni necessari per la costruzione dell'impianto e sono responsabili della sua completezza tecnica.
• Lei è responsabile dell'esecuzione di progetti di impianti in modo orientato al cliente, nonché per l'analisi di documenti tecnici e l'utilizzo di loro come ordini.
• La formazione di solito dura 3,5 anni, la scuola professionale è nel primo anno di formazione a Wasserburg am Inn, poi a Lauingen.

Requisiti
• Sei interessato alla tecnologia e ti senti come lavorare con i modelli 3D.
• Inoltre, siete impegnati e affidabili, il lavoro di squadra è divertente.
• Con il diploma di scuola media e i buoni voti in matematica, i soggetti scientifici e l'inglese, hai esattamente ragione con noi.

• E dopo l'allenamento?
• Dopo la laurea, è possibile supportare il nostro dipartimento di ingegneria come pianificatore di sistema tecnico (m/f/d).
• O cogliere l'opportunità di allenarsi in vari modi (tecnico, ingegneria meccanica o simile).
• I nostri esperti e manager di domani sono costruiti preferibilmente all'interno delle nostre fila, a condizione che siano altamente disposti a svolgere e lavorare.

Offriamo:
• Cultura aziendale familiare
• Abbiamo più di 160 anni di storia. Questo ci rende una società che pensa e investe a lungo termine – in innovazione, i nostri dipendenti e il successo economico.

Eventi e eventi di squadra
Il vostro impegno ci rende possibile. Vogliamo festeggiare insieme a te. Le nostre feste di Natale, feste estive, eventi sportivi e eventi di squadra offrono le migliori opportunità per farlo.

Posto di lavoro moderno con le migliori attrezzature tecniche
Lavorare in un luogo di lavoro moderno dotato degli ultimi strumenti tecnici per aumentare la produttività e l'innovazione.

Vantaggi e sconti dei dipendenti
Godetevi una varietà di vantaggi e sconti per i dipendenti che rendono la vostra vita quotidiana più facile. Diventa parte della nostra squadra e scopri di più.

Sviluppo professionale e personale
Offriamo una vasta gamma di opportunità di apprendimento, come video, formazione online, formazione faccia a faccia e webinar con formati brevi, rilevanti, coinvolgenti, personalizzati e mobili.

Ottimo caffè e frutta fresca
Godetevi i nostri servizi, come caffè premium gratuito e frutta fresca - per il vostro perfetto inizio della giornata!

Due miliardi di persone mangiano cibo prodotto nelle piante di Bühler ogni giorno. Un miliardo di persone viaggiano in veicoli le cui parti sono state prodotte utilizzando le tecnologie Bühler.
Con ogni decisione, Bühler persegue l'obiettivo di conciliare le esigenze dell'economia, delle persone e della natura. In questo modo, sviluppiamo soluzioni che aprono opportunità di business sostenibili nel settore alimentare, alimentare e della mobilità globale.
Vogliamo innovare per un mondo migliore, con particolare attenzione alle soluzioni sane, sicure e sostenibili. Ecco perché lavoriamo con clienti, start-up, multinazionali e scienziati per ottenere un impatto più veloce insieme.
descriptionByLocale.en:
At the Beilngries site, around 360 employees in the Grain Quality and Supply division are dedicated to plant and mechanical engineering in the areas of grain processing and malt & brewing.
This includes cleaning, drying, transport (including conveying equipment and ship loading), storage and digitization to process grain from the field to the consumer. Always with the focus on efficiency, product quality and sustainability.

Start your apprenticeship at Bühler in Beilngries and look forward to:
  • Starting bonus 500, - Euro + additional bonuses for your good performance
  • 1 week of paid learning leave
  • Azubi car for trips to vocational school
  • Exciting apprenticeship projects and excursions
  • Corporate benefits for many shops
  • International open doors thanks to our locations around the world

Let us at Bühler make a difference together!
Two billion people eat food produced on Bühler plants every day. One billion people travel in vehicles whose parts were produced using Bühler technologies.
With every decision, Bühler pursues the goal of reconciling the needs of the economy, people and nature. In this way, we develop solutions that open up sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed and mobility industries.
We want to create innovations for a better world, with a particular focus on healthy, safe and sustainable solutions. This is why we work with customers, start-ups, multinational corporations and scientists to achieve a faster impact together. Tasks: • As a technical system planner (m/f/d), you contribute significantly to our customer projects. • You will learn to design complete equipment for our customers in AutoCAD 3D and to create complete data sets for ordering machines and assembly plans. • For this purpose, you design all machines used according to the order in terms of purpose and performance and plan them in the 3D model in accordance with the application. • From this, you create all the drawings necessary for the construction of the plant and are responsible for its technical completeness. • You are responsible for executing plant projects in a customer-oriented manner as well as for analyzing technical documents and using them as orders. • The training usually lasts 3.5 years, the vocational school is in the first year of training in Wasserburg am Inn, then in Lauingen. Requirements • You are interested in technology and feel like working with 3D models. • In addition, you are committed and reliable, teamwork is fun. • With the middle school degree and good grades in mathematics, the science subjects and English, you are exactly right with us. • And after the training? • After graduation, you can support our engineering department as a technical system planner (m/f/d). • Or take the opportunity to train yourself in various ways (technician, mechanical engineering or similar). • Our experts and managers of tomorrow are preferably built up from within our own ranks, provided that they are highly willing to perform and work. We offer: • Family business culture • We have more than 160 years of history. This makes us a company that thinks and invests in the long term – in innovation, our employees and economic success. Team events and events Your commitment makes it possible for us. We want to celebrate this together with you. Our Christmas parties, summer parties, sporting events and team events offer the best opportunities to do so. Modern workplace with the best technical equipment Work in a modern workplace equipped with the latest technical tools to boost your productivity and innovation. Employee benefits and discounts Enjoy a variety of employee benefits and discounts that make your everyday life easier. Become part of our team and find out more. Professional and personal development We offer a wide range of learning opportunities, such as videos, online training, face-to-face training and webinars with short, relevant, engaging, personalised and mobile formats. Great coffee and fresh fruit Enjoy our amenities, such as free premium coffee and fresh fruit - for your perfect start to the day! Two billion people eat food produced at Bühler plants every day. One billion people travel in vehicles whose parts were produced using Bühler technologies. With every decision, Bühler pursues the goal of reconciling the needs of the economy, people and nature. In this way, we develop solutions that open up sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed and mobility industries. We want to innovate for a better world, with a particular focus on healthy, safe and sustainable solutions. This is why we work with customers, start-ups, multinational corporations and scientists to achieve a faster impact together.

jobs.title: Junior Mechanical Designer
jobs.description:
We're looking for a Mechanical Designer with 3-5 years of experience who can support design work from concept to execution to meet project specifications, optimize design quality and usability, and work closely with cross-functional teams to achieve efficient, manufacturable, and high-value engineering outcomes.

Aufgaben:
• Produce high-quality deliverables such as equipment models and manufacturing drawings using Autodesk Inventor.

• Generate sales drawings using Inventor and AutoCAD.

• Ensure technical compliance and proper fit and function.

• Present work clearly - sharing rationale, incorporating feedback, and driving toward decisions.

• Manage workload priorities to adhere to budget constraints and project timelines.

• Resolve discrepancies that occur during the design and manufacture of Buhler equipment.

• Perform inspections of components, work-in-process, and finished equipment.

• Organize information on project specific SharePoint sites.

• Actively participate in project meetings with cross-functional team members, suppliers, and/or customers.

• Complete design related tasks resulting from equipment installation issues at customer site.

Anforderungen:
Job Specifications
 (Required education and experience)

• Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent

• 3-5 years of relevant work experience

PREFERRED SKILLS

• Proficient in engineering drafting/drawings and engineering principles.

• Working knowledge of manufacturing and assembly practices, e.g. welding, sheet metal forming, press operations, etc.

• Awareness of machine safety codes and designing equipment for the food industry.

• Understanding of GD&T

• Autodesk Inventor and AutoCAD

• PTC Windchill

Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines.

jobs.title: Outsourcing Buyer
jobs.description:
The Buyer will support the organization by ensuring the on-going availability of material and components to meet project requirements. The Buyer is accountable for component cost, quality, and delivery requirements supporting needs of the engineering, design, and manufacturing environment.

Experience in a manufacturing environment with the ability to read drawings and specifications for machining, fabrication, and assembly.
Key for success in this position is the ability to evaluate supplier capabilities and match best suppliers with best products.
The Buyer will use qualitative and quantitative analysis of data to maintain an overall view of cost, schedule, and quality. The Buyer represents Bühler interests globally for key supplier relationships, and internal and external stakeholders to ensure consistency with corporate guidelines and business strategies. Aufgaben: • Manage commodities and competitive sources of supply • Plan, prioritize, and manage multiple work assignments using strong organizational skills • Negotiate with suppliers on cost, quality, and lead-time to obtain the maximum value for the company • Develop, implement, and drive procurement strategies to meet cost savings targets • Perform regular performance reviews with key suppliers to drive continuous improvements • Ensure commercial, legal, and contractual compliance in all procurement transactions • Perform all associated detailed work commensurate with the position, such as: • Understand requirements for items to be purchased. • Confer with vendors to obtain product or service information such as price, availability, and delivery schedule. • Prepare and submit purchase orders. • Track all orders to ensure timely and accurate delivery. • Contact vendors with discrepancies on quantity and quality to resolve issues. • Interface with all departments to resolve issues with purchased items. • Manage inventory. • Generate monthly forecasts to ensure long lead time material is available when needed, as required. • Reconcile billing summaries from main vendors/suppliers, as required. • Support and provide back-up and assistance to other buyers as needed. • Monitor the suppliers; quality/cost/delivery performance on a regular basis. • In the event of major disruption which would have significant effect upon delivery, quality or availability, direct necessary actions with the supplier in collaboration with the project managers or design team to reduce the impact. • Evaluate the status of all purchased components/materials for active projects to prioritize and communicate issues with the project teams, other buyers, and managers. Anforderungen: - Experience in Machining or Fabrication. • Ability to read and interpret component part drawings and specifications. • Bachelor's degree is preferred. • Experience in an SAP or ERP environment is a plus. • High level of intellectual curiosity, self-motivation, ownership, sense of urgency and positive engagement. • Experience working with Microsoft Office Suite (basic skills in Excel and Word) Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. jobs.description:

• Take the lead and manage the project during commissioning and communicate with the customer, project manager and team manager on a regularly basis to ensure projects run smoothly with normal progress.

• Start up the plant or equipment with product and adjust process to ensure plant is running efficiently on contractual performance.

• Graduate of Engineering degree or related field

• Minimum 1 year experience in flour milling

• A miller apprenticeship is preferred

• Strong interpersonal and teamwork skills

• Excellent problem solving skills

• Good written and oral communication skills

Nos technologies de film mince sont utilisées dans les systèmes de revêtement sous vide pour fabriquer des fenêtres, smartphones, écrans d'affichage, panneaux solaires, composants automobiles, matériel décoratif et plus encore.

En tant que machiniste CNC, vous serez propriétaire de tâches complexes d'usinage, travaillant de façon indépendante pour produire des composants de haute qualité tout en vous assurant que les objectifs de production sont atteints efficacement et en toute sécurité. Vous aurez l'occasion de collaborer avec des ingénieurs expérimentés sur des projets de production et de recherche et développement, vous exposant à une variété de travaux stimulants et enrichissants. Aufgaben: • Produire un produit de qualité de manière efficace • Traduire avec précision les plans de fabrication de pièces • Suivez tous les ordres de travail et les voyageurs que l'entreprise fournira • Suivre toutes les normes de qualité fixées par l'entreprise • Suivre toutes les règles de sécurité • Maintenir une zone de travail propre, organisée et exempte de débris • Configurations préformées précises dans les machines CNC sur leur propre • Pratiquer les compétences de fabrication maigre dans tous les domaines de la boutique • Maintenir une attitude positive et s'efforcer d'améliorer continuellement • Réduire les coûts de fabrication lorsque c'est possible • Rester proactif à tout moment • Maître Cam connaissance ou prêt à apprendre • Capacité de base de lire et de programmer en utilisant les codes G & M au contrôleur • Capacité à fabriquer leurs propres mâchoires de fixation et de viscosité • Volonté de former d'autres membres de l'équipe - C'est pas vrai. • Produire un produit de qualité de manière efficace Deux milliards de personnes mangent chaque jour de la nourriture produite avec des équipements Bühler. Un milliard de personnes conduisent des véhicules dont les pièces ont été fabriquées avec nos machines. Bühler vise à équilibrer l'humanité, la nature et l'économie dans chaque décision en développant des solutions qui ouvrent des opportunités commerciales durables dans les industries mondiales de l'alimentation humaine, de l'alimentation animale et de la mobilité. Nous nous efforçons de créer des innovations pour un monde meilleur, en mettant l'accent sur des solutions saines, sûres et durables. Par conséquent, nous faisons équipe avec les clients, les start-up, les multinationales et les universités pour accélérer l'impact ensemble.

jobs.title: Solution Architect SAP PS & SD
jobs.description: Are you passionate about designing innovative SAP solutions and shaping the next generation of business processes? Join our team and play a key role in shaping and implementing the end-to-end architecture for customer project processes across SAP PS & SD, and surrounding systems. Combining architectural responsibility with hands-on development, you will collaborate with Product Owners, development teams, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable, integrated, and future-ready solutions for our global organization. Aufgaben: • You shape the SAP solution architecture for customer project management across SAP PS & SD and related custom solutions, ensuring alignment with strategic business objectives and enterprise standards • You design and specify technical solutions, either implementing them hands-on or guiding their delivery from concept to completion • You partner with Product Owners, Product Managers, and agile teams to refine, deliver, and operate solutions across the entire product lifecycle • You ensure seamless integration between SAP PS & SD, other SAP modules, and external systems to support efficient end-to-end business processes • You provide expert 3rd-level support, troubleshoot complex issues, and coordinate with stakeholders to ensure timely resolution of incidents and requests Anforderungen: • Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field (e.g., HF, FH, university, or an internationally equivalent qualification) • 5+ years of professional experience, including 3+ years in SAP solution architecture, development, or a comparable technical SAP role; agile experience (Scrum, SAFe) is a plus • Deep expertise in SAP PS and/or SD is ideal. What matters most is a strong architectural mindset across SAP modules, so candidates with deep expertise in another area such as FI/CO who bring broad SAP knowledge and a track record of designing integrated solutions are equally encouraged to apply • Strong hands-on expertise in ABAP and ABAP OO development, including custom programs, enhancements, BAPIs, and BADIs; BTP, OData, and CDS experience is a plus • Proven ability to take ownership, proactively drive initiatives and solutions, solve complex problems, and collaborate effectively across technical and business teams, combined with fluent business-level English Wir bieten: Attractive vacation entitlement Enough time for relaxation and personal interests - we offer from 25 to 30 days of vacation per year depending on age. Attractive mobility concept We offer an OSTWIND ZVV / Z-Pass + half-fare travelcard for CHF 365 + CHF 400 public transport credit as well as an attractive first-class travelcard or free parking. VIVA Restaurant We offer our employees a daily fitness menu from 9, 00 CHF. Employer-funded pension plan The Bühler Pension Fund offers Bühler employees an independent pension fund that ensures reliable financial security in retirement: www.pk-buhler.ch Health-Port We are committed to preventive health care through laboratory analyses, massages, nutritional advice, physiotherapy, group courses and a company doctor. Sports activities We promote physical activity through self-organized circuit training and running groups as well as vouchers for Update and Activ Fitness. Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines. Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries. We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sei appassionato di progettare soluzioni SAP innovative e modellare la prossima generazione di processi aziendali? Unisciti al nostro team e gioca un ruolo chiave nella modellazione e nell'implementazione dell'architettura end-to-end per i processi di progetto dei clienti in SAP PS & SD e nei sistemi circostanti. Combinando la responsabilità architettonica con lo sviluppo pratico, collaborerai con i Proprietari del Prodotto, i team di sviluppo e gli stakeholder aziendali per fornire soluzioni scalabili, integrate e future per la nostra organizzazione globale. >

Aufgaben:
• L'architettura della soluzione SAP per la gestione del progetto dei clienti attraverso SAP PS & SD e le relative soluzioni personalizzate, garantendo l'allineamento con gli obiettivi strategici aziendali e gli standard aziendali

• Progettare e specificare soluzioni tecniche, sia implementando loro hands-on o guidando la loro consegna dal concetto al completamento

• Collaborate con Product Owners, Product Manager e team agili per perfezionare, fornire e gestire soluzioni in tutto il ciclo di vita del prodotto

• Garantisci un'integrazione senza soluzione di continuità tra SAP PS & SD, altri moduli SAP e sistemi esterni per supportare processi aziendali end-to-end efficienti

• Fornisci un supporto esperto di terzo livello, risolvere problemi complessi, e coordinare con gli stakeholder per garantire una risoluzione tempestiva di incidenti e richieste

Anforderungen:
• Laurea in Informatica, Informatica, o in un campo relativo (ad esempio, HF, FH, università, o una qualifica equivalente a livello internazionale)

• 5+ anni di esperienza professionale, tra cui 3+ anni in SAP soluzione architettura, sviluppo, o un ruolo SAP tecnico comparabile; l'esperienza agile (Scrum, SAFe) è un plus

• La profonda esperienza in SAP PS e/o SD è ideale. Ciò che conta di più è una forte mentalità architettonica tra i moduli SAP, quindi i candidati con una profonda esperienza in un altro settore come FI/CO che portano una vasta conoscenza SAP e un track record di progettazione di soluzioni integrate sono ugualmente incoraggiati ad applicare

• Forte esperienza pratica nello sviluppo ABAP e ABAP OO, tra cui programmi personalizzati, miglioramenti, BAPI e BADI; BTP, OData e CDS esperienza è un plus

• Prova capacità di prendere la proprietà, guidare proattivamente iniziative e soluzioni, risolvere problemi complessi, e collaborare efficacemente tra team tecnici e aziendali, combinato con fluente business-level inglese

Wir bieten:
Attraente diritto di vacanza
Abbastanza tempo per il relax e gli interessi personali - offriamo da 25 a 30 giorni di vacanza all'anno a seconda dell'età.

Concetto di mobilità attraente
Offriamo una tessera di viaggio OSTWIND ZV/Z-Pass + mezza strada per CHF 365 + CHF 400 credito di trasporto pubblico, nonché una attraente carta di viaggio di prima classe o un parcheggio gratuito.

Ristorante VIVA
Offriamo ai nostri dipendenti un menu di fitness giornaliero da 9, 00 CHF.

Piano pensionistico finanziato dal datore di lavoro
Il Bühler Pension Fund offre ai dipendenti Bühler un fondo pensione indipendente che garantisce una sicurezza finanziaria affidabile in pensione: www.pk-buhler.ch

Salute-Porto
Ci impegniamo nell'assistenza sanitaria preventiva attraverso analisi di laboratorio, massaggi, consigli nutrizionali, fisioterapia, corsi di gruppo e un medico aziendale.

Attività sportive
Promuoviamo l'attività fisica attraverso la formazione di circuiti auto-organizzati e gruppi in esecuzione, nonché buoni per l'aggiornamento e l'attivazione di fitness.

Due miliardi di persone mangiano cibo ogni giorno che è stato prodotto con attrezzature Bühler. Un miliardo di persone guidano veicoli le cui parti sono state prodotte con le nostre macchine.
Bühler si propone di bilanciare l'umanità, la natura e l'economia in ogni decisione, sviluppando soluzioni che sbloccano opportunità di business sostenibili nei settori alimentare, alimentare e della mobilità globale.
Ci sforziamo di creare innovazioni per un mondo migliore, con un focus speciale su soluzioni sane, sicure e sostenibili. Pertanto, ci impegniamo con clienti, start-up, multinazionali e accademia per accelerare l'impatto insieme.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Haben Sie eine Leidenschaft für innovative SAP-Lösungen und die Gestaltung der nächsten Generation von Geschäftsprozessen? Treten Sie unserem Team bei und spielen Sie eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Gestaltung und Implementierung der End-to-End-Architektur für Kundenprojektprozesse in SAP PS & SD und Umgebungssystemen. Durch die Kombination von architektonischer Verantwortung mit praktischer Entwicklung arbeiten Sie mit Product Ownern, Entwicklungsteams und geschäftlichen Stakeholdern zusammen, um skalierbare, integrierte und zukunftsfähige Lösungen für unsere globale Organisation zu liefern. </stark>

Aufgaben:
• Sie gestalten die SAP-Lösungsarchitektur für das Kundenprojektmanagement in SAP PS & SD und verwandten kundenspezifischen Lösungen, um die Ausrichtung auf strategische Geschäftsziele und Unternehmensstandards sicherzustellen

• Sie entwerfen und spezifizieren technische Lösungen, die Sie entweder praktisch umsetzen oder ihre Lieferung vom Konzept bis zur Fertigstellung steuern

• Sie arbeiten mit Product Ownern, Produktmanagern und agilen Teams zusammen, um Lösungen über den gesamten Produktlebenszyklus hinweg zu verfeinern, zu liefern und zu betreiben.

• Sie gewährleisten eine nahtlose Integration zwischen SAP PS & SD, anderen SAP-Modulen und externen Systemen, um effiziente End-to-End-Geschäftsprozesse zu unterstützen.

• Sie bieten kompetenten 3rd-Level-Support, beheben komplexe Probleme und stimmen sich mit Stakeholdern ab, um eine zeitnahe Lösung von Vorfällen und Anfragen zu gewährleisten.

Anforderungen:
• Abschluss in Informationstechnologie, Informatik oder einem verwandten Bereich (z. B. HF, FH, Universität oder eine international gleichwertige Qualifikation)

• 5+ Jahre Berufserfahrung, davon 3+ Jahre in SAP-Lösungsarchitektur, -entwicklung oder eine vergleichbare technische SAP-Rolle; agile Erfahrung (Scrum, SAFe) ist ein Plus

• Tiefe Expertise in SAP PS und / oder SD ist ideal. Was am wichtigsten ist, ist eine starke architektonische Denkweise in SAP-Modulen, so dass Kandidaten mit fundierter Expertise in einem anderen Bereich wie FI / CO, die ein breites SAP-Wissen und eine Erfolgsbilanz bei der Entwicklung integrierter Lösungen mitbringen, gleichermaßen ermutigt werden, sich zu bewerben.

• Starke praktische Expertise in der ABAP- und ABAP-OO-Entwicklung, einschließlich benutzerdefinierter Programme, Erweiterungen, BAPIs und BADIs; BTP-, OData- und CDS-Erfahrung ist ein Plus

• Bewährte Fähigkeit, Eigenverantwortung zu übernehmen, Initiativen und Lösungen proaktiv voranzutreiben, komplexe Probleme zu lösen und effektiv in technischen und geschäftlichen Teams zusammenzuarbeiten, kombiniert mit fließendem Englisch auf Geschäftsebene

Wir bieten:
Attraktive Urlaubsberechtigung
Genug Zeit für Entspannung und persönliche Interessen - wir bieten von 25 bis 30 Tagen Urlaub pro Jahr je nach Alter.

Attraktives Mobilitätskonzept
Wir bieten eine OSTWIND ZVV / Z-Pass + Halbtax-Fahrkarte für CHF 365 + CHF 400 öffentlicher Nahverkehrsguthaben sowie eine attraktive First-Class-Fahrkarte oder kostenlose Parkplätze an.

VIVA Restaurant
Wir bieten unseren Mitarbeitern ein tägliches Fitnessmenü ab 9.00 CHF.

Arbeitgeberfinanzierte Altersversorgung
Die Bühler Pensionskasse bietet Bühler Mitarbeitern eine unabhängige Pensionskasse, die eine zuverlässige finanzielle Absicherung im Ruhestand gewährleistet: www.pk-buhler.ch

Gesundheitshafen
Wir engagieren uns für die präventive Gesundheitsversorgung durch Laboranalysen, Massagen, Ernährungsberatung, Physiotherapie, Gruppenkurse und einen Betriebsarzt.

Sportarten
Wir fördern körperliche Aktivität durch selbstorganisiertes Zirkeltraining und Laufgruppen sowie Gutscheine für Update und Activ Fitness.

Zwei Milliarden Menschen essen täglich Lebensmittel, die mit Bühler-Geräten hergestellt wurden. Eine Milliarde Menschen fahren Fahrzeuge, deren Teile mit unseren Maschinen hergestellt wurden.
Bühler zielt darauf ab, Mensch, Natur und Wirtschaft bei jeder Entscheidung in Einklang zu bringen, indem es Lösungen entwickelt, die nachhaltige Geschäftsmöglichkeiten in der globalen Lebensmittel-, Futtermittel- und Mobilitätsbranche eröffnen.
Wir bemühen uns, Innovationen für eine bessere Welt zu schaffen, mit besonderem Fokus auf gesunde, sichere und nachhaltige Lösungen. Daher arbeiten wir mit Kunden, Start-ups, multinationalen Unternehmen und der akademischen Welt zusammen, um die Wirkung gemeinsam zu beschleunigen.

jobs.title: Lead Supply Chain Planner
jobs.description:
Responsible for overseeing the planning and execution of Supply Chain in Customer Projects. The primary goal is to ensure seamless and accurate scheduling that aligns with business, project, and manufacturing requirements, with a particular emphasis on timely delivery.

Aufgaben:
• Convert business information into demand planning within the system, verify capacity across different factories, and ensure financial performance aligns with targets

• Review quotations to check lead times, consider factory workload in line with the requirements of the business

• Coordinating closely and collaborating with Commercial team, Procurement, Shipping and Manufacturing

• Define supply chain events for all components based on project strategy, lead times and given capacities

• Draft, adjust and update the event schedule and prepare event schedule for kick-off meetings

• Track major events, monitor progress and proactively define actions with the Project Manager, the Supply Chain and Logistics in case of deviation or delay

• Act as Single point of contact within the Sales & Operations Planning Process for Project Manager, Supply Chain and Logistics

• Manage and coordinate factory supplies, ensuring a balanced supply plan that aligns project priorities and factory requirements with the manufacturing planner

Anforderungen:
• Bachelor's Degree in a technical field or equivalent, Master's degree in a technical field will be considered as a plus

• At least seven (7) years of experience in Demand Planning, Supply Chain Management, or Project Supply Planning

• Very good communication skills in English, any additional language will be considered as a plus

• Strong ability in the use of SAP, MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Analysis) and SAP IBP

• Strong customer focused problem solving and conflict management skills

• Team spirit and well-developed communication skills as well as the ability to work within an interdisciplinary and international environment

Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines.
Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries.
We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

jobs.title: Senior PLC Software Development Engineer
jobs.description:
Join Bühler's Business Area Value Nutrition and help shape the next generation of automation and software solutions for advanced machine control systems. In this role within R&D, you will combine PLC programming, modern software development, and interdisciplinary collaboration to develop reliable, efficient, and high-performing solutions that support our customers in achieving outstanding process and product quality.

Aufgaben:
• You develop and implement PLC software for machine control systems, primarily using Siemens automation platforms; Rockwell knowledge is an advantage

• You design, implement, and maintain visualization software, including C# backend services and Angular-based frontend applications

• You analyze technical requirements and translate them into robust automation and software solutions aligned with engineering standards and best practices

• You collaborate closely with electrical, mechanical, process, and project teams, including close cooperation with our development team in China

• You support machine commissioning, troubleshooting, optimization, and 3rd-level support for machine control systems and related services, both remotely and on-site when required

Anforderungen:
• Degree in Automation Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Systems Engineering, or a comparable technical field, ideally from a University of Applied Sciences or ETH

• Several years of experience in industrial automation, with solid knowledge of PLC programming, machine control software, relevant automation standards, C# backend development, and ideally Angular, TypeScript, HTML, and CSS frontend development

• Good understanding of software engineering principles, including modular design, testing, version control, and documentation, combined with analytical thinking, strong problem-solving skills and deployment strategies as well as willingness to learn data science, data analytics, and machine learning methods for industrial applications

• Strong communication and collaboration skills in interdisciplinary teams, along with very good English and good German skills

• Willingness to travel up to 10% per year

offriamo da 25 a 30 giorni di vacanza all'anno a seconda dell'età. jobs.description:
Bühler Leybold Optics steht für innovative Technologien und stetiges Wachstum. Als Teil der Bühler Group, einem weltweit agierenden Maschinenbaukonzern mit über 13.000 Mitarbeitenden, sind wir einer der führenden Hersteller von Hightech-Dünnfilm-Vakuumbeschichtungsanlagen. Seit mehr als 150 Jahren bieten wir unseren Kunden ein breites Angebot an Anlagen für die Beschichtung von Architekturglas, Brillengläsern, optischen Komponenten in Smartphones, Autos, Medizintechnik und vielem mehr. Unserem internationalen Team gelingt es tagtäglich neue Maßstäbe zu setzen und komplexe Projekte erfolgreich umzusetzen.

Wir suchen einen hochmotivierten und engagierten Werkstudenten (m/w/d), der unser Team in Alzenau tatkräftig unterstützt. Es warten spannende Aufgaben auf dich, bei denen du deine ausgeprägte Eigeninitiative und Lernbereitschaft unter Beweis stellen kannst. Ergreife deine Chance und werde Teil der Bühler Alzenau GmbH!

Lass uns bei Bühler gemeinsam etwas bewirken!
Zwei Milliarden Menschen essen täglich Lebensmittel, die auf Anlagen von Bühler hergestellt wurden. Eine Milliarde Menschen reisen in Fahrzeugen, deren Teile mit Technologien von Bühler produziert wurden.
Mit jeder Entscheidung verfolgt Bühler das Ziel, die Bedürfnisse von Wirtschaft, Mensch und Natur in Einklang zu bringen. So entwickeln wir Lösungen, die nachhaltige Geschäftsmöglichkeiten in der globalen Lebensmittel-, Futtermittel- und Mobilitätsindustrie eröffnen.
Wir wollen Innovationen für eine bessere Welt schaffen, mit besonderem Fokus auf gesunde, sichere und nachhaltige Lösungen. Deshalb arbeiten wir mit Kunden, Start-ups, multinationalen Konzernen und Wissenschaftlern zusammen, um gemeinsam eine schnellere Wirkung zu erzielen. Aufgaben: • Erstellung, Organisation und Dokumentation sämtlicher Versand- und Zolldokumente, inklusive der Ausstellung von Ausfuhrbegleitdokumenten (ABD) • Vergabe von Transportaufträgen an Spediteure gemäß Auftragsvorgabe • Einholung und Vergleich von transportbezogenen Angeboten sowie Überwachung und Nachverfolgung von Transporten (Tracking, Abholungen, Air Waybill) • Erstellung und Versand von Rechnungen an Kunden • Bearbeitung und Dokumentation von Reklamationen Anforderungen: • Du bist als Student (m/w/d) in einem betriebswirtschaftlichen oder vergleichbaren Studiengang eingeschrieben • Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift • Der sichere Umgang mit MS Office ist für dich selbstverständlich • Ein professionelles Auftreten sowie ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeiten zeichnen dich aus Wir bieten: Teamanlässe und Events Ihr Engagement macht es uns möglich. Das wollen wir gemeinsam mit Ihnen feiern. Unsere Weihnachtsfeiern, Sommerpartys, Sportveranstaltungen und Teamevents bieten die besten Gelegenheiten dazu. Kantine mit gesunden Mahlzeiten Geniessen Sie gesunde Mahlzeiten in unserer Kantine zu fairen Preisen. Interkulturelles Arbeitsumfeld Der Schlüssel zu unserem Erfolg ist unsere vielfältige Belegschaft aus mehr als 100 Nationen und unsere inklusive Kultur. Familiäre Unternehmenskultur Wir haben eine mehr als 160-jährige Geschichte. Damit sind wir ein Unternehmen, das langfristig denkt und investiert - bei Innovationen, unseren Mitarbeitenden und dem wirtschaftlichen Erfolg. Mitarbeitendenvorteile und Rabatte Geniessen Sie eine Vielzahl von Mitarbeitendenvorteilen und Ermässigungen, die Ihren Alltag erleichtern. Werden Sie Teil unseres Teams und erfahren Sie mehr. Moderner Arbeitsplatz mit bester technischer Ausstattung Arbeiten Sie an einem modernen Arbeitsplatz, der mit den neuesten technischen Hilfsmitteln ausgestattet ist, um Ihre Produktivität und Innovation zu fördern. Bühler Leybold Optics stands for innovative technologies and steady growth. As part of the Bühler Group, a global engineering group with over 13,000 employees, we are one of the leading manufacturers of high-tech thin-film vacuum coating systems. For more than 150 years, we have offered our customers a wide range of equipment for the coating of architectural glass, eyeglasses, optical components in smartphones, cars, medical technology and much more. Our international team succeeds in setting new standards every day and successfully implementing complex projects.

We are looking for a highly motivated and committed working student (m/f/d) who actively supports our team in Alzenau. Exciting tasks await you, in which you can prove your pronounced initiative and willingness to learn. Take your chance and become part of Bühler Alzenau GmbH!

Let us make a difference together at Bühler!
Two billion people eat food produced on Bühler plants every day. One billion people travel in vehicles whose parts were produced using Bühler technologies.
With every decision, Bühler pursues the goal of reconciling the needs of the economy, people and nature. In this way, we develop solutions that open up sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed and mobility industries.
We want to create innovations for a better world, with a particular focus on healthy, safe and sustainable solutions. This is why we work with customers, start-ups, multinational corporations and scientists to achieve a faster impact together. jobs.title: Export Compliance Engineer
jobs.description:
Join our team as an Export Compliance Engineer and combine your engineering expertise with international business, technology, and global trade affairs. You will work at the intersection of innovation, international trade, and regulatory compliance, supporting the worldwide delivery of advanced technologies while ensuring adherence to global export control requirements. This role is ideal for engineers who enjoy analyzing technical products and documentation, solving complex challenges, and collaborating with colleagues across engineering, project management, supply chain, and global operations. As part of our Trade Affairs organization, you will help ensure that cutting-edge technologies can be successfully and compliantly deployed around the world.

Aufgaben:
• You evaluate products, technologies, software, and technical data to determine export control classifications (ECN/ECCN) and licensing requirements

• You review technical drawings, engineering documentation, product specifications, and technology transfers to ensure compliance with international export control regulations

• You perform screenings, risk assessments, and end-use/end-user evaluations while supporting global customer projects from offer to delivery

• You maintain export control records, classifications, licenses, and audit-ready documentation to ensure full regulatory compliance and traceability

• You collaborate with engineering, project management, supply chain, and sales teams while driving process improvements, digitalization initiatives, and stakeholder training

Anforderungen:
• University degree in a technical discipline such as Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Automation Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a comparable field; additional knowledge of international trade or compliance is a plus

• Strong analytical skills with the ability to understand and assess technical products, systems, drawings, and documentation

• Independent, structured, and detail- and solution-oriented working style combined with strong cross-functional problem-solving capabilities

• High level of responsibility, reliability, and integrity when dealing with complex technical and regulatory topics; experience with export control regulations or SAP GTS is advantageous

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills with fluency in English; additional languages are a plus

Wir bieten:
Attractive vacation entitlement
Enough time for relaxation and personal interests - we offer from 25 to 30 days of vacation per year depending on age.

Attractive mobility concept
We offer an OSTWIND ZVV / Z-Pass + half-fare travelcard for CHF 365 + CHF 400 public transport credit as well as an attractive first-class travelcard or free parking.

VIVA Restaurant
We offer our employees a daily fitness menu from 9, 00 CHF.

Employer-funded pension plan
The Bühler Pension Fund offers Bühler employees an independent pension fund that ensures reliable financial security in retirement: www.pk-buhler.ch

Health-Port
We are committed to preventive health care through laboratory analyses, massages, nutritional advice, physiotherapy, group courses and a company doctor.

Sports activities
We promote physical activity through self-organized circuit training and running groups as well as vouchers for Update and Activ Fitness.

Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines.
Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries.
We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

Questo ruolo è ideale per gli ingegneri che amano analizzare i prodotti tecnici e la documentazione, risolvere le sfide complesse, e collaborare con colleghi attraverso l'ingegneria, la gestione del progetto, la supply chain e le operazioni globali. Nell'ambito della nostra organizzazione Trade Affairs, vi aiuterà a garantire che le tecnologie all'avanguardia possono essere implementate con successo e conformi in tutto il mondo.

• Si eseguono proiezioni, valutazioni dei rischi e valutazioni end-use/end-user, supportando i progetti globali dei clienti dall'offerta alla consegna

• Mantenete i record di controllo delle esportazioni, le classificazioni, le licenze e la documentazione pronta all'audit per garantire la piena conformità normativa e la tracciabilità

• Collaborate con team di ingegneria, project management, supply chain e vendita, mentre guidate i miglioramenti dei processi, le iniziative di digitalizzazione e la formazione degli stakeholder

Anforderungen:
• Laurea in una disciplina tecnica come ingegneria elettrica, ingegneria elettronica, ingegneria dell'automazione, ingegneria meccanica o un campo comparabile; conoscenza aggiuntiva del commercio internazionale o della conformità è un plus

• Forte capacità analitiche con la capacità di comprendere e valutare prodotti tecnici, sistemi, disegni e documentazione

• Stile di lavoro indipendente, strutturato e dettagliato e orientato alla soluzione combinato con forti capacità di problem solving interfunzionali

• Un alto livello di responsabilità, affidabilità e integrità quando si tratta di argomenti tecnici e normativi complessi; l'esperienza con le normative di controllo delle esportazioni o SAP GTS è vantaggiosa

• Ottima capacità di comunicazione e gestione degli stakeholder con fluidità in inglese; lingue aggiuntive sono un plus

Wir bieten:
Attraente diritto di vacanza
Abbastanza tempo per il relax e gli interessi personali - offriamo da 25 a 30 giorni di vacanza all'anno a seconda dell'età.

Concetto di mobilità attraente
Offriamo una tessera di viaggio OSTWIND ZV/Z-Pass + mezza strada per CHF 365 + CHF 400 credito di trasporto pubblico, nonché una attraente carta di viaggio di prima classe o un parcheggio gratuito.

Ristorante VIVA
Offriamo ai nostri dipendenti un menu di fitness giornaliero da 9, 00 CHF.

Piano pensionistico finanziato dal datore di lavoro
Il Bühler Pension Fund offre ai dipendenti Bühler un fondo pensione indipendente che garantisce una sicurezza finanziaria affidabile in pensione: www.pk-buhler.ch

Salute-Porto
Ci impegniamo nell'assistenza sanitaria preventiva attraverso analisi di laboratorio, massaggi, consigli nutrizionali, fisioterapia, corsi di gruppo e un medico aziendale.

Attività sportive
Promuoviamo l'attività fisica attraverso la formazione di circuiti auto-organizzati e gruppi in esecuzione, nonché buoni per l'aggiornamento e l'attivazione di fitness.

Due miliardi di persone mangiano cibo ogni giorno che è stato prodotto con attrezzature Bühler. Un miliardo di persone guidano veicoli le cui parti sono state prodotte con le nostre macchine.
Bühler si propone di bilanciare l'umanità, la natura e l'economia in ogni decisione, sviluppando soluzioni che sbloccano opportunità di business sostenibili nei settori alimentare, alimentare e della mobilità globale.
Ci sforziamo di creare innovazioni per un mondo migliore, con un focus speciale su soluzioni sane, sicure e sostenibili. Pertanto, ci impegniamo con clienti, start-up, multinazionali e accademia per accelerare l'impatto insieme.

Would you like to accompany people in challenging life situations professionally and promote mental health sustainably? At Bühler, we live health management holistically, forward-looking and transformatively. Anchored in our in-house doctor and prevention practice on site, you actively expand psychosocial counselling as a fixed offer. Accompany employees confidentially and holistically from a single source – a meaningful task with plenty of room for manoeuvre.

Tasks:
• You advise and accompany employees confidentially in psychological, psychosocial and personal challenges

• They identify support needs at an early stage and coordinate the professional triage to internal and external specialist departments

• You work closely with the Bühler healthcare team and other relevant contacts

• They actively shape the further development of our health management and put a special focus on the promotion of mental health

• They ensure seamless and professional documentation in compliance with the highest data protection, confidentiality and quality standards

Requirements
• Completed studies in psychology, social work or Social education with several years of experience in psychosocial counseling and crisis intervention

• Good knowledge of Swiss health and social services

• Strong counselling, communication and social skills coupled with high empathy and empathy

• Absolute trustworthiness, high sensitivity in dealing with confidential health data and an independent, precise and team-oriented way of working

• Flowing German and good English skills as well as security in dealing with the common MS Office applications

We offer:
Attractive holiday entitlement
Sufficient time for recreation and personal interests - we offer from 25 to 30 days of holidays per year depending on the year of life.

Attractive mobility concept
We offer an OSTWIND ZVV / Z-Pass + Half-Tax for 365 CHF + 400CHF public transport credit as well as an attractive first-class subscription or free parking.

Staff restaurant VIVA
We offer our employees a daily fitness menu from 9.00 CHF.

Employer-funded pension plan
Bühler Pensionskasse offers its employees an independent pension fund that ensures reliable financial retirement: www.pk-buhler.ch

Health port
We are committed to health prevention through laboratory analyses, massages, nutritional advice, physiotherapy, group courses and a company doctor.

Sports activities
We promote sport through self-organized circuit training and running groups as well as vouchers for update and active fitness.

Two billion people eat food produced at Bühler plants every day. One billion people travel in vehicles whose parts were produced using Bühler technologies.
With every decision, Bühler pursues the goal of reconciling the needs of the economy, people and nature. In this way, we develop solutions that open up sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed and mobility industries.
We want to innovate for a better world, with a particular focus on healthy, safe and sustainable solutions. This is why we work with customers, start-ups, multinational corporations and scientists to achieve a faster impact together.

• Sie arbeiten eng mit internen Fachstellen sowie externen Partnern aus Medizin und Sozialversicherungen zusammen

• Sie entwickeln Prozesse, Standards und Kennzahlen im Case Management weiter und stellen eine professionelle Dokumentation sicher

• Abgeschlossene Ausbildung im kaufmännischen Bereich, Gesundheits- oder Sozialwesen beziehungsweise in Psychologie ergänzt durch eine Weiterbildung im Case Management

• Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Case Management oder einer vergleichbaren Funktion sowie fundierte Kenntnisse des Schweizer Sozialversicherungssystems

• Ausgeprägte Beratungskompetenz und hohes Verständnis für arbeitsrechtliche sowie medizinische Fragestellungen

• Kommunikationsstarke, vertrauenswürdige Persönlichkeit mit Freude an interdisziplinärer Zusammenarbeit

• Fliessende Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse sowie ein sicherer Umgang mit den gängigen MS-Office-Anwendungen

Wir bieten:

Ausreichend Zeit für Erholung und persönliche Interessen - wir bieten von 25 bis zu 30 Tage Ferien pro Jahr abhängig vom Lebensjahr.

Wir bieten ein OSTWIND ZVV / Z-Pass + Halbtax für 365 CHF + 400CHF ÖV-Guthaben sowie ein attraktives Erstklass-Abonnement oder kostenlose Parkplätze.

Wir bieten unseren Mitarbeitenden ein tägliches Fitnessmenü ab 9, 00 CHF.

Die Bühler Pensionskasse bietet ihren Mitarbeitenden eine eigenständige Pensionskasse, die eine verlässliche finanzielle Abischerung im Ruhestand sicherstellt: www.pk-buhler.ch

Health-Port
Wir setzen uns für Gesundheitsprävention durch Laboranalysen, Massagen, Ernährungsberatung, Physiotherapie, Gruppenkurse sowie einen Betriebsarzt ein.

Wir fördern die sportliche Betätigung durch eigenorganisiertes Zirkeltraining und Laufgruppen sowie durch Gutscheine für Update und Activ Fitness.

We offer our employees a daily fitness menu from 9.00 CHF.

Let us at Bühler make a difference together!
Two billion people eat food produced on Bühler plants every day. One billion people travel in vehicles whose parts were produced using Bühler technologies.
With every decision, Bühler pursues the goal of reconciling the needs of the economy, people and nature. In this way, we develop solutions that open up sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed and mobility industries.
We want to create innovations for a better world, with a particular focus on healthy, safe and sustainable solutions. This is why we work with customers, start-ups, multinational corporations and scientists to achieve a faster impact together. jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
Step into a project leadership role where your expertise directly shapes the future of grain handling and milling operations. As a Project Manager specializing in capital projects, you'll oversee the full lifecycle of large‑scale system installations by guiding projects from initial concept through commissioning. You'll collaborate closely with engineering, vendors, and onsite teams to deliver reliable, efficient solutions that help customers maximize operational performance.
In this role, you'll lead mechanical and process‑focused projects from start to finish, ensuring clear communication, organized scheduling, and smooth coordination with all teams involved. If you like taking ownership, working closely with customers, and managing the details that keep major industrial projects moving, this position offers the chance to make a real impact. Aufgaben: • Provides execution strategy and conducts final project negotiations; ensures project schedule baseline is approved prior to project commencement • Manages and leads project teams in order to achieve and further improve the cost, schedule, quality and EHS targets • Ensures proper project deviation management; assesses, approves and expedites technical aspects of change orders and defines effective claim strategies for customers, partners, subcontractors, etc. • Prepares and performs project reviews and facilitates site briefing meetings, ensuring all site-related documents are delivered to site personnel, and organizes and participates in debriefing meetings following project conclusion • Implements and maintains operating standards to ensure quality project results and customer satisfaction • Develops and maintains relationships with customers, contractors, and subcontractors to ensure smooth operation of projects • Establishes internal prevention and detection controls which address potential risks of inefficiency, ineffectiveness, fraud, abuse, or mismanagement with reasonable assurance • Provides guidance and support to project team members • Participates in continual learning activities and applies practical application to work performed • Must arrive at work predictably and promptly • Performs other duties as assigned Anforderungen: • Bachelor's from an accredited institution in mechanical, electrical or automation engineering or related field • 3 years of experience in a project engineering role • 3 years overseeing projects in the grain handling industry • Experience with AutoCAD and Microsoft Office is required • 3D Mechanical and Architect preferred • SAP experience is preferred • Experience with Gantt charts is preferred • PMI certification is a plus • Strong communication skills required • Ability to speak and understand English • Ability to travel 15% of the time Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines. Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries. We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Entra in un ruolo di leadership di progetto in cui la tua competenza modella direttamente il futuro delle operazioni di lavorazione e fresatura dei grani. In qualità di Project Manager specializzato in progetti di capitale, supervisionerai il ciclo di vita completo delle installazioni di sistemi su larga scala guidando progetti dal concetto iniziale attraverso la messa in servizio. Collaborerai a stretto contatto con i team di ingegneri, fornitori e onsite per fornire soluzioni affidabili ed efficienti che aiutano i clienti a massimizzare le prestazioni operative. In questo ruolo, guiderai progetti meccanici e orientati al processo dall'inizio alla fine, garantendo una comunicazione chiara, una pianificazione organizzata e un coordinamento regolare con tutte le squadre coinvolte. Se ti piace prendere la proprietà, lavorare a stretto contatto con i clienti, e gestire i dettagli che mantengono grandi progetti industriali in movimento, questa posizione offre la possibilità di fare un impatto reale.

Aufgaben:
• Fornisce la strategia di esecuzione e conduce i negoziati finali del progetto; assicura che la linea di base del programma di progetto sia approvata prima dell'inizio del progetto

• Gestisce e guida i team di progetto per raggiungere e migliorare ulteriormente i target di costo, programma, qualità e EHS

• Garantisce una corretta gestione delle deviazioni di progetto; valuta, approva e accelera gli aspetti tecnici degli ordini di cambiamento e definisce strategie di reclamo efficaci per clienti, partner, subappaltatori, ecc.

• Prepara ed esegue le recensioni dei progetti e facilita le riunioni di briefing del sito, assicurando che tutti i documenti relativi al sito siano consegnati al personale del sito, e organizza e partecipa a riunioni di debriefing a seguito della conclusione del progetto

descriptionByLocale.en:
Step into a project leadership role where your expertise directly shapes the future of grain handling and milling operations. As a Project Manager specializing in capital projects, you'll oversee the full lifecycle of large‑scale system installations by guiding projects from initial concept through commissioning. You'll collaborate closely with engineering, vendors, and onsite teams to deliver reliable, efficient solutions that help customers maximize operational performance.
In this role, you'll lead mechanical and process‑focused projects from start to finish, ensuring clear communication, organized scheduling, and smooth coordination with all teams involved. If you like taking ownership, working closely with customers, and managing the details that keep major industrial projects moving, this position offers the chance to make a real impact. Aufgaben: • Provides execution strategy and conducts final project negotiations; ensures project schedule baseline is approved prior to project commencement • Manages and leads project teams in order to achieve and further improve the cost, schedule, quality and EHS targets • Ensures proper project deviation management; assesses, approves and expedites technical aspects of change orders and defines effective claim strategies for customers, partners, subcontractors, etc. • Prepares and performs project reviews and facilitates site briefing meetings, ensuring all site-related documents are delivered to site personnel, and organizes and participates in debriefing meetings following project conclusion • Implements and maintains operating standards to ensure quality project results and customer satisfaction • Develops and maintains relationships with customers, contractors, and subcontractors to ensure smooth operation of projects • Establishes internal prevention and detection controls which address potential risks of inefficiency, ineffectiveness, fraud, abuse, or mismanagement with reasonable assurance • Provides guidance and support to project team members • Participates in continual learning activities and applies practical application to work performed • Must arrive at work predictably and promptly • Performs other duties as assigned Anforderungen: • Bachelor's from an accredited institution in mechanical, electrical or automation engineering or related field • 3 years of experience in a project engineering role • 3 years overseeing projects in the grain handling industry • Experience with AutoCAD and Microsoft Office is required • 3D Mechanical and Architect preferred • SAP experience is preferred • Experience with Gantt charts is preferred • PMI certification is a plus • Strong communication skills required • Ability to speak and understand English • Ability to travel 15% of the time Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines. Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries. We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

Bühler Leybold Optics è sinonimo di tecnologie innovative e crescita costante. Come parte del Gruppo Bühler, un gruppo di ingegneria globale con oltre 13.000 dipendenti, siamo uno dei principali produttori di sistemi di rivestimento sottovuoto ad alta tecnologia. Da oltre 150 anni, abbiamo offerto ai nostri clienti una vasta gamma di attrezzature per il rivestimento di vetro architettonico, occhiali, componenti ottici in smartphone, auto, tecnologia medica e molto altro ancora. Il nostro team internazionale riesce a stabilire nuovi standard ogni giorno e ad implementare con successo progetti complessi. Stiamo cercando uno studente motivato (m/f/d) che supporterà attivamente il nostro design elettrico presso il sito Alzenau. Si distinguono per impegno, affidabilità e un metodo di lavoro indipendente e si distinguono per i propri compiti e responsabilità. > > Facciamo la differenza a Bühler insieme! In questo modo, sviluppiamo soluzioni che aprono opportunità di business sostenibili nel settore alimentare, alimentare e della mobilità globale. > Vogliamo creare innovazioni per un mondo migliore, con particolare attenzione alle soluzioni sane, sicure e sostenibili. Ecco perché lavoriamo con clienti, start-up, multinazionali e scienziati per ottenere un impatto più veloce insieme.

Compiti:
• Cooperazione nello sviluppo e nella costruzione di sistemi elettrici, diagrammi e assemblaggi

• Progettazione e realizzazione di progetti elettrici con EPLAN

• Sostegno alle operazioni giornaliere e ai vari progetti

• Una stretta collaborazione con diversi dipartimenti e partecipazione alle riunioni di progetto

Requisiti
• Sei uno studente iscritto (m/f/d), idealmente nei campi dell'ingegneria elettrica, della meccatronica, della tecnologia di automazione o di un programma di laurea paragonabile

• Idealmente, hai già esperienza iniziale nel design elettrico

• Hai un grande interesse per la tecnologia e l'innovazione

• Sei un giocatore di squadra e ti distinguono attraverso affidabilità e forza di comunicazione

Offriamo:
Sviluppo professionale e personale
Offriamo una vasta gamma di opportunità di apprendimento, come video, formazione online, formazione faccia a faccia e webinar con formati brevi, rilevanti, coinvolgenti, personalizzati e mobili.

Eventi e eventi di squadra
Il vostro impegno ci rende possibile. Vogliamo festeggiare insieme a te. Le nostre feste di Natale, feste estive, eventi sportivi e eventi di squadra offrono le migliori opportunità per farlo.

Mensa con pasti sani
Godetevi pasti sani nella nostra mensa a prezzi equi.

Ambiente di lavoro interculturale
La chiave del nostro successo è la nostra forza lavoro diversificata da più di 100 nazioni e la nostra cultura inclusiva.

Posto di lavoro moderno con le migliori attrezzature tecniche
Lavorare in un luogo di lavoro moderno dotato degli ultimi strumenti tecnici per aumentare la produttività e l'innovazione.

Vantaggi e sconti dei dipendenti
Godetevi una varietà di vantaggi e sconti per i dipendenti che rendono la vostra vita quotidiana più facile. Diventa parte della nostra squadra e scopri di più.

Bühler Leybold Optics stands for innovative technologies and steady growth. As part of the Bühler Group, a global engineering group with over 13,000 employees, we are one of the leading manufacturers of high-tech thin-film vacuum coating systems. For more than 150 years, we have offered our customers a wide range of equipment for the coating of architectural glass, eyeglasses, optical components in smartphones, cars, medical technology and much more. Our international team succeeds in setting new standards every day and successfully implementing complex projects.

We are looking for a motivated working student (m/f/d) who will actively support our electrical design at the Alzenau site. You distinguish yourself through commitment, reliability and an independent working method and enjoy taking on your own tasks and responsibility.

Let's make a difference at Bühler together!
Two billion people eat food produced on Bühler plants every day. One billion people travel in vehicles whose parts were produced using Bühler technologies.
With every decision, Bühler pursues the goal of reconciling the needs of the economy, people and nature. In this way, we develop solutions that open up sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed and mobility industries.
We want to create innovations for a better world, with a particular focus on healthy, safe and sustainable solutions. This is why we work with customers, start-ups, multinational corporations and scientists to achieve a faster impact together. Tasks: • Cooperation in the development and construction of electrical systems, circuit diagrams and assemblies • Planning and realization of electrical designs with EPLAN • Support in day-to-day operations and various projects • Close cooperation with different departments and participation in project meetings Requirements • You are an enrolled student (m/f/d), ideally in the fields of electrical engineering, mechatronics, automation technology or a comparable degree program • Ideally, you already have initial experience in electrical design • You have a great interest in technology and innovation • You are a team player and distinguish yourself through reliability and communication strength We offer: Professional and personal development We offer a wide range of learning opportunities, such as videos, online training, face-to-face training and webinars with short, relevant, engaging, personalised and mobile formats. Team events and events Your commitment makes it possible for us. We want to celebrate this together with you. Our Christmas parties, summer parties, sporting events and team events offer the best opportunities to do so. Canteen with healthy meals Enjoy healthy meals in our canteen at fair prices. Intercultural working environment Key to our success is our diverse workforce from more than 100 nations and our inclusive culture. Modern workplace with the best technical equipment Work in a modern workplace equipped with the latest technical tools to boost your productivity and innovation. Employee benefits and discounts Enjoy a variety of employee benefits and discounts that make your everyday life easier. Become part of our team and find out more. Dans le cadre du Groupe Bühler, groupe d'ingénierie mondial comptant plus de 13 000 employés, nous sommes l'un des principaux fabricants de systèmes de revêtement sous vide à film mince de haute technologie.
