jobs.title: Onsite Support Engineer
jobs.description:
Join our team as an Onsite Support Engineer, where you'll play a key role in delivering successful equipment installations and ensuring long-term customer success. In this highly visible, customer-facing position, you'll lead onsite technical activities during equipment assembly, startup, and commissioning while serving as the primary expert for troubleshooting and resolving complex equipment issues. This is an exciting opportunity to apply your technical expertise, take ownership of critical projects, and make a direct impact on customer operations and satisfaction.

Aufgaben:
• Repair, install, troubleshoot, inspect and modify Bühler equipment at customer site during standard business hours.

• Assess customer needs regarding maintenance, spare parts, modernization, and improvement of process.

• Provide technical support externally and internally.

• Develop, organize and provide customer training programs.

• Promote Bühler Customer Service products and help the customer to plan future service.

• On-call rotation for support outside of business hours.

• Carry out repairs, modifications, inspections, overhauls, and preventive maintenance activities.

• Analyze, troubleshoot, and resolve mechanical, electrical, and software-related issues in cooperation with the relevant engineering departments.

• Train customer personnel in machine operation, maintenance, and basic troubleshooting procedures.

• Support machine software updates and continuous improvement activities.

• Prepare detailed service reports and submit weekly reports, emails, and required documentation in a timely manner.

• Ensure professional representation of Bühler at customer sites.

• Support customer projects and ensure high machine availability and operational performance.

Anforderungen:
• Bachelor's in engineering or accredited technical degree or equivalent training or experience in a field of technology such as electrical, mechanical, vacuum technology, thin film, physics or similar field.

• Previous field service experience or machine engineering is preferred.

• 5+ years of vacuum coating technology experience strongly preferred.

• Demonstrates leadership as an effective role model for the department in tasks both internal and external to the company.

• Must be able to work under pressure.

• Excellent negotiating skills.

• Maintains discipline, recommending and administering corrective action according to company policy and procedures.

• Proficient with MS Office: Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook.

• Maintain valid driving license.

• Strong troubleshooting and fault-finding skills in complex machinery and industrial systems.

• Strong Knowledge of PLC programming, Allen Bradley is an advantage.

• Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, electrical schematics, and service documentation.

• Fluent in English, both written and spoken.

• Friendly, professional, and open-minded personality with a serious and customer-focused attitude.

• Reliable, accountable, and committed to delivering high-quality service.

• Strong communication skills with clear and effective verbal and written communication.

• Ability to understand customer requirements and translate them into practical technical solutions.

• Independent, organized, and solution-oriented working style.

• High level of flexibility, adaptability, and resilience under demanding conditions.

• Team-oriented approach with the ability to collaborate across departments and cultures.

• Readiness for long-term assignments, including continuous stays of up to 2 years at customer sites.

• Ability to travel nationally and internationally.

• Flexibility regarding working hours, locations, and project requirements.

Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines.
Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries.
We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

Questa è un'opportunità emozionante per applicare la vostra competenza tecnica, prendere la proprietà di progetti critici, e fare un impatto diretto sulle operazioni e la soddisfazione del cliente.

• Valutare le esigenze del cliente per quanto riguarda manutenzione, pezzi di ricambio, modernizzazione e miglioramento del processo.

• Fornire supporto tecnico esternamente e internamente.

• Sviluppare, organizzare e fornire programmi di formazione dei clienti.

• Promuovere i prodotti del Servizio Clienti di Bühler e aiutare il cliente a pianificare il servizio futuro.

• Formare il personale del cliente nel funzionamento della macchina, la manutenzione e le procedure di risoluzione dei problemi di base.

• Aggiornamenti software di supporto e attività di miglioramento continuo.

• Preparare report di servizio dettagliati e inviare report settimanali, e-mail e documentazione richiesta in modo tempestivo.

• Assicurare la rappresentanza professionale di Bühler presso i siti dei clienti.

• Sostenere i progetti dei clienti e garantire elevata disponibilità della macchina e prestazioni operative.

• Esperienza di servizio sul campo precedente o ingegneria della macchina è preferito.

• 5+ anni di esperienza di tecnologia di rivestimento sotto vuoto fortemente preferito.

• Dimostra la leadership come un modello di ruolo efficace per il dipartimento in compiti sia interni che esterni alla società.

• Deve essere in grado di lavorare sotto pressione.

• Eccellente capacità di negoziazione.

• Mantiene la disciplina, raccomandando e amministrando azioni correttive secondo la politica e le procedure aziendali.

• Proficiente con MS Office: Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook.

• Mantenere la patente di guida valida.

• Forte capacità di risoluzione dei problemi e di rilevamento dei guasti in macchinari complessi e sistemi industriali.

• Forte conoscenza della programmazione PLC, Allen Bradley è un vantaggio.

• Capacità di leggere e interpretare disegni tecnici, schemi elettrici e documentazione di servizio.

• Fluente in inglese, sia scritto che parlato.

• Personalità amichevole, professionale e aperta con un atteggiamento serio e orientato al cliente.

• Affidabile, responsabile e impegnato a fornire un servizio di alta qualità.

• Forte capacità comunicative con comunicazione verbale ed scritta chiara ed efficace.

• Capacità di comprendere i requisiti dei clienti e di tradurli in soluzioni tecniche pratiche.

• Stile di lavoro indipendente, organizzato e orientato alla soluzione.

• Alto livello di flessibilità, adattabilità e resilienza in condizioni difficili.

• Approccio orientato al team con la capacità di collaborare tra dipartimenti e culture.

• Prontezza per incarichi a lungo termine, inclusi soggiorni continui fino a 2 anni presso i siti dei clienti.

• Capacità di viaggiare a livello nazionale e internazionale.

• Flessibilità per quanto riguarda le ore di lavoro, le sedi e i requisiti di progetto.

Due miliardi di persone mangiano cibo ogni giorno che è stato prodotto con attrezzature Bühler. Un miliardo di persone guidano veicoli le cui parti sono state prodotte con le nostre macchine.
Bühler si propone di bilanciare l'umanità, la natura e l'economia in ogni decisione, sviluppando soluzioni che sbloccano opportunità di business sostenibili nei settori alimentare, alimentare e della mobilità globale.
Ci sforziamo di creare innovazioni per un mondo migliore, con un focus speciale su soluzioni sane, sicure e sostenibili. Pertanto, ci impegniamo con clienti, start-up, multinazionali e accademia per accelerare l'impatto insieme.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Bühler Leybold Optics, qui fait partie du groupe Bühler, est l'un des leaders du marché des systèmes de revêtement sous vide à film mince de haute technologie. Depuis plus de 150 ans, nous développons des solutions innovantes pour le revêtement du verre architectural, des verres de spectacle et des composants optiques pour smartphones, véhicules et technologies médicales.

En tant qu'employé (m/f/d) Service d'intérieur des ventes / Soutien aux ventes, vous aidez l'équipe de vente et la direction divisionnaire avec des offres, des calculs et des documents de projet. Avec votre méthode de travail structurée, vous assurez l'efficacité des processus et accompagnez les projets clients internationaux administrativement. Devenez membre de Bühler Alzenau GmbH!

Faisons la différence ensemble à Bühler!
Deux milliards de personnes mangent de la nourriture produite sur les plantes de Bühler chaque jour. Un milliard de personnes voyagent dans des véhicules dont les pièces ont été produites grâce aux technologies Bühler.
Nous voulons créer des innovations pour un monde meilleur, en mettant l'accent sur des solutions saines, sûres et durables. C'est pourquoi nous travaillons avec les clients, les start-up, les multinationales et les scientifiques pour obtenir un impact plus rapide ensemble. Tâches : • Ils créent, révisent et vérifient la plausibilité des calculs et des offres pour des projets d'usines internationaux. • Ils rassemblent de manière structurée les informations et les besoins de nos domaines commerciaux et spécialisés dans le monde entier et créent une base d'approvisionnement fiable. • Ils soutiennent nos clients dans le monde entier pendant le processus d'offre et sont à leur disposition en tant que personne de contact compétente. • Vous coordonnez la coordination interne avec l'ingénierie, l'achat, la gestion de projet et le service et ainsi soutenir l'équipe de vente dans la préparation de l'offre. • Ils assurent une budgétisation complète et adéquate des projets. • Vous assumez des tâches administratives et organisationnelles dans le bureau des ventes et soutenez la direction du département dans les évaluations, les présentations et les rapports. Exigences • Ils ont suivi une formation commerciale ou technique, idéalement complétée par une formation continue en tant que technicien, économiste d'entreprise ou une qualification comparable. • Vous apportez votre première expérience professionnelle en support commercial, service interne de vente, dans la préparation d'offres ou dans une fonction comparable. • Idéalement, vous avez déjà travaillé avec des outils de devis, de calcul, de CRM ou de configuration de produits et avez une bonne compréhension technique et commerciale. • Vous êtes sûr de traiter avec MS Office; Connaissance du SAP est un avantage. • Grâce à vos bonnes compétences en langue anglaise, vous pouvez communiquer en toute sécurité avec des clients internationaux ainsi qu'avec des domaines de vente et de spécialisation dans le monde entier. • Une façon systématique, structurée et prudente de travailler ainsi que de solides compétences en communication et en coordination vous distinguent. • Initiative, fiabilité, travail d'équipe et plaisir de travailler ensemble dans un environnement international complètent votre profil. Nous offrons: Développement professionnel et personnel Nous offrons un large éventail d'opportunités d'apprentissage, telles que des vidéos, des formations en ligne, des formations face à face et des webinaires avec des formats courts, pertinents, attrayants, personnalisés et mobiles. Cantine avec des repas sains Profitez de repas sains dans notre cantine à des prix équitables. Manifestations et événements en équipe Votre engagement nous rend possibles. Nous voulons fêter ça avec vous. Nos fêtes de Noël, les fêtes d'été, les événements sportifs et les événements en équipe offrent les meilleures occasions de le faire. Un lieu de travail moderne avec le meilleur équipement technique Travaillez dans un lieu de travail moderne équipé des derniers outils techniques pour stimuler votre productivité et votre innovation. Culture des entreprises familiales Nous avons plus de 160 ans d'histoire. Cela fait de nous une entreprise qui pense et investit à long terme – dans l'innovation, nos employés et la réussite économique. Avantages sociaux et rabais Profitez d'une variété d'avantages sociaux et de réductions qui facilitent votre vie quotidienne. Faites partie de notre équipe et en savoir plus. Deux milliards de personnes mangent chaque jour des aliments produits dans les usines de Bühler. Un milliard de personnes voyagent dans des véhicules dont les pièces ont été produites grâce aux technologies Bühler. Avec chaque décision, Bühler poursuit l'objectif de concilier les besoins de l'économie, des personnes et de la nature. De cette manière, nous développons des solutions qui ouvrent des opportunités commerciales durables dans les industries mondiales des aliments pour animaux, des aliments pour animaux et de la mobilité. Nous voulons innover pour un monde meilleur, avec un accent particulier sur des solutions saines, sûres et durables. C'est pourquoi nous travaillons avec les clients, les start-up, les multinationales et les scientifiques pour obtenir un impact plus rapide ensemble.

As part of your 6-month technical internship, you will support the Business Development CS in sustainably improving data quality with the help of artificial intelligence. You can put your already acquired technical know-how into practice, get to know innovative AI solutions and actively contribute to the further development of data-based service processes.

Let's make a difference at Bühler together!
Two billion people eat food produced on Bühler plants every day. One billion people travel in vehicles whose parts were produced using Bühler technologies.
With every decision, Bühler pursues the goal of reconciling the needs of the economy, people and nature. In this way, we develop solutions that open up sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed and mobility industries.
We want to innovate for a better world, with a particular focus on healthy, safe and sustainable solutions. This is why we work with customers, start-ups, multinational corporations and scientists to achieve a faster impact together. Public and private connections Our location offers excellent access to public transport and convenient parking spaces that make it easier for you to commute every day. jobs.title: Service Sales Engineer
jobs.description:
Bühler Group in Abidjan, Côte d'Ivoire, is looking for a skilled professional to join our team as a Customer Service Sales Engineer for the cocoa industry. The successful candidate will be responsible for strengthening the company's business, expanding our customer base, implementing the business strategy, and ensuring that business targets are achieved.

Aufgaben:
• Develop and maintain sales materials and current product knowledge.

• Establish, manage, and maintain current customers and potential customers relationships.

• Prepare action plans and schedules to increase business activities in the assigned territory.

• Identify sales prospects and contact these and other accounts as assigned.

• Align and complement market activities together with existing Area Sales/Service Manager in the assigned territory.

• Identify, handle, and resolve customer complaints/concerns.

• Communicate new product and service opportunities and special developments gathered through field activity to the Supervisor.

• Follow up on new leads and referrals resulting from field activity, ensure that customer data in CRM is up to date.

• Prepare presentations and proposals, and generates sales leads for equipment/plant business.

Anforderungen:
• Bachelor's degree in Engineering.

• Minimum 5 years of working experience in the similar industry.

• Fluent communication skill in French and English language.

• PSSR (Parts, Sales and Service Representative) experience is an advantage.

• Deep knowledge of Grains and Food processing.

• Excellent knowledge of sales and customer relationship management.

• Has the ability to develop technical/technological solutions with and for the customers.

Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines.
Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries.
We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

jobs.title: Sales Director - Grinding & Dispersing
jobs.description:
Lead the growth and success of our Grinding and Dispersing business across the region as a Sales Director. In this strategic leadership role, you will drive sales expansion, build strong customer partnerships, and inspire a high-performing sales team to achieve ambitious business goals. You'll play a key role in shaping market strategy, identifying new opportunities, and delivering value-driven solutions that help customers succeed. This is an opportunity for a results-oriented leader to make a meaningful impact on business growth while fostering lasting customer relationships and team development.

Aufgaben:
• Leadership development, recruit, train, develop and retain high talent within the sales teams.

• Foster and manage relationships with customers and key accounts with sales team.

• Responsible for meeting department productivity and quality goals.

• Resolve Customer issues and improve Customer satisfaction where interfaces exist.

• Communicates and participates in solving problems related to sales and growth of North America region.

• Be the beacon of Buhler culture; lead through example to inspire and motivate employees.

• Drive business growth and exceed business targets.

• Develop and expand the customer base for current and future business within Grinding and Dispersing business area.

• Continuous refreshing/updating of product knowledge.

• Attend and participate in trade shows, exhibitions and industry associations

• Performs other duties as assigned.

Anforderungen:
• Bachelor's degree in Business or equivalent.

• 8-10 years plus of managing and sales experience, preferably in a capital equipment manufacturing environment on an international level.

• Demonstrates leadership as an effective role model for the department in tasks both internal and external to the company.

• Sufficient technical knowledge of products to be sold.

jobs.title: Sales Account Manager
jobs.description:
Build lasting customer partnerships and drive business growth in a dynamic, customer-focused role. As a Sales Account Manager, you'll serve as a trusted advisor to customers, helping them identify solutions that support their goals while expanding opportunities for both new projects and aftermarket products and services. Working closely with cross-functional teams, you'll combine relationship management, technical knowledge, and commercial expertise to deliver exceptional customer experiences and impactful business results.

Aufgaben:
•	Manage and maintain assigned accounts, while fostering long-term customer relationships.
•	Develop new accounts and identify new clients who may benefit from company products, services, aftermarket solutions, or project-based offerings.
•	Execute sales strategies that support both new project sales and service sales growth.
•	Initiate and maintain customer contact to understand requirements, identify opportunities, and recommend solutions that best meet customer needs related to quality, price, delivery, and long-term value.
•	Negotiate contracts, tender terms, and conditions to meet both customer and company needs.
•	Prepare, calculate, and administer customer quotations, proposals, and account documentation.
•	Provide pre-sales technical assistance, product education, and customer training as needed.
•	Support after-sales services by providing technical backup, coordinating solutions, and assisting with customer order concerns or service-related needs.
•	Work with engineering, quoting, accounting, design, development, production, purchasing, quality, research, sales, and other technical experts to support customer requirements and sales opportunities.
•	Collect and analyze market data, customer information, competitor activity, sales performance, and cost information to support business planning and strategy.
•	Maintain customer records, CRM database information, SOM reports, trip reports, expense reports, and other sales-related documentation.
•	Contribute to sales budget planning, SWOT analysis, and broader business sales strategy.
•	Meet regular sales targets and coordinate sales projects across assigned accounts, territories, and customer opportunities.
•	Support marketing activities by attending trade shows, exhibitions, conferences, industry associations, and other customer-facing events.
•	Make technical presentations and demonstrate how products, services, aftermarket offerings, or project solutions meet customer needs.
•	Maintain and continuously update product, technical, and industry knowledge.
•	Participate in sales training, sales seminars, and product training activities.
•	Provide training and support materials for other members of the sales team as needed.
•	Manage miscellaneous projects and complete other duties as assigned.

Anforderungen:
•	Bachelor's degree in business, engineering, or a related field preferred, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
•	5+ years experience in capital equipment sales, technical sales, industrial sales, aftermarket sales, or related customer-facing sales roles is preferred.
•	Microsoft Office is required.
•	Experience with enterprise software such as SAP is preferred.
•	Familiarity with AutoCAD, Project Wise, and D3 is nice to have.
•	Strong customer relationship, sales, and negotiation skills.
•	Technical knowledge of products, services, equipment, and customer applications.
•	Ability to provide technical advice, product education, pre-sales assistance, and after-sales support.
•	Ability to read and understand electrical and mechanical technical drawings.
•	Strong interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills with the ability to work effectively with customers, internal teams, and a variety of personalities.
•	Strong organizational skills with the ability to plan, prioritize, coordinate, and manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
•	Ability to work independently with minimal supervision and make effective decisions within company guidelines.
•	Ability to identify, evaluate, problem solve, and support resolution of customer, account, and business issues.
•	Ability to analyze costs, sales, customer needs, market trends, and competitive activity.
•	Proactive team player with an ownership approach.
•	Ability to understand and maintain confidentiality related to organizational and employee information.
•	Speaks and understands English.
•	Ability to travel up to 80% domestically and internationally, including frequent travel and non-traditional work schedules.

• Preparare, calcolare e amministrare le citazioni dei clienti, le proposte e la documentazione del conto.

• Lavorare con ingegneria, citando, contabilità, progettazione, sviluppo, produzione, acquisto, qualità, ricerca, vendite e altri esperti tecnici per supportare le esigenze dei clienti e le opportunità di vendita.

• Sostenere le attività di marketing partecipando a fiere, mostre, conferenze, associazioni di settore e altri eventi di customer-facing.
• Rendere presentazioni tecniche e dimostrare come prodotti, servizi, offerte aftermarket, o soluzioni di progetto soddisfano le esigenze del cliente.
• Mantenere e aggiornare continuamente le conoscenze di prodotto, tecnico e industriale.
• Partecipano alla formazione delle vendite, ai seminari di vendita e alle attività di formazione dei prodotti.
• Fornire materiali di formazione e supporto per altri membri del team di vendita come necessario.
• Gestire vari progetti e completare altri compiti assegnati.

Anforderungen:
• Corso di laurea in economia, ingegneria, o un campo correlato preferito, o una combinazione equivalente di istruzione e di esperienza.
• 5+ anni di esperienza nelle vendite di attrezzature di capitale, vendite tecniche, vendite industriali, vendite aftermarket, o relativi ruoli di vendita al cliente è preferito.
• Microsoft Office è richiesto.
• L'esperienza con software enterprise come SAP è preferita.
• Familiarità con AutoCAD, Project Wise, e D3 è bello avere.
• Forte rapporto cliente, vendite e competenze di negoziazione.
• Conoscenza tecnica di prodotti, servizi, attrezzature e applicazioni dei clienti.
• Capacità di fornire consulenza tecnica, formazione dei prodotti, assistenza pre-vendita e assistenza post-vendita.
• Capacità di leggere e comprendere disegni tecnici elettrici e meccanici.
• Forte capacità di comunicazione interpersonale, scritta e verbale con la capacità di lavorare efficacemente con i clienti, le squadre interne e una varietà di personalità.
• Forte capacità organizzative con la capacità di pianificare, prioritizzare, coordinare e gestire più attività contemporaneamente.
• Capacità di lavorare indipendentemente con una minima supervisione e prendere decisioni efficaci all'interno delle linee guida aziendali.
• Capacità di identificare, valutare, risolvere i problemi e supportare la risoluzione dei problemi di cliente, account e business.
• Capacità di analizzare i costi, le vendite, le esigenze del cliente, le tendenze del mercato e l'attività competitiva.
• Giocatore di squadra attivo con un approccio di proprietà.
• Capacità di comprendere e mantenere la riservatezza relativa alle informazioni organizzative e dei dipendenti.
• Parla e comprende l'inglese.
• Capacità di viaggiare fino all'80% a livello nazionale e internazionale, tra cui viaggi frequenti e orari di lavoro non tradizionali.

Aufbau nachhaltiger Kundenpartnerschaften und Förderung des Geschäftswachstums in einer dynamischen, kundenorientierten Rolle. Als Sales Account Manager sind Sie als vertrauenswürdiger Berater für Kunden tätig und helfen ihnen, Lösungen zu finden, die ihre Ziele unterstützen und gleichzeitig die Möglichkeiten für neue Projekte und Aftermarket-Produkte und -Dienstleistungen erweitern. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams kombinieren Sie Beziehungsmanagement, technisches Wissen und kaufmännisches Fachwissen, um außergewöhnliche Kundenerfahrungen und wirkungsvolle Geschäftsergebnisse zu liefern.

Aufgaben:
• Verwalten und pflegen Sie zugewiesene Konten und fördern Sie gleichzeitig langfristige Kundenbeziehungen.
• Entwickeln Sie neue Konten und identifizieren Sie neue Kunden, die von Unternehmensprodukten, Dienstleistungen, Aftermarket-Lösungen oder projektbasierten Angeboten profitieren können.
• Führen Sie Vertriebsstrategien aus, die sowohl den Verkauf neuer Projekte als auch das Umsatzwachstum im Service unterstützen.

• Verhandeln Sie Verträge, Ausschreibungsbedingungen und Bedingungen, um sowohl Kunden- als auch Unternehmensbedürfnisse zu erfüllen.
• Bereiten, berechnen und verwalten Sie Kundenangebote, Vorschläge und Kontodokumentation.
• Bieten Sie vor dem Verkauf technische Unterstützung, Produktschulung und Kundenschulung nach Bedarf.
• Unterstützen Sie After-Sales-Services, indem Sie technisches Backup bereitstellen, Lösungen koordinieren und bei Kundenbestellungen oder servicebezogenen Bedürfnissen helfen.
• Arbeiten Sie mit Engineering, Zitieren, Buchhaltung, Design, Entwicklung, Produktion, Einkauf, Qualität, Forschung, Verkauf und anderen technischen Experten, um Kundenanforderungen und Verkaufsmöglichkeiten zu unterstützen.

jobs.title: Identity & Access Management Architect
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about securing digital identities and shaping the future of enterprise security architecture? As part of our continued investment in Cyber Security and Identity & Access Management (IAM), we are building a new IAM Product team and are looking for an experienced IAM Architect to help shape this capability further. In this newly created role, you will have the unique opportunity to define architectural standards, influence strategic direction, and build the foundation for scalable and secure identity services across our global organization.

Aufgaben:
• You design, govern, and continuously evolve enterprise-wide Identity & Access Management architectures across cloud, on-premise, and hybrid environments, ensuring alignment with business objectives and security requirements

• You define IAM standards, policies, and architecture principles for authentication, authorization, federation, privileged access management, and identity governance

• You design secure identity and access concepts for employees, partners, service accounts, APIs, and privileged users while ensuring compliance with security and regulatory requirements

• You act as a trusted advisor for business and technology teams, driving secure-by-design IAM solutions and supporting the integration of new applications, platforms, and services

• You assess identity-related risks, conduct security and architecture reviews, contribute to incident response activities, and collaborate closely with Cyber Security, Enterprise Architecture, Compliance, and external partners

Anforderungen:
• Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Cyber Security, or a related field, combined with 5+ years of experience in Identity & Access Management within complex enterprise environments

• Strong expertise across IAM disciplines including authentication, authorization, identity lifecycle management, role design, federation, and Privileged Access Management (PAM)

• Hands-on experience with leading IAM and Identity Governance platforms such as Sailpoint, Omada, One Identity, Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, and PAM solutions

• Proven track record integrating enterprise platforms and applications, including SAP and Microsoft ecosystems, into IAM and Identity Governance processes

• Strong understanding of cybersecurity frameworks and regulatory requirements such as ISO 27001, NIST, GDPR, and NIS2, combined with fluency in English

Wir bieten:
Attractive vacation entitlement
Enough time for relaxation and personal interests - we offer from 25 to 30 days of vacation per year depending on age.

Attractive mobility concept
We offer an OSTWIND ZVV / Z-Pass + half-fare travelcard for CHF 365 + CHF 400 public transport credit as well as an attractive first-class travelcard or free parking.

VIVA Restaurant
We offer our employees a daily fitness menu from 9, 00 CHF.

Employer-funded pension plan
The Bühler Pension Fund offers Bühler employees an independent pension fund that ensures reliable financial security in retirement: www.pk-buhler.ch

Health-Port
We are committed to preventive health care through laboratory analyses, massages, nutritional advice, physiotherapy, group courses and a company doctor.

Sports activities
We promote physical activity through self-organized circuit training and running groups as well as vouchers for Update and Activ Fitness.

Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sei appassionato di proteggere le identità digitali e plasmare il futuro dell'architettura di sicurezza aziendale? Come parte del nostro continuo investimento in Cyber Security e Identity & Access Management (IAM), stiamo costruendo un nuovo team di prodotti IAM e stiamo cercando un esperto IAM Architect per contribuire a modellare ulteriormente questa capacità. In questo ruolo appena creato, avrete l'opportunità unica di definire gli standard architettonici, influenzare la direzione strategica, e costruire le basi per servizi di identità scalabili e sicuri in tutta la nostra organizzazione globale.

Aufgaben:
• Progettare, governare e evolvere continuamente architetture Identity & Access Management a livello aziendale in ambienti cloud, on-premise e ibridi, garantendo l'allineamento con obiettivi aziendali e requisiti di sicurezza

• Definisci standard IAM, politiche e principi di architettura per l'autenticazione, l'autorizzazione, la federazione, la gestione privilegiata dell'accesso e la governance dell'identità

• L'utente progetta concetti di identità e accesso sicuri per dipendenti, partner, account di servizio, API e utenti privilegiati, garantendo al contempo la conformità ai requisiti di sicurezza e regolamentazione

• L'utente funge da consulente di fiducia per i team aziendali e tecnologici, guidando soluzioni IAM sicure e supportando l'integrazione di nuove applicazioni, piattaforme e servizi

• Valutare i rischi legati all'identità, condurre le recensioni di sicurezza e architettura, contribuire alle attività di risposta agli incidenti e collaborare strettamente con Cyber Security, Enterprise Architecture, Compliance e partner esterni

Anforderungen:
• Laurea in Informatica, Informatica, Cyber Security o un campo correlato, combinato con 5 anni di esperienza in Identity & Access Management all'interno di ambienti aziendali complessi

• Forte competenza in tutte le discipline IAM, tra cui autenticazione, autorizzazione, gestione del ciclo di vita dell'identità, progettazione del ruolo, federazione e Privileged Access Management (PAM)

• Esperienza pratica con le principali piattaforme IAM e Identity Governance come Sailpoint, Omada, One Identity, Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory e soluzioni PAM

• Proventa l'integrazione di piattaforme e applicazioni aziendali, inclusi gli ecosistemi SAP e Microsoft, nei processi IAM e Identity Governance

• Forte comprensione dei framework di sicurezza informatica e dei requisiti normativi come ISO 27001, NIST, GDPR e NIS2, combinato con la fluenza in inglese

Wir bieten:
Attraente diritto di vacanza
Abbastanza tempo per il relax e gli interessi personali - offriamo da 25 a 30 giorni di vacanza all'anno a seconda dell'età.

Concetto di mobilità attraente
Offriamo una tessera di viaggio OSTWIND ZV/Z-Pass + mezza strada per CHF 365 + CHF 400 credito di trasporto pubblico, nonché una attraente carta di viaggio di prima classe o un parcheggio gratuito.

Ristorante VIVA
Offriamo ai nostri dipendenti un menu di fitness giornaliero da 9, 00 CHF.

Piano pensionistico finanziato dal datore di lavoro
Il Bühler Pension Fund offre ai dipendenti Bühler un fondo pensione indipendente che garantisce una sicurezza finanziaria affidabile in pensione: www.pk-buhler.ch

Salute-Porto
Ci impegniamo nell'assistenza sanitaria preventiva attraverso analisi di laboratorio, massaggi, consigli nutrizionali, fisioterapia, corsi di gruppo e un medico aziendale.

Attività sportive
Promuoviamo l'attività fisica attraverso la formazione di circuiti auto-organizzati e gruppi in esecuzione, nonché buoni per l'aggiornamento e l'attivazione di fitness.

Due miliardi di persone mangiano cibo ogni giorno che è stato prodotto con attrezzature Bühler. Un miliardo di persone guidano veicoli le cui parti sono state prodotte con le nostre macchine.
Bühler si propone di bilanciare l'umanità, la natura e l'economia in ogni decisione, sviluppando soluzioni che sbloccano opportunità di business sostenibili nei settori alimentare, alimentare e della mobilità globale.
Ci sforziamo di creare innovazioni per un mondo migliore, con un focus speciale su soluzioni sane, sicure e sostenibili. Pertanto, ci impegniamo con clienti, start-up, multinazionali e accademia per accelerare l'impatto insieme.

Êtes-vous passionné par la sécurisation des identités numériques et l'avenir de l'architecture de sécurité d'entreprise ? Dans le cadre de notre investissement continu dans la cybersécurité et la gestion de l'identité et de l'accès (IAM), nous construisons une nouvelle équipe de produits IAM et cherchons un architecte IAM expérimenté pour aider à façonner cette capacité. Dans ce rôle nouvellement créé, vous aurez l'occasion unique de définir des normes architecturales, d'influencer l'orientation stratégique et de jeter les bases de services d'identité évolutifs et sécurisés dans notre organisation mondiale.

Aufgaben:

• Vous définissez les normes, les politiques et les principes d'architecture de l'IAM pour l'authentification, l'autorisation, la fédération, la gestion d'accès privilégiée et la gouvernance d'identité

• Vous concevez des concepts d'identité et d'accès sécurisés pour les employés, les partenaires, les comptes de service, les API et les utilisateurs privilégiés tout en assurant le respect des exigences de sécurité et de réglementation

• Vous agissez en tant que conseiller de confiance pour les équipes d'affaires et de technologie, conduisant des solutions IAM sécurisées par conception et soutenant l'intégration de nouvelles applications, plateformes et services

• Vous évaluez les risques liés à l'identité, effectuez des examens de sécurité et d'architecture, contribuez aux activités d'intervention en cas d'incident et collaborez étroitement avec la cybersécurité, l'architecture d'entreprise, la conformité et les partenaires externes

- C'est pas vrai.

Bühler Leybold Optics is one of the world's leading companies in the field of high-tech thin-film coating systems. As part of the global Bühler Group with more than 13,000 employees, we develop technologies that are used in smartphones, cars, medical technology and architectural glass all over the world.


Let us at Bühler make a difference together!
Two billion people eat food produced on Bühler plants every day. One billion people travel in vehicles whose parts were produced using Bühler technologies.
With every decision, Bühler pursues the goal of reconciling the needs of the economy, people and nature. In this way, we develop solutions that open up sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed and mobility industries.
We want to create innovations for a better world, with a particular focus on healthy, safe and sustainable solutions. This is why we work with customers, start-ups, multinational corporations and scientists to achieve a faster impact together. Tasks: • Development of customized software solutions: You develop customized software solutions for controlling our plants and machines. • Cover project cycle: You take over the entire cycle of software projects, from conception to implementation. • Planning and implementation: You plan and implement complex measurement and control systems. • Software commissioning: You support the software commissioning both in Alzenau and, if necessary, directly at the customer’s site. • Cross-departmental cooperation: You work closely with other departments and contribute to the further development of our processes. Our Christmas parties, summer parties, sporting events and team events offer the best opportunities to do so. At Bühler Leybold Optics, we develop high-precision thin-film coating systems for future markets such as architectural glass, smartphone displays, automotive headlights and medical technology. Our plants convince not only by technological excellence, but also by the highest safety standards.

In this key role, you accompany our plants from the first idea to commissioning and ensure that safety is considered right from the start. They identify risks at an early stage, develop practical solutions and ensure that our machines are economical, compliant and safe for people and the environment.

Let us at Bühler make a difference together!
Two billion people eat food produced on Bühler plants every day. One billion people travel in vehicles whose parts were produced using Bühler technologies.
With every decision, Bühler pursues the goal of reconciling the needs of the economy, people and nature. In this way, we develop solutions that open up sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed and mobility industries.
We want to create innovations for a better world, with a particular focus on healthy, safe and sustainable solutions. This is why we work with customers, start-ups, multinational corporations and scientists to achieve a faster impact together. Tasks: • They support the implementation and documentation of risk assessments according to EN ISO 12100 and CE conformity assessment procedures. • Together with experienced colleagues, you will analyse safety-related risks and participate in the development of suitable protective measures. • They work closely with design, electrical engineering, software development and project management.0 • They support the evaluation and implementation of standards and guidelines in mechanical and plant engineering. • They create and maintain technical documentation, checklists and security documents. • They participate in the further development of our standards and processes in the field of machine safety. • You will gradually build up expertise in CE conformity and functional safety. Requirements • Completed studies in mechanical engineering, mechatronics, electrical engineering or a comparable technical qualification. • Initial practical experience through internships, working student activities, final theses or an initial professional experience in mechanical or plant engineering are advantageous. • Interest in machinery safety, CE conformity and technical regulations. • Technical understanding and the willingness to familiarize yourself with standards and guidelines. • Structured and analytical working method and enjoyment of interdisciplinary cooperation. • Good knowledge of German and English. jobs.description:
The role combines hands-on food R&D, trial management, customer engagement, and technical reporting to help customers develop and optimize new food products using extrusion technolog. And the role supports the development of plant-based meat analogue products by conducting extrusion trials, collaborating with customers and partners, and contributing to innovation in alternative proteins.

Aufgaben:
• Support Customers and our Collaboration Partner (Givaudan) in the product development of plant-based meat analogues, using extrusion technology

• Run and evaluate the extrusion process for internal trials

• Communicate proactively with customers in the planning of product trials, including managing timelines, preparation of raw materials, expectations of results

• Support the Technologists in preparing comprehensive trials reports to be presented to customers and relevant parties involved post trials

• Involvement in the Plant-Based Ecosystem and identifying the latest innovations and applying them at the (Protein Innovation Center) PIC

• Proactively seek and attract new customers for the PIC to fill the pipeline of users on an ongoing basis

• Prepare customer's trials quotes and contracts for potential customers, support in contract negotiations till completion

• Collaborate with customers / shipping agents and prepare relevant documents for raw materials import and samples export

• Present Buhler solutions to potential customers at PIC visits

• Support the Manager with trials' cost and pricing analyses

• Managing order processing queries with the respective department

• Responsible for Purchase Order and Good Receipts documentation

Anforderungen:
• Preferably Master Degree in Food Science, Industrial/ Food Processing, Chemical Engineering, or any relevant discipline

• Bachelor Degree holder with relevant industry / expertise experience will be considered

• 2 to 3 years relevant R&D experience

• Demonstrated ability to research, plan and present solutions/ ideas for problem solving/ business relevant topics/initiatives

• Experience working in global/ multinational companies is a plus.

• Experience in the Plant Based ecosystem and existing relations in the network locally or regionally is a plus

Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines.
Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries.
We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

jobs.title: Werkstudent (m/w/d) Einkauf
jobs.description:
Bühler Leybold Optics steht für innovative Technologien und nachhaltiges Wachstum. Als Teil der weltweit agierenden Bühler Group entwickeln wir seit über 150 Jahren Hightech-Dünnfilm-Vakuumbeschichtungsanlagen für Anwendungen in der Optik-, Automobil-, Medizin- und Elektronikindustrie. An unserem Standort in Alzenau arbeiten internationale Teams an innovativen Lösungen für Kunden auf der ganzen Welt.

Zur Unterstützung unseres Einkaufsteams suchen wir einen Werkstudenten (m/w/d). Dich erwarten spannende Einblicke in den operativen und strategischen Einkauf, abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben sowie die Möglichkeit, aktiv an Projekten mitzuwirken und wertvolle Praxiserfahrung in einem internationalen Technologieunternehmen zu sammeln.

Lass uns bei Bühler gemeinsam etwas bewirken!
Zwei Milliarden Menschen essen täglich Lebensmittel, die auf Anlagen von Bühler hergestellt wurden. Eine Milliarde Menschen reisen in Fahrzeugen, deren Teile mit Technologien von Bühler produziert wurden.
Mit jeder Entscheidung verfolgt Bühler das Ziel, die Bedürfnisse von Wirtschaft, Mensch und Natur in Einklang zu bringen. So entwickeln wir Lösungen, die nachhaltige Geschäftsmöglichkeiten in der globalen Lebensmittel-, Futtermittel- und Mobilitätsindustrie eröffnen.
Wir wollen Innovationen für eine bessere Welt schaffen, mit besonderem Fokus auf gesunde, sichere und nachhaltige Lösungen. Deshalb arbeiten wir mit Kunden, Start-ups, multinationalen Konzernen und Wissenschaftlern zusammen, um gemeinsam eine schnellere Wirkung zu erzielen. Das wollen wir gemeinsam mit Ihnen feiern. Unsere Weihnachtsfeiern, Sommerpartys, Sportveranstaltungen und Teamevents bieten die besten Gelegenheiten dazu. descriptionByLocale.en:
Bühler Leybold Optics stands for innovative technologies and sustainable growth. As part of the global Bühler Group, we have been developing high-tech thin-film vacuum coating systems for applications in the optics, automotive, medical and electronics industries for more than 150 years. At our location in Alzenau, international teams are working on innovative solutions for customers around the world.

To support our purchasing team, we are looking for a working student (m/f/d). You can expect exciting insights into operational and strategic purchasing, varied tasks and the opportunity to actively participate in projects and gain valuable practical experience in an international technology company.

Let's make a difference at Bühler together!
Two billion people eat food produced on Bühler plants every day. One billion people travel in vehicles whose parts were produced using Bühler technologies.
With every decision, Bühler pursues the goal of reconciling the needs of the economy, people and nature. In this way, we develop solutions that open up sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed and mobility industries.
We want to create innovations for a better world, with a particular focus on healthy, safe and sustainable solutions. This is why we work with customers, start-ups, multinational corporations and scientists to achieve a faster impact together. Tasks: • You will support our purchasing team in exciting operational and strategic projects and get a comprehensive insight into modern purchasing processes. • You are actively involved in day-to-day business and support in tenders, offer comparisons and the preparation of negotiations. • You are in direct contact with our international suppliers and participate in price and contract negotiations. • You bring your own ideas to optimize purchasing processes and support their implementation together with the specialist departments. • You create analyses and evaluations and thus contribute to informed purchasing decisions. Requirements • You are an enrolled student (m/f/d) of business administration, economics, industrial engineering or a comparable degree program. • You want to gain practical experience in an internationally successful technology company and are interested in purchasing, supply chain or business contexts. • You work independently, conscientiously and like to take responsibility. • You have good knowledge of MS Office, especially Excel; First SAP knowledge is a plus. • You communicate safely in German and feel comfortable in the exchange with different contacts. • You convince through team spirit, willingness to learn and a proactive hands-on mentality. We offer: Canteen with healthy meals Enjoy healthy meals in our canteen at fair prices. Team events and events Your commitment makes it possible for us. We want to celebrate this together with you. Our Christmas parties, summer parties, sporting events and team events offer the best opportunities to do so. Modern workplace with the best technical equipment Work in a modern workplace equipped with the latest technical tools to boost your productivity and innovation. Diverse and inclusive workplace We promote an inclusive culture that values our global diversity. Respect and empathy ensure that everyone feels safe and can do their best. descriptionByLocale.fr:
Bühler Leybold Optics est synonyme de technologies innovantes et de croissance durable. Dans le cadre du Groupe Bühler mondial, nous développons depuis plus de 150 ans des systèmes de revêtement sous vide à film mince de haute technologie pour des applications dans les secteurs de l'optique, de l'automobile, de la médecine et de l'électronique. À notre emplacement à Alzenau, les équipes internationales travaillent sur des solutions innovantes pour les clients du monde entier.

Pour soutenir notre équipe d'achat, nous recherchons un étudiant en activité (h/f/d). Vous pouvez vous attendre à des renseignements passionnants sur les achats opérationnels et stratégiques, les tâches variées et la possibilité de participer activement à des projets et d'acquérir une expérience pratique précieuse dans une entreprise technologique internationale.

Faisons une différence à Bühler ensemble!
Deux milliards de personnes mangent de la nourriture produite sur les plantes de Bühler chaque jour. Un milliard de personnes voyagent dans des véhicules dont les pièces ont été produites grâce aux technologies Bühler.
Avec chaque décision, Bühler poursuit l'objectif de concilier les besoins de l'économie, des personnes et de la nature. De cette manière, nous développons des solutions qui ouvrent des opportunités commerciales durables dans les industries mondiales des aliments pour animaux, des aliments pour animaux et de la mobilité.
Nous voulons créer des innovations pour un monde meilleur, en mettant l'accent sur des solutions saines, sûres et durables. C'est pourquoi nous travaillons avec les clients, les start-up, les multinationales et les scientifiques pour obtenir un impact plus rapide ensemble. Tâches: • Vous accompagnerez notre équipe d'achat dans des projets opérationnels et stratégiques passionnants et vous aurez un aperçu complet des processus d'achat modernes. • Vous participez activement aux activités quotidiennes et au soutien aux appels d'offres, aux comparaisons et à la préparation des négociations. • Vous êtes en contact direct avec nos fournisseurs internationaux et participez aux négociations de prix et de contrats. • Vous apportez vos propres idées pour optimiser les processus d'achat et soutenir leur mise en œuvre avec les départements spécialisés. • Vous créez des analyses et des évaluations et contribuez ainsi à des décisions d'achat éclairées. Nous offrons: Cantine avec des repas sains Profitez de repas sains dans notre cantine à des prix équitables. Manifestations et événements en équipe Votre engagement nous rend possibles. Nous voulons fêter ça avec vous. Nos fêtes de Noël, les fêtes d'été, les événements sportifs et les événements en équipe offrent les meilleures occasions de le faire. Le respect et l'empathie assurent que chacun se sent en sécurité et peut faire de son mieux. Environnement de travail interculturel La clé de notre succès est notre main-d'oeuvre diversifiée de plus de 100 pays et notre culture inclusive. Avec chaque décision, Bühler poursuit l'objectif de concilier les besoins de l'économie, des personnes et de la nature. De cette manière, nous développons des solutions qui ouvrent des opportunités commerciales durables dans les industries mondiales des aliments pour animaux, des aliments pour animaux et de la mobilité. Nous voulons innover pour un monde meilleur, avec un accent particulier sur des solutions saines, sûres et durables. descriptionByLocale.fr:
Dans le cadre de l'équipe de marketing des aliments de consommation de Bühler, vous travaillerez sur un large éventail de projets dans un environnement international et serez en contact étroit avec nos unités d'affaires, le secteur de service des FC, les régions et les communications corporatives. Ensemble, nous formons une communication efficace et des événements fructueux qui renforcent notre position de leader mondial du marché.

Faisons une différence à Bühler ensemble!
Deux milliards de personnes mangent de la nourriture produite sur les plantes de Bühler chaque jour. Un milliard de personnes voyagent dans des véhicules dont les pièces ont été produites grâce aux technologies Bühler.
Avec chaque décision, Bühler poursuit l'objectif de concilier les besoins de l'économie, des personnes et de la nature. De cette façon, nous développons des solutions qui ouvrent des opportunités commerciales durables dans les industries mondiales des aliments pour animaux, des aliments pour animaux et de la mobilité.
Nous voulons innover pour un monde meilleur, avec un accent particulier sur des solutions saines, sûres et durables. C'est pourquoi nous travaillons avec les clients, les start-up, les multinationales et les scientifiques pour obtenir un impact plus rapide ensemble. Tâches : • Vous prenez en charge la planification et la gestion responsables des projets et contribuez activement à vos idées. • Vous participez à la planification et à l'organisation d'événements et de salons internationaux. • Vous supportez la création de contenus axés sur les groupes cibles pour les médias commerciaux et la chaîne LinkedIn de -Bühler Group Chocolat, Confiserie & Snacks. • Vous concevez une variété d'outils de communication, y compris des dépliants, des présentations et des vidéos. • Vous coordonnez la coopération avec les agences extérieures et accompagnez la mise en œuvre de projets communs. • Vous maintenez et mettez à jour le contenu de nos systèmes de gestion de contenu. Exigences • Vous terminez actuellement un baccalauréat ou une maîtrise dans une université / université des sciences appliquées dans les domaines du marketing, de la communication, des médias, de l'événement ou de la gestion de produits. • Créativité, initiative et talent organisationnel vous distinguent. • L'utilisation d'outils d'IA est une question bien sûr pour vous et une partie naturelle de votre travail quotidien. • Vous êtes intéressé par le contenu technique et souhaitez acquérir de l'expérience dans une entreprise industrielle mondiale. • Vous avez une très bonne connaissance de l'allemand et de l'anglais en paroles et en écriture. • Vous aimez travailler en équipe et apprécier les échanges entre différentes régions et cultures. • Idéalement, vous connaissez déjà Adobe InDesign et Photoshop. Cela fait de nous une entreprise qui pense et investit à long terme - dans l'innovation, nos employés et la réussite économique. jobs.title: Technical Training Specialist (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about creating engaging learning experiences and turning technical knowledge into practical training solutions that support customer success?

The Consumer Foods Academy equips Bühler employees and customers with the skills to operate, maintain, and optimize our biscuit machines and production lines. In this role, you will design, coordinate, and deliver digital, classroom, and hands-on training programs for internal and external audiences. Working closely with experts and technicians, you will translate complex technical knowledge into practical learning solutions that drive professional development and operational excellence.

If this sounds like the right opportunity for you, we look forward to receiving your CV and motivational letter. Please note that this role can be based in either Denmark or Austria. Aufgaben: • Design, coordinate, and deliver technical training courses for Bühler customers and employees worldwide, in line with CF Academy guidelines and Bühler standards. • Develop modern, interactive training modules for internal and external target groups, including technicians, engineers, operators, and maintenance personnel. • Tailor training content and methods to defined learning objectives, combining theoretical and practical knowledge for biscuit production lines. • Create and maintain training materials, such as presentations, video tutorials, and interactive learning modules. • Review and update training concepts in close collaboration with the CF Academy lead, and support related communication and promotional activities. Anforderungen: • Technical education or training, such as an apprenticeship, technical college qualification, university degree, or relevant experience in a technical environment. • Strong hands-on technical mindset with a passion for practical work on machinery and equipment. • Strong ability to structure and explain complex technical topics clearly, with motivation to share knowledge in classroom or virtual training settings. • Hands-on interest in machines, production environments, technical processes, and modern learning formats. • Good Microsoft Office skills and experience or interest in creating e-learnings. • Strong English and Danish skills; German is an advantage. • Structured, independent, and precise working style with a positive, confident, and approachable communication style. • Willingness and ability to travel approximately 30% of the time, including international travel as required. Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines. Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries. We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sei appassionato di creare esperienze di apprendimento coinvolgenti e trasformare la conoscenza tecnica in soluzioni pratiche di formazione che supportano il successo del cliente? La Consumer Foods Academy equipaggia dipendenti e clienti Bühler con le competenze per operare, mantenere e ottimizzare le nostre macchine per biscotti e linee di produzione. In questo ruolo, progettare, coordinare e fornire programmi di formazione digitale, aula e hands-on per il pubblico interno ed esterno. Lavorando a stretto contatto con esperti e tecnici, tradurrai conoscenze tecniche complesse in soluzioni pratiche di apprendimento che spingono lo sviluppo professionale e l'eccellenza operativa. Se questo suona come l'opportunità giusta per voi, non vediamo l'ora di ricevere il vostro CV e lettera motivazionale. Si prega di notare che questo ruolo può essere basato in Danimarca o in Austria.

Aufgaben:
• Progettazione, coordinare e fornire corsi di formazione tecnica per clienti e dipendenti Bühler in tutto il mondo, in linea con le linee guida CF Academy e gli standard Bühler.

• Sviluppare moduli di formazione moderni e interattivi per gruppi target interni ed esterni, tra cui tecnici, ingegneri, operatori e personale di manutenzione.

• Contenuto e metodi di formazione su misura per obiettivi di apprendimento definiti, combinando conoscenze teoriche e pratiche per le linee di produzione di biscotti.

• Creare e mantenere materiali di formazione, come presentazioni, tutorial video e moduli di apprendimento interattivo.

• Revisione e aggiornamento dei concetti di formazione in stretta collaborazione con il direttore CF Academy, e supporto di comunicazione e attività promozionali.

Anforderungen:
• Istruzione tecnica o formazione, come un apprendistato, qualifica di college tecnico, laurea o esperienza rilevante in un ambiente tecnico.

• Forte capacità di strutturare e spiegare chiaramente argomenti tecnici complessi, con la motivazione di condividere le conoscenze in classe o impostazioni di formazione virtuale.

• Hands-on interesse per macchine, ambienti di produzione, processi tecnici e formati di apprendimento moderni.

• Buone competenze Microsoft Office e l'esperienza o l'interesse a creare e-learnings.

• Forti competenze in inglese e danese; il tedesco è un vantaggio.

• Stile di lavoro strutturato, indipendente e preciso con uno stile di comunicazione positivo, sicuro e accessibile.

Due miliardi di persone mangiano cibo ogni giorno che è stato prodotto con attrezzature Bühler. Un miliardo di persone guidano veicoli le cui parti sono state prodotte con le nostre macchine.
Bühler si propone di bilanciare l'umanità, la natura e l'economia in ogni decisione, sviluppando soluzioni che sbloccano opportunità di business sostenibili nel settore alimentare, alimentare e della mobilità globale.
Ci sforziamo di creare innovazioni per un mondo migliore, con un focus speciale su soluzioni sane, sicure e sostenibili. Pertanto, ci impegniamo con clienti, start-up, multinazionali e accademia per accelerare l'impatto insieme.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Sind Sie leidenschaftlich daran interessiert, ansprechende Lernerfahrungen zu schaffen und technisches Wissen in praktische Schulungslösungen umzuwandeln, die den Kundenerfolg unterstützen?

Die Consumer Foods Academy stattet Bühler Mitarbeiter und Kunden mit den Fähigkeiten aus, unsere Keksmaschinen und Produktionslinien zu betreiben, zu warten und zu optimieren. In dieser Rolle entwerfen, koordinieren und liefern Sie digitale, Klassenzimmer- und praktische Schulungsprogramme für interne und externe Zielgruppen. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit Experten und Technikern übersetzen Sie komplexes technisches Wissen in praktische Lernlösungen, die die berufliche Entwicklung und operative Exzellenz vorantreiben.

Wenn dies nach der richtigen Gelegenheit für Sie klingt, freuen wir uns auf Ihren Lebenslauf und Ihr Motivationsschreiben. Bitte beachten Sie, dass diese Rolle entweder in Dänemark oder Österreich angesiedelt sein kann. Aufgaben: • Design, Koordination und Bereitstellung von technischen Schulungen für Bühler Kunden und Mitarbeiter weltweit nach CF Academy Richtlinien und Bühler Standards. • Entwicklung moderner, interaktiver Schulungsmodule für interne und externe Zielgruppen, darunter Techniker, Ingenieure, Bediener und Wartungspersonal. • Passen Sie die Schulungsinhalte und -methoden an definierte Lernziele an und kombinieren Sie theoretisches und praktisches Wissen für Keksproduktionslinien. • Erstellen und pflegen Sie Schulungsmaterialien wie Präsentationen, Video-Tutorials und interaktive Lernmodule. • Überprüfung und Aktualisierung von Schulungskonzepten in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Leiter der CF Academy und Unterstützung der damit verbundenen Kommunikations- und Werbeaktivitäten. Anforderungen: • Technische Ausbildung oder Ausbildung, wie eine Lehre, technische Hochschulqualifikation, Hochschulabschluss oder relevante Erfahrung in einem technischen Umfeld. • Starke Fähigkeit, komplexe technische Themen klar zu strukturieren und zu erklären, mit Motivation, Wissen im Klassenzimmer oder in virtuellen Trainingsumgebungen zu teilen. • Hands-on Interesse an Maschinen, Produktionsumgebungen, technischen Prozessen und modernen Lernformaten. • Gute Microsoft Office Fähigkeiten und Erfahrungen oder Interesse an der Erstellung von E-Learnings. • Starke Englisch- und Dänischkenntnisse; Deutsch ist ein Vorteil. • Strukturierter, unabhängiger und präziser Arbeitsstil mit einem positiven, selbstbewussten und zugänglichen Kommunikationsstil. Zwei Milliarden Menschen essen täglich Lebensmittel, die mit Bühler-Geräten hergestellt wurden. Eine Milliarde Menschen fahren Fahrzeuge, deren Teile mit unseren Maschinen hergestellt wurden. Wir bemühen uns, Innovationen für eine bessere Welt zu schaffen, mit besonderem Fokus auf gesunde, sichere und nachhaltige Lösungen. Daher arbeiten wir mit Kunden, Start-ups, multinationalen Unternehmen und der akademischen Welt zusammen, um die Wirkung gemeinsam zu beschleunigen.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Êtes-vous passionné par la création d'expériences d'apprentissage stimulantes et la transformation des connaissances techniques en solutions de formation pratique qui appuient le succès du client?

La Consumer Foods Academy fournit aux employés et clients de Bühler les compétences nécessaires pour exploiter, entretenir et optimiser nos machines à biscuits et nos lignes de production. Si cela vous semble être la bonne occasion, nous nous réjouissons de recevoir votre CV et votre lettre de motivation. Veuillez noter que ce rôle peut être exercé au Danemark ou en Autriche. Aufgaben: • Concevoir, coordonner et offrir des cours de formation technique aux clients et employés de Bühler dans le monde entier, conformément aux directives de l'Académie des FC et aux normes de Bühler. • Développer des modules de formation interactifs modernes pour les groupes cibles internes et externes, y compris les techniciens, les ingénieurs, les opérateurs et le personnel de maintenance. • Adapter le contenu et les méthodes de formation à des objectifs d'apprentissage définis, combinant connaissances théoriques et pratiques pour les lignes de production de biscuits. • Créer et maintenir du matériel de formation, comme des présentations, des tutoriels vidéo et des modules d'apprentissage interactifs. • Examiner et mettre à jour les concepts de formation en étroite collaboration avec l'Académie des FC, et appuyer les activités de communication et de promotion connexes. C'est pas vrai. • Enseignement ou formation technique, comme un apprentissage, une qualification d'un collège technique, un diplôme universitaire ou une expérience pertinente dans un environnement technique. • Forte capacité de structurer et d'expliquer clairement les sujets techniques complexes, avec la motivation de partager les connaissances dans les milieux de formation en classe ou virtuelle. • Intérêt pratique pour les machines, les environnements de production, les processus techniques et les formats d'apprentissage modernes. • Bonnes compétences et expérience de Microsoft Office ou intérêt à créer des e-learnings. • Des compétences anglaises et danoises fortes; l'allemand est un avantage. • Style de travail structuré, indépendant et précis avec un style de communication positif, confiant et accessible. Nous nous efforçons de créer des innovations pour un monde meilleur, en mettant l'accent sur des solutions saines, sûres et durables. jobs.title: Engineering intern
jobs.description:
Becario de Ingeniería de Proyectos con enfoque en el diseño y elaboración de planos mecánicos en AutoCAD. Con conocimientos en dibujo técnico, interpretación y actualización de planos, elaboración de layouts, detalles constructivos y documentación técnica. Capacidad para apoyar en revisión de especificaciones y coordinación de modificaciones de diseño.

Aufgaben:
• Elaborar y actualizar planos mecánicos en AutoCAD.

• Desarrollar layouts, vistas, cortes, detalles constructivos y planos de montaje.

• Interpretar planos, diagramas, especificaciones técnicas y documentación de ingeniería.

• Apoyar en el diseño de componentes, estructuras, tuberías y sistemas mecánicos.

• Incorporar correcciones y cambios solicitados durante el desarrollo del proyecto.

• Dar seguimiento al avance de planos y entregables.

Anforderungen:
• Estudiante de Ingeniería Mecánica, Electromecánica, Mecatrónica o carrera afín.

• Conocimientos en dibujo técnico y diseño de planos mecánicos.

• Manejo de AutoCAD modelado 3D.

• Inglés intermedio.

Copy

Dos mil millones de personas consumen cada día alimentos producidos con equipos de Bühler. Mil millones de personas se movilizan en vehículos cuyas piezas han sido fabricadas con nuestras máquinas.
En Bühler, buscamos equilibrar la humanidad, la naturaleza y la economía en cada decisión, mediante el desarrollo de soluciones que impulsan oportunidades de negocio sostenibles en las industrias globales de alimentos, piensos y movilidad.
Trabajamos para crear innovaciones para un mundo mejor, con un enfoque especial en soluciones saludables, seguras y sostenibles. Para ello, colaboramos con clientes, start-ups, multinacionales y el mundo académico con el fin de acelerar juntos el impacto.

jobs.title: Regional Service Agreements Operations Manager

titleByLocale.it: Gestione operativa degli accordi di servizio regionali
titleByLocale.fr: Gestionnaire des opérations des accords de service régionaux

jobs.description:
The Regional Service Agreements Operations Manager is responsible for driving the growth and execution of service agreements across Southeast Asia. This role partners closely with the Sales organization to expand Bühler's service portfolio by identifying opportunities, developing tailored contractual solutions, and securing long-term service agreements. The position plays a critical role in defining commercial structures, ensuring operational excellence, and delivering customer success through strong contractual partnerships.

Aufgaben:
• Take full ownership of the assigned portfolio of service agreements (e.g., Remote Services, Inspection, and Maintenance), ensuring delivery excellence and high customer satisfaction

• Develop and lead a regional support structure, including quotation management, contract delivery, and back-office operations

• Act as the primary point of contact for all contractual service matters, ensuring timely and effective execution aligned with customer expectations

• Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Project Execution, Field Service, Spare Parts, and Automation teams to deliver integrated service solutions

• Drive operational excellence and standardization of service agreement management across the SEA region

• Oversee contract renewal processes, pricing strategies, and cost control measures to maintain profitability

• Develop and present integrated service proposals that balance customer needs with business objectives

• Support the identification, development, quotation, and negotiation of complex service agreements

• Establish and maintain region-specific cost calculation models in alignment with global guidelines

• Work with technical, legal, finance, and commercial teams to ensure accurate, compliant, and competitive proposals

• Maintain comprehensive documentation of quotations, contracts, and handover processes

• Communicate proactively with stakeholders on proposal status, pricing updates, and contract execution progress

• Collaborate with global teams to share insights and continuously improve service offerings and customer experience

• Support the implementation of service frameworks, processes, tools, and best practices within the region

Anforderungen:
• Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field.

• Minimum 5 years of experience in value-based selling or front-end commercial roles.

• Strong understanding of maintenance strategies and planning methodologies.

• Solid commercial acumen, including pricing, cost management, and risk assessment.

• Excellent stakeholder management, communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.

• Fluency in English (written and spoken).

• Self-motivated with a strong entrepreneurial mindset and results-driven approach.

• Ability to operate effectively within a matrix organization across multiple countries and business units.

• Proven ability to influence stakeholders without direct authority.

Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines.
Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries.
We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Il Direttore Operativo degli Accordi di Servizio Regionale è responsabile della crescita e dell'esecuzione degli accordi di servizio in tutto il Sud-Est asiatico. Questo ruolo collabora strettamente con l'organizzazione Vendite per espandere il portafoglio di servizi di Bühler individuando opportunità, sviluppando soluzioni contrattuali su misura e garantendo accordi di servizio a lungo termine. La posizione riveste un ruolo fondamentale nella definizione di strutture commerciali, nel garantire l'eccellenza operativa e nel garantire il successo del cliente attraverso forti partnership contrattuali.

Aufgaben:
• Prendere la piena proprietà del portafoglio assegnato di accordi di servizio (ad esempio, Servizi Remoti, Ispezione e Manutenzione), garantendo l'eccellenza di consegna e l'alta soddisfazione del cliente.

• Sviluppare e condurre una struttura di sostegno regionale, compresa la gestione delle quotazioni, la consegna dei contratti e le operazioni di back-office.

• Agire come punto di contatto principale per tutte le questioni di servizio contrattuale, assicurando l'esecuzione tempestiva ed efficace allineata alle aspettative del cliente.

• Collaborare in modo interfunzionale con i team Sales, Project Execution, Field Service, Spare Parts e Automation per fornire soluzioni di servizio integrate.

• Guidare l'eccellenza operativa e la standardizzazione della gestione degli accordi di servizio in tutta la regione di SEA.

• Superare i processi di rinnovo del contratto, le strategie di prezzi e le misure di controllo dei costi per mantenere la redditività.

• Sviluppare e presentare proposte di servizio integrate che bilanciano le esigenze del cliente con gli obiettivi aziendali.

• Sostenere l'identificazione, lo sviluppo, la citazione e la negoziazione di accordi di servizio complessi.

• Stabilire e mantenere modelli di calcolo dei costi specifici della regione in allineamento con le linee guida globali.

• Lavora con team tecnici, legali, finanziari e commerciali per garantire proposte accurate, conformi e competitive.

• Mantenere la documentazione completa di citazioni, contratti e processi di consegna.

• Comunicare proattivamente con le parti interessate sullo stato della proposta, sugli aggiornamenti dei prezzi e sui progressi dell'esecuzione dei contratti.

• Collabora con i team globali per condividere approfondimenti e migliorare continuamente le offerte di assistenza e l'esperienza dei clienti.

• Sostenere l'attuazione di strutture di servizio, processi, strumenti e migliori pratiche all'interno della regione

Anforderungen:
• Laurea in Business Administration, Ingegneria, o un campo relativo.

• Minimo 5 anni di esperienza in ruoli commerciali di vendita o front-end.

• Forte comprensione delle strategie di manutenzione e metodologie di pianificazione.

• Solida acume commerciale, compresi i prezzi, la gestione dei costi e la valutazione del rischio.

• Eccellente gestione delle parti interessate, comunicazione, negoziazione e capacità di presentazione.

• Fluenza in inglese (scritta e parlata).

• Auto-motivato con una forte mentalità imprenditoriale e approccio guidato dai risultati.

• Capacità di operare efficacemente all'interno di un'organizzazione matrice in più paesi e unità aziendali.

• Prove capacità di influenzare gli stakeholder senza autorità diretta.

Due miliardi di persone mangiano cibo ogni giorno che è stato prodotto con attrezzature Bühler. Un miliardo di persone guidano veicoli le cui parti sono state prodotte con le nostre macchine.
Bühler si propone di bilanciare l'umanità, la natura e l'economia in ogni decisione, sviluppando soluzioni che sbloccano opportunità di business sostenibili nei settori alimentare, alimentare e della mobilità globale.
Ci sforziamo di creare innovazioni per un mondo migliore, con un focus speciale su soluzioni sane, sicure e sostenibili. Pertanto, ci impegniamo con clienti, start-up, multinazionali e accademia per accelerare l'impatto insieme.
